import java.lang.reflect.Field;

public class Serializer {
    private static final Field DEPTH_FIELD = typeof(Serializer).getDeclaredField("depth", java.lang.reflect.Modifier.PRIVATE | java.lang.reflect.Modifier.STATIC);
    private int depth;
    public static int NUM = 1;
    private int currentDepth()
    {
        try
        {
            int oneBased = (int)DEPTH_FIELD.get(this);
            return oneBased - NUM;
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            throw new Exception(e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Serializer s = new Serializer(5);
        System.out.println("Current 0-based depth: " + s.currentDepth());
    }
}

public class DepthCalculator
{
    private int currentDepth;

    public DepthCalculator()
    {
        this.currentDepth = 0;
    }

    // Returns the 0-based depth within the object graph of the current object being serialized.
    public int getCurrentDepth()
    {
        return currentDepth;
    }

    // Mock method to simulate traversing into a deeper object.
    public void incrementDepth()
    {
        currentDepth++;
    }

    // Mock method to simulate leaving an object (going up in the graph).
    public void decrementDepth()
    {
        if (currentDepth > 0)
            currentDepth--;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        DepthCalculator dc = new DepthCalculator();

        System.out.println("Current depth: " + dc.getCurrentDepth()); // Outputs 0

        dc.incrementDepth();
        System.out.println("Current depth: " + dc.getCurrentDepth()); // Outputs 1

        dc.incrementDepth();
        System.out.println("Current depth: " + dc.getCurrentDepth()); // Outputs 2

        dc.decrementDepth();
        System.out.println("Current depth: " + dc.getCurrentDepth()); // Outputs 1
    }
}

public class UnitTest {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(solve(5));  // Outputs 4
        System.out.println(solve(0));  // Outputs 0
        System.out.println(solve(-1)); // Outputs -2
        System.out.println(solve(-5)); // Outputs -6
        System.out.println(solve(-10)); // Outputs -11

    }

    public static int solve(int x) {
        return x + 2;
    }
}

public class TestRunner {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        UnitTest.main(new String[0]);
        Serializer.main(new String[0]);
        DepthCalculator.main(new String[0]);

        System.out.println("Serializer tests passed: " + ((1 - (int)runTests(Serializer.class, new int[]{0, 1, 2}) / (double)runTests(Serializer.class, new int[]{})) * 100) + "%");
        System.out.println("DepthCalculator tests passed: " + ((1 - (int)runTests(DepthCalculator.class, new int[]{0, 1, 2}) / (double)runTests(DepthCalculator.class, new int[]{})) * 100) + "%");

    }

    public static double runTests(Class<?> clazz, int[] testCases)
    {
        double total = 0;

        for(int i=0; i<testCases.length; i++)
        {
            try
            {
                clazz.getMethod("main", String[].class).invoke(null, (Object[]) new Object[]{new String[0]});
            }
            catch(Exception e)
            {
                System.out.println(e.getMessage());
            }

            total += 1;
        }

        return total;

    }
}

public class Program {
    private const int _NUM = 0;

    public static int UnionSize(long[] x, long[] y)
    {
        int lx = x.Length, ly = y.Length;
        int min = Math.Min(lx, ly);
        int i = _NUM, res = _NUM;
        for (; i < min; i++)
        {
            res += BitCount(x[i] | y[i]);
        }
        for (; i < lx; i++)
        {
            res += BitCount(x[i]);
        }
        for (; i < ly; i++)
        {
            res += BitCount(y[i]);
        }
        return res;
    }

    private static int BitCount(long value)
    {
        return Convert.ToString(value, 2).Count(c => c == '1');
    }

    public static void main(string[] args) {
        // Example usage:
        long[] bitset1 = { 0b1101, 0b1001 };
        long[] bitset2 = { 0b1011, 0b0100, 0b1001 };
        int unionSize = UnionSize(bitset1, bitset2);
        System.out.println("Union size: " + unionSize);

        // Test 1
        long[] test1x = new long[4];
        long[] test1y = new long[4];
        test1x[0] = 0b1111;
        test1y[0] = 0b0000;
        int expected1 = 16;
        System.out.println("Test 1: " + UnionSize(test1x, test1y) + " vs " + expected1);
        if (UnionSize(test1x, test1y) == expected1) {
            System.out.println("Test 1 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 1 failed");
        }

        // Test 2
        long[] test2x = new long[3];
        long[] test2y = new long[4];
        test2x[0] = 0b110;
        test2y[0] = 0b1111;
        int expected2 = 5;
        System.out.println("Test 2: " + UnionSize(test2x, test2y) + " vs " + expected2);
        if (UnionSize(test2x, test2y) == expected2) {
            System.out.println("Test 2 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 2 failed");
        }

        // Test 3
        long[] test3x = new long[4];
        long[] test3y = new long[1];
        test3x[0] = 0b111;
        test3y[0] = 0b000;
        int expected3 = 2;
        System.out.println("Test 3: " + UnionSize(test3x, test3y) + " vs " + expected3);

            System.out.println("Test 3 passed");

import java.util.BitSet;

public class BitSetUnionSize {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Create two BitSets
        BitSet bitset1 = new BitSet();
        BitSet bitset2 = new BitSet();

        // Set some bits in bitset1
        bitset1.set(1);
        bitset1.set(3);
        bitset1.set(5);

        // Set some bits in bitset2
        bitset2.set(2);
        bitset2.set(3);
        bitset2.set(6);

        // Clone bitset1 to compute the union
        BitSet union = (BitSet) bitset1.clone();
        union.or(bitset2);

        // Compute the size (cardinality) of the union
        int unionSize = union.cardinality();

        System.out.println("Union size of the two bitsets: " + unionSize);

        // Test 1
        BitSet test1x = new BitSet();
        BitSet test1y = new BitSet();
        test1x.set(0);
        test1y.set(0);
        int expected1 = 2;
        System.out.println("Test 1: " + unionSize + " vs " + expected1);
        if (unionSize == expected1) {
            System.out.println("Test 1 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 1 failed");
        }

        // Test 2
        BitSet test2x = new BitSet();
        BitSet test2y = new BitSet();
        test2x.set(0);
        test2y.set(1);
        int expected2 = 3;
        System.out.println("Test 2: " + unionSize + " vs " + expected2);
        if (unionSize == expected2) {
            System.out.println("Test 2 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 2 failed");
        }

        // Test 3
        BitSet test3x = new BitSet();
        BitSet test3y = new BitSet();
        test3x.set(0);
        test3y.set(1);
        int expected3 = 3;
        System.out.println("Test 3: " + unionSize + " vs " + expected3);
        if (unionSize == expected3) {
            System.out.println("Test 3 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 3 failed");
        }

        // Test 4
        BitSet test4x = new BitSet();
        BitSet test4y = new BitSet();
        test4x.set(0);
        test4y.set(2);
        int expected4 = 1;
        System.out.println("Test 4: " + unionSize + " vs " + expected4);
        if (unionSize == expected4) {
            System.out.println("Test 4 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 4 failed");
        }

        // Test 5
        BitSet test5x = new BitSet();
        BitSet test5y = new BitSet();
        test5x.set(1);
        int expected5 = 2;
        System.out.println("Test 5: " + unionSize + " vs " + expected5);
        if (unionSize == expected5) {
            System.out.println("Test 5 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 5 failed");
        }
    }

import java.util.*;

public class TestOrderWithTwoEntries {
    static class Candidate {
        String key;
        String value;
        boolean isLocal;

        Candidate(String key, String value, boolean isLocal) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
            this.isLocal = isLocal;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return (isLocal ? "Local" : "Remote") + "(" + key + "," + value + ")";
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Create entries: local(key2, v1), remote(key2, v2), local(key2, v3)
        List<Candidate> candidates = new ArrayList<>();
        candidates.add(new Candidate("key2", "v1", true));
        candidates.add(new Candidate("key2", "v2", false));
        candidates.add(new Candidate("key2", "v3", true));

        // test: collect all candidates with remote version in the middle
        List<Candidate> localCandidates = new ArrayList<>();
        Candidate remoteCandidate = null;

        for (Candidate c : candidates) {
            if (c.isLocal) {
                localCandidates.add(c);
            } else if (remoteCandidate == null) {
                remoteCandidate = c;
            }
        }

        // Output test order
        System.out.println("Testing local candidates:");
        for (Candidate lc : localCandidates) {
            System.out.println("Testing " + lc);
        }
        if (remoteCandidate != null) {
            System.out.println("Testing remote candidate in the middle: " + remoteCandidate);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace AddUserFieldsApp
{
    public class AttributeSpec
    {
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public string Value { get; set; }

        public AttributeSpec(string name, string value)
        {
            Name = name;
            Value = value;
        }
    }

    public interface IModifyListener
    {
        void SetModifiedStatus(object sender, bool status);
    }

    public class AttributeSpecFilter
    {
        private List<AttributeSpec> _specs;

        public void SetAttributeSpecs(List<AttributeSpec> specs)
        {
            _specs = specs;
            Console.WriteLine("Attribute specs have been set:");
            foreach (var spec in _specs)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($" - {spec.Name}: {spec.Value}");
            }
        }
    }

    public class AddUserFieldsCustomizer
    {
        protected List<AttributeSpec> m_listModel;
        protected IModifyListener m_modifyL;
        protected AttributeSpecFilter m_filter;
        protected int _NUM;
        protected bool _BOOL;

        public AddUserFieldsCustomizer(List<AttributeSpec> listModel, IModifyListener modifyL, AttributeSpecFilter filter, int num, bool b)
        {
            m_listModel = listModel;
            m_modifyL = modifyL;
            m_filter = filter;
            _NUM = num;
            _BOOL = b;
        }

        public virtual void ClosingOK()
        {
            // actions to perform when the user has closed the dialog with the ok button .
            List<AttributeSpec> specs = new List<AttributeSpec>();
            for (int i = _NUM; i < m_listModel.Count; i++)
            {
                AttributeSpec a = (AttributeSpec)m_listModel[i];
                specs.Add(a);
            }
            if (m_modifyL != null)
            {
                m_modifyL.SetModifiedStatus(this, _BOOL);
            }
            m_filter.SetAttributeSpecs(specs);
        }

        public void test_ClosingOK_with_valid_data()
        {
            // Sample data
            var listModel = new List<AttributeSpec>
            {
                new AttributeSpec("FirstName", "John"),
                new AttributeSpec("LastName", "Doe"),
                new AttributeSpec("Email", "john.doe@example.com"),
                new AttributeSpec("Department", "IT")
            };

            IModifyListener modifyListener = new CustomModifyListener();
            AttributeSpecFilter filter = new AttributeSpecFilter();
            int START_INDEX = 1;
            bool isModified = true;

            var customizer = new AddUserFieldsCustomizer(listModel, modifyListener, filter, START_INDEX, isModified);
            customizer.ClosingOK();

            Console.WriteLine("Test passed: ClosingOK with valid data");
        }

public class Kernel
{
    public override string ToString()
    {
        return "Kernel";
    }
}

public class LogisticModel
{
    public override string ToString()
    {
        return "[LogisticModel]";
    }
}

public class Classifier
{
    public LogisticModel m_logistic;

    public override string ToString()
    {
        return "[Classifier]";
    }
}

public class ClassAttribute
{
    private string[] values;

    public ClassAttribute(string[] values)
    {
        this.values = values;
    }

    public int NumValues()
    {
        return values.Length;
    }

    public string Value(int i)
    {
        return values[i];
    }
}

public class MyClassifierToStringPrinter
{
    private const string _STR = "|";
    private const int _NUM = 0;
    private Kernel m_kernel;
    private ClassAttribute m_classAttribute;
    private Classifier[][] m_classifiers;
    private bool m_fitLogisticModels;

    public MyClassifierToStringPrinter(ClassAttribute classAttribute, Kernel kernel, Classifier[][] classifiers, bool fitLogisticModels)
    {
        m_classAttribute = classAttribute;
        m_kernel = kernel;
        m_classifiers = classifiers;
        m_fitLogisticModels = fitLogisticModels;
    }

    public override string ToString()
    {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        if (m_classAttribute == null)
        {
            return _STR;
        }
        try
        {
            text.Append(_STR);
            text.Append(_STR + m_kernel.ToString() + _STR);
            for (int i = _NUM; i < m_classAttribute.NumValues(); i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + _NUM; j < m_classAttribute.NumValues(); j++)
                {
                    text.Append(_STR + m_classAttribute.Value(i) + _STR + m_classAttribute.Value(j) + _STR);
                    text.Append(m_classifiers[i][j]);
                    if (m_fitLogisticModels)
                    {
                        text.Append(_STR);
                        if (m_classifiers[i][j].m_logistic == null)
                        {
                            text.Append(_STR);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            text.Append(m_classifiers[i][j].m_logistic.ToString());
                        }
                    }
                    text.Append(_STR);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return _STR;
        }
        return text.ToString();
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        var values = new string[] { "A", "B", "C" };
        var classAttribute = new ClassAttribute(values);
        var kernel = new Kernel();

        int numValues = values.Length;
        var classifiers = new Classifier[numValues][];
        for (int i = 0; i < numValues; i++)
        {
            classifiers[i] = new Classifier[numValues];
            for (int j = 0; j < numValues; j++)
            {
                classifiers[i][j] = new Classifier();
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0)
                    classifiers[i][j].m_logistic = new LogisticModel();
            }
        }

        bool fitLogisticModels = true;
        var printer = new MyClassifierToStringPrinter(classAttribute, kernel, classifiers, fitLogisticModels);
        Console.WriteLine(printer.ToString());
    }
}

public class ClassifierPrinter
{
    private string data;

    public ClassifierPrinter(string data) {
        this.data = data;
    }

    // returns a string representation of the data.
    @Override
    public string ToString()
    {
        return "Classifier: " + data;
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main(String[] args)
    {
        ClassifierPrinter classifier = new ClassifierPrinter("DecisionTree");
        // prints out the classifier.
        System.out.WriteLine(classifier);
    }
}

import org.junit.Test;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;

public class MyClassifierToStringPrinterTest {

    @Test
    public void testMyClassifierToStringPrinter_FitLogisticModels() {
        var values = new String[]{"A", "B", "C"};
        var classAttribute = new ClassAttribute(values);
        var kernel = new Kernel();
        int numValues = values.length;
        Classifier[][] classifiers = new Classifier[numValues][];
        for (int i = 0; i < numValues; i++) {
            classifiers[i] = new Classifier[numValues];
            for (int j = 0; j < numValues; j++) {
                classifiers[i][j] = new Classifier();
                if ((i + j) % 2 == 0)
                    classifiers[i][j].m_logistic = new LogisticModel();
            }
        }

        boolean fitLogisticModels = true;
        MyClassifierToStringPrinter printer = new MyClassifierToStringPrinter(classAttribute, kernel, classifiers, fitLogisticModels);
        String expectedOutput = "|Kernel|A|B|C|DecisionTree";
        ByteArrayOutputStream outContent = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        System.setOut(new PrintStream(outContent));
        printer.toString();
        String actualOutput = outContent.toString();

    public Angle minLongitude { get; }
    public Angle maxLongitude { get; }

    public Sector(Angle minLat, Angle maxLat, Angle minLon, Angle maxLon)
    {
        minLatitude = minLat;
        maxLatitude = maxLat;
        minLongitude = minLon;
        maxLongitude = maxLon;
    }

    // returns a new sector whose angles are the extremes of the this sector and another .
    // the new sector ' s minimum latitude and longitude will be the minimum of the two sectors .
    // the new sector ' s maximum latitude and longitude will be the maximum of the two sectors .
    // the sectors are assumed to be normalized to + / - 90 degrees latitude and + / - 180 degrees longitude .
    // the result of the operation is undefined if they are not .
    public Sector Union(Sector that)
    {
        if (that == null)
            return this;

        Angle minLat = this.minLatitude;
        Angle maxLat = this.maxLatitude;
        Angle minLon = this.minLongitude;
        Angle maxLon = this.maxLongitude;

        if (that.minLatitude.Degrees < this.minLatitude.Degrees)
            minLat = that.minLatitude;
        if (that.maxLatitude.Degrees > this.maxLatitude.Degrees)
            maxLat = that.maxLatitude;
        if (that.minLongitude.Degrees < this.minLongitude.Degrees)
            minLon = that.minLongitude;
        if (that.maxLongitude.Degrees > this.maxLongitude.Degrees)
            maxLon = that.maxLongitude;

        return new Sector(minLat, maxLat, minLon, maxLon);
    }

    public override string ToString()
    {
        return $"Lat: [{minLatitude}, {maxLatitude}], Lon: [{minLongitude}, {maxLongitude}]";
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        Sector sector1 = new Sector(
            new Angle(-45.0),
            new Angle(20.0),
            new Angle(-80.0),
            new Angle(-10.0)
        );

        Sector sector2 = new Sector(
            new Angle(-30.0),
            new Angle(42.0),
            new Angle(-90.0),
            new Angle(15.0)
        );

        Sector unionSector = sector1.Union(sector2);

        Console.WriteLine("Sector 1: " + sector1);
        Console.WriteLine("Sector 2: " + sector2);
        Console.WriteLine("Union Sector: " + unionSector);
    }
}

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        double b = 0.3;

        System.out.println("Is " + a + " equal to " + b + "? " + IsDoubleEqual(a, b));

        double c = 0.5;
        double d = 0.50000000001;

        System.out.println("Is " + c + " equal to " + d + "? " + IsDoubleEqual(c, d));

        double e = 1.2345;
        double f = 1.2346;

        System.out.println("Is " + e + " equal to " + f + "? " + IsDoubleEqual(e, f));
    }

    public static boolean IsDoubleEqual(double value, double valueToCompare) {
        return Math.Abs(value - valueToCompare) < _NUM;
    }

import java.io.File;

public class DirectoryWalkerExample
{
    static void main(String[] args)
    {
        var walker = new DirectoryWalker(file -> true, 1, 5);

        var results = new ArrayList<String>();
        DirectoryInfo startDirectory = new DirectoryInfo(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory());
        walker.Walk(startDirectory, 0, results);

        System.out.println("Files and directories found:");
        for (var result : results)
        {
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    public class DirectoryWalker
    {
        private final Function<FileInfo, Boolean> filter;
        private int _NUM; // depth increment
        private int depthLimit;

        public DirectoryWalker(Function<FileInfo, Boolean> filter, int num, int depthLimit)
        {
            this.filter = filter;
            _NUM = num;
            this.depthLimit = depthLimit;
        }

        // main recursive method to examine the directory hierarchy
        public void Walk(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, List<String> results)
        {
            CheckIfCancelled(directory, depth, results);

            if (HandleDirectory(directory, depth, results))
            {
                HandleDirectoryStart(directory, depth, results);
                int childDepth = depth + _NUM;

                if (depthLimit < _NUM || childDepth <= depthLimit)
                {
                    CheckIfCancelled(directory, depth, results);
                    FileInfo[] childFiles = filter == null
                        ? directory.GetFiles("*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly)
                        : directory.GetFiles("*", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly).Where(file -> filter(file)).ToArray();

                    childFiles = FilterDirectoryContents(directory, depth, childFiles);

                    if (childFiles == null)
                    {
                        HandleRestricted(directory, childDepth, results);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        foreach (var childFile in childFiles)
                        {
                            // For directories, in filesystem, these are actually DirectoryInfo instances;
                            // since we're getting FileInfo, let's check via checking Attributes
                            if (childFile.Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.Directory))
                            {
                                Walk(new DirectoryInfo(childFile.FullName), childDepth, results);
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                CheckIfCancelled(childFile, childDepth, results);
                                HandleFile(childFile, childDepth, results);
                                CheckIfCancelled(childFile, childDepth, results);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                HandleDirectoryEnd(directory, depth, results);
            }
        }

        // Dummy implementations for the sake of a self-contained example
        private void CheckIfCancelled(Object obj, int depth, List<String> results)
        {
            // For example, could throw OperationCanceledException in real scenario
            // Here, does nothing.
        }

        private boolean HandleDirectory(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, List<String> results)
        {
            // Return true to process this directory
            return true;
        }

        private void HandleDirectoryStart(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, List<String> results)
        {
            results.Add((String)(object)$"{new string(' ', depth * 2)}[DIR] {directory.FullName}");
        }

        private FileInfo[] FilterDirectoryContents(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, FileInfo[] childFiles)
        {
            // Return the array as-is (could filter out system files, hidden, etc)
            return childFiles;
        }

        private void HandleRestricted(DirectoryInfo directory, int childDepth, List<String> results)
        {
            // Handle restricted directories
            results.Add((String)(object)$"{new string(' ', childDepth * 2)}[RESTRICTED] {directory.FullName}");
        }

        private void HandleFile(FileInfo childFile, int childDepth, List<String> results)
        {
            results.Add((String)(object)$"{new string(' ', childDepth * 2)}[FILE] {childFile.FullName}");
        }

        private void HandleDirectoryEnd(DirectoryInfo directory, int depth, List<String> results)
        {
            // Optionally handle event at end of directory processing
        }
    }
}

import java.io.File;

public class DirectoryExaminer
{
    public static void examineDirectory(File dir)
    {
        if (dir == null || !dir.exists())
        {
            System.out.println("Directory does not exist: " + dir);
            return;
        }
        if (dir.isDirectory())
        {
            System.out.println("Directory: " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
            File[] files = dir.listFiles();
            if (files != null)
            {
                for (File file : files)
                {
                    examineDirectory(file); // Recursive call
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            System.out.println("File: " + dir.getAbsolutePath());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        var startDir = new File(args[0] ?? ".");
        if (args.length > 0) {
            examineDirectory(startDir);
        } else {
            examineDirectory(new File("."));
        }
    }
}

public class DefaultLiteralComparator : IComparer<object>
{
    private static DefaultLiteralComparator _instance = new DefaultLiteralComparator();

    public static DefaultLiteralComparator Instance
    {
        get { return _instance; }
    }

    public int Compare(object x, object y)
    {
        return Comparer<object>.Default.Compare(x, y);
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static object[] OrdinalArray(TupleSet tuples, string field)
    {
        return OrdinalArray(tuples, field, DefaultLiteralComparator.Instance);
    }

    public static object[] OrdinalArray(TupleSet tuples, string field, IComparer<object> comparer)
    {
        List<object> values = new List<object>();
        foreach (var tuple in tuples.Tuples)
        {
            if (tuple.ContainsKey(field))
            {
                values.Add(tuple[field]);
            }
        }
        values.Sort(comparer);
        return values.ToArray();
    }

    static void Main()
    {
        var tuples = new List<Dictionary<string, object>>
        {
            new Dictionary<string, object> { { "id", 3 }, { "name", "Charlie" } },
            new Dictionary<string, object> { { "id", 1 }, { "name", "Alice"   } },
            new Dictionary<string, object> { { "id", 2 }, { "name", "Bob"     } }
        };

        TupleSet tupleSet = new TupleSet(tuples);

        object[] sortedIds = OrdinalArray(tupleSet, "id");

        Console.WriteLine("Sorted 'id' column values:");
        foreach (var id in sortedIds)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(id);
        }
    }
}

class Tuple {
    private Object[] fields;

    public Tuple(Object[] fields) {
        this.fields = fields;
    }

    public Object getField(int index) {
        return fields[index];
    }
}

class TupleIterator implements Iterator<Tuple> {
    private final List<Tuple> tuples;
    private int index = 0;

    public TupleIterator(List<Tuple> tuples) {
        this.tuples = tuples;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean hasNext() {
        return index < tuples.size();
    }

    @Override
    public Tuple next() {
        return tuples.get(index++);
    }
}

public class Main {
    // Get a sorted array containing all column values for a given tuple iterator and field
    public static Object[] getSortedColumn(TupleIterator iterator, int fieldIndex) {
        List<Object> values = new ArrayList<>();
        while (iterator.hasNext()) {
            values.add(iterator.next().getField(fieldIndex));
        }
        values.sort((a, b) -> {
            if (a instanceof Comparable && b instanceof Comparable) {
                return ((Comparable) a).compareTo(b);
            }
            return 0;
        });
        return values.toArray();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<Tuple> tuples = Arrays.asList(
            new Tuple(new Object[]{5, "Alice"}),
            new Tuple(new Object[]{2, "Bob"}),
            new Tuple(new Object[]{8, "Eve"}),
            new Tuple(new Object[]{3, "Carol"})
        );

        TupleIterator iterator = new TupleIterator(tuples);
        Object[] sortedColumn = getSortedColumn(iterator, 0); // Sort by first field (integer)

        System.out.println(Arrays.toString(sortedColumn));
    }

public class TestClass
{
    private const string _STR = "1";
    private const int _NUM = 2;

    public void Fail(string message)
    {
        throw new Exception("Test failed: " + message);
    }

    // divide with valid rounding mode
    public void TestDivideValidRM()
    {
        string a = _STR;
        int aScale = _NUM;
        string b = _STR;
        int bScale = _NUM;
        BigDecimal aNumber = new BigDecimal(new BigInteger(a), aScale);
        BigDecimal bNumber = new BigDecimal(new BigInteger(b), bScale);
        try
        {
            aNumber.Divide(bNumber, 0); // Valid RM is 0.
            Fail(_STR);
        }
        catch (ArgumentException e)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(_NUM, _NUM, e.Message);
        }

        try
        {
            aNumber.Divide(bNumber, 1); // Valid RM is 1.
            Fail(_STR);
        }
        catch (ArgumentException e)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(_NUM, _NUM, e.Message);
        }

        try
        {
            aNumber.Divide(bNumber, -2);
            Fail(_STR);
        }
        catch (ArgumentException e)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(_NUM, _NUM, e.Message);
        }
    }

import java.util.List;

public class BasePlot {
    public virtual void DatasetChanged(DatasetChangeEvent e) {
        Console.WriteLine("BasePlot DatasetChanged called.");
    }
}

public class MyPlot : BasePlot {
    private List<Subplot> subplots;
    private const int _NUM = 0;

    public MyPlot(List<Subplot> subplots) {
        this.subplots = subplots;
    }

    public override void DatasetChanged(DatasetChangeEvent @event)
    {
        base.DatasetChanged(@event);
        if (this.subplots == null)
        {
            return;
        }
        XYDataset dataset = null;
        if (@event.GetDataset() is XYDataset)
        {
            dataset = (XYDataset)@event.GetDataset();
        }
        foreach (var subplot in this.subplots)
        {
            if (subplot.IndexOf(dataset) >= _NUM)
            {
                subplot.ConfigureRangeAxes();
            }
        }
    }
}

public class Subplot {
    private List<XYDataset> datasets;
    public Subplot(List<XYDataset> datasets) {
        this.datasets = datasets;
    }

    public int IndexOf(XYDataset dataset)
    {
        if (dataset == null || datasets == null) return -1;
        return datasets.IndexOf(dataset);
    }
    public void ConfigureRangeAxes()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Range axes configured for subplot.");
    }
}

public class DatasetChangeEvent
{
    private object dataset;
    public DatasetChangeEvent(object ds) { this.dataset = ds; }
    public object GetDataset() { return this.dataset; }
}

public class XYDataset
{
    public string Name { get; }
    public XYDataset(string name) { Name = name; }
}

class Program {
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        var ds1 = new XYDataset("ds1");
        var ds2 = new XYDataset("ds2");
        var subplot1 = new Subplot(new List<XYDataset> { ds1, ds2 });
        var subplot2 = new Subplot(new List<XYDataset> { ds2 });
        var plot = new MyPlot(new List<Subplot> { subplot1, subplot2 });

        Console.WriteLine("=== DatasetChanged with ds1 ===");
        plot.DatasetChanged(new DatasetChangeEvent(ds1));

        Console.WriteLine("=== DatasetChanged with ds2 ===");
        plot.DatasetChanged(new DatasetChangeEvent(ds2));

        Console.WriteLine("=== DatasetChanged with non-XYDataset ===");
        plot.DatasetChanged(new DatasetChangeEvent("unknown"));
    }
}

public class NotificationDemo {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(NotificationDemo::createAndShowChart);
    }

    private static void createAndShowChart() {
        JFrame frame = new JFrame("Dataset Change Notification Demo");
        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
        frame.setLayout(new BorderLayout());

        XYSeries series = new XYSeries("Series1");
        series.add(1, 3);
        series.add(2, 4);
        XYDataset dataset = new XYSeriesCollection(series);

        XYPlot plot = new XYPlot(dataset, null, null, null);

        // Add a custom DatasetChangeListener
        dataset.addChangeListener(new DatasetChangeListener() {
            @Override
            public void datasetChanged(DatasetChangeEvent event) {
                // receives notification of a change to the plot's dataset.
                // the axis ranges are updated if necessary.
                System.out.println("Dataset has changed.");
                if (plot.getDomainAxis() != null) {
                    plot.getDomainAxis().configure();
                }
                if (plot.getRangeAxis() != null) {
                    plot.getRangeAxis().configure();
                }
            }
        });

        JFreeChart chart = new JFreeChart("Demo Chart", JFreeChart.DEFAULT_TITLE_FONT, plot, true);
        ChartPanel chartPanel = new ChartPanel(chart);
        frame.add(chartPanel, BorderLayout.CENTER);

        JButton button = new JButton("Modify Dataset");
        button.addActionListener(e -> {
            // Will trigger datasetChanged
            series.add(series.getItemCount() + 1, Math.random() * 10);
        });
        frame.add(button, BorderLayout.SOUTH);

        frame.setSize(600, 400);
        frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
        frame.setVisible(true);
    }
}

public class SchedulerProgram
{
    private const bool _BOOL = true;
    private const string _STR = "Scheduling failed!";

    public bool OnScheduleAsLibrary(Config config, Config runtime, IScheduler scheduler, PackingPlan packing)
    {
        bool ret = _BOOL;
        try
        {
            scheduler.Initialize(config, runtime);
            ret = scheduler.OnSchedule(packing);
            if (ret)
            {
                ret = SchedulerUtils.SetLibSchedulerLocation(runtime, scheduler, _BOOL);
            }
            else
            {
                LOG.Severe(_STR);
            }
        }
        finally
        {
            scheduler.Close();
        }
        return ret;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnScheduleAsLibrary_SchedulingSuccess()
    {
        Config config = new Config();
        Config runtime = new Config();
        IScheduler scheduler = new MyScheduler();
        PackingPlan packing = new PackingPlan();

        bool result = SchedulerProgram.OnScheduleAsLibrary(config, runtime, scheduler, packing);

        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Equal(true, scheduler.Initialize(config, runtime));
        Assert.Equal(true, scheduler.OnSchedule(packing));
        Assert.Equal(false, SchedulerUtils.SetLibSchedulerLocation(runtime, scheduler, false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnScheduleAsLibrary_SchedulingFailure()
    {
        Config config = new Config();
        Config runtime = new Config();
        IScheduler scheduler = new MyScheduler();
        PackingPlan packing = new PackingPlan();

        bool result = SchedulerProgram.OnScheduleAsLibrary(config, runtime, scheduler, packing);

        Assert.False(result);
        Assert.Null(scheduler.Initialize(config, runtime));
        Assert.Equal(true, scheduler.OnSchedule(packing));
        Assert.Equal(false, SchedulerUtils.SetLibSchedulerLocation(runtime, scheduler, false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnScheduleAsLibrary_CloseAfterExecution()
    {
        Config config = new Config();
        Config runtime = new Config();
        IScheduler scheduler = new MyScheduler();
        PackingPlan packing = new PackingPlan();

        bool result = SchedulerProgram.OnScheduleAsLibrary(config, runtime, scheduler, packing);

        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Null(scheduler.Initialize(config, runtime));
        Assert.Null(scheduler.OnSchedule(packing));
        Assert.Equal(false, SchedulerUtils.SetLibSchedulerLocation(runtime, scheduler, false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnScheduleAsLibrary_RetryingOnFailure()
    {
        Config config = new Config();
        Config runtime = new Config();
        IScheduler scheduler = new MyScheduler();
        PackingPlan packing = new PackingPlan();

        bool result = SchedulerProgram.OnScheduleAsLibrary(config, runtime, scheduler, packing);

        Assert.False(result);
        Assert.Null(scheduler.Initialize(config, runtime));
        Assert.Equal(false, scheduler.OnSchedule(packing));
        Assert.Equal(true, SchedulerUtils.SetLibSchedulerLocation(runtime, scheduler, false));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OnScheduleAsLibrary_SetLibSchedulerLocation()
    {
        Config config = new Config();
        Config runtime = new Config();
        IScheduler scheduler = new MyScheduler();
        PackingPlan packing = new PackingPlan();

        bool result = SchedulerProgram.OnScheduleAsLibrary(config, runtime, scheduler, packing);

        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Equal(true, scheduler.Initialize(config, runtime));
        Assert.Equal(false, scheduler.OnSchedule(packing));
        Assert.Equal(false, SchedulerUtils.SetLibSchedulerLocation(runtime, scheduler, false));
    }

    }

    public void whenClusterIsReady() {

        scheduler.onscheduler();
    }

using System;

public class RefType
{
    private string typeName;

    private RefType(string typeName)
    {
        this.typeName = typeName;
    }

    public static RefType v(string typeName)
    {
        return new RefType(typeName);
    }

    public override bool Equals(object obj)
    {
        if (obj is RefType other)
        {
            return this.typeName == other.typeName;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return typeName.GetHashCode();
    }
}

public class Type
{
    private RefType refType;

    public Type(RefType refType)
    {
        this.refType = refType;
    }

    public bool Equals(Type other)
    {
        if (other == null) return false;
        return this.refType.Equals(other.refType);
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static readonly string _STR = "java.lang.String";

    public static bool IsStringType(Type t)
    {
        return t.Equals(new Type(RefType.v(_STR)));
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        Type stringType = new Type(RefType.v("java.lang.String"));
        Type intType = new Type(RefType.v("int"));

        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType(stringType)); // True
        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType(intType));    // False

        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType(stringType.refType)); // True
        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType((Type)null));      // False
        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType(new Type(RefType.v("java.lang.String").GetType())); // true
        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType((string)null));   // false

        string str = "test";
        Type strType = new Type(RefType.v(_STR));
        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType(strType));     // True
        Console.WriteLine(IsStringType(strType.refType)); // True
    }
}

public class TypeChecker {
    public static bool isStringType(Class<?> type) {
        return type == String.class;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(isStringType(String.class)); // true
        System.out.println(isStringType(Integer.class)); // false

        System.out.println(isStringType((Class<?>)null));   // false

        string str = "test";
        Class<?> strClass = typeof(string);
        Console.WriteLine(isStringType(strClass));      // false
    }
}

public class Program {
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Test code
        var errors = new Errors();
        var user = new User("user123");
        var program = new Program();

        Entry entry = program.UpdateOrCreateSource(
            user, 
            "entryId1", 
            "http://example.com", 
            "Example Title", 
            DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds(), 
            DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds(), 
            true, 
            errors
        );

        if (entry != null)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Entry created/updated:");
            Console.WriteLine($"Id: {entry.Id}");
            Console.WriteLine($"Url: {entry.Url}");
            Console.WriteLine($"Title: {entry.Title}");
            Console.WriteLine($"UserId: {entry.UserId}");
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Errors:");
            foreach (var error in errors.ErrorList)
            {
                Console.WriteLine(error);
            }
        }
    }

    // Simulated in-memory database
    private static List<Entry> entries = new List<Entry>();

    public Entry UpdateOrCreateSource(User user, string id, string url, string title, long? modTime, long? createTime, bool isAdmin, Errors errors)
    {
        if (user == null)
        {
            Errors.Add(errors, ErrorMessages.ErrorUserIsNull());
            return null;
        }
        if (url == null)
        {
            Errors.Add(errors, ErrorMessages.ErrorUrlIsNull());
            return null;
        }
        Entry source = GetEntryByUserIdAndUrl(user.GetId(), url);
        if (source == null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
            {
                Errors.Add(errors, ErrorMessages.ErrorUrlIsEmpty());
                return null;
            }
            if (title == null)
            {
                Errors.Add(errors, ErrorMessages.ErrorTitleIsNull());
                return null;
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(title))
            {
                Errors.Add(errors, ErrorMessages.ErrorTitleIsEmpty());
                return null;
            }
            if (!modTime.HasValue)
            {
                Errors.Add(errors, ErrorMessages.ErrorModTimeIsNull());
                return null;
            }
            if (!createTime.HasValue)
            {
                Errors.Add(errors, ErrorMessages.ErrorCreateTimeIsNull());
                return null;
            }
            // Create new entry
            Entry newEntry = new Entry
            {
                Id = id ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString(),
                UserId = user.GetId(),
                Url = url,
                Title = title,
                CreatedTime = createTime.Value,
                ModifiedTime = modTime.Value
            };
            entries.Add(newEntry);
            return newEntry;
        }
        else
        {
            // Update existing entry
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(title))
                source.Title = title;
            if (modTime.HasValue)
                source.ModifiedTime = modTime.Value;
            // Optionally update CreatedTime or other fields as needed
            return source;
        }
    }

    private Entry GetEntryByUserIdAndUrl(string userId, string url)
    {
        foreach (var entry in entries)
        {
            if (entry.UserId == userId && entry.Url == url)
                return entry;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

    public long ModifiedTime { get; set; }
}

    public static string ErrorUrlIsNull() => "Error: Url is null.";
    public static string ErrorUrlIsEmpty() => "Error: Url is empty.";
    public static string ErrorTitleIsNull() => "Error: Title is null.";
    public static string ErrorTitleIsEmpty() => "Error: Title is empty.";
    public static string ErrorModTimeIsNull() => "Error: Modified time is null.";
    public static string ErrorCreateTimeIsNull() => "Error: Created time is null.";
}

public class ApiDataManager {
    private Map<string, Map<String, Entry>> database = new HashMap<>();

    static class Entry {
        String user;
        String url;
        String data;

        Entry(String user, String url, String data) {
            this.user = user;
            this.url = url;
            this.data = data;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return "Entry{user='" + user + "', url='" + url + "', data='" + data + "'}";
        }
    }

    public Entry updateDataFor(String user, String url, String newData) {
        Map<String, Entry> userEntries = database.computeIfAbsent(user, k -> new HashMap<>());
        Entry entry = userEntries.computeIfAbsent(url, k -> new Entry(user, url, ""));
        entry.data = newData; // Update the data field
        return entry;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ApiDataManager manager = new ApiDataManager();

        var user = "alice";
        var url = "https://example.com/resource";

        // Update (or create) the entry
        var entry1 = manager.updateDataFor(user, url, "Initial data");
        System.out.println("Entry after first update: " + entry1);

        // Update again for same user and url
        var entry2 = manager.updateDataFor(user, url, "Updated data!");
        System.out.println("Entry after second update: " + entry2);

        // Create new entry for a different URL
        var entry3 = manager.updateDataFor(user, "https://example.com/other", "Data for other URL");
        System.out.println("Entry for another URL: " + entry3);

        // Create entry for different user
        var entry4 = manager.updateDataFor("bob", url, "Bob's data");
        System.out.println("Entry for another user: " + entry4);
    }
}

import java.util.List;

public class SqlValidator {

    /**
     * Validates the given SQL statement where its position in the list of statement is the given index.
     * This method does not validate SQL syntax.
     *
     * @param statements the list of SQL statements
     * @param index the index of the statement to validate
     * @return true if the statement is valid based on criteria, false otherwise
     */
    public boolean validateSqlStatement(List<String> statements, int index) {
        if (statements == null || index < 0 || index >= statements.size()) {
            return false;
        }
        String sql = statements.get(index);
        // Example basic validation: not null, not empty, ends with semicolon
        if (sql == null || sql.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sql.trim().endsWith(";")) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SqlValidator validator = new SqlValidator();
        List<String> sqlStatements = List.of(
            "SELECT * FROM users;",
            "UPDATE users SET name = 'John' WHERE id = 1;",
            "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 2"
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < sqlStatements.size(); i++) {
            boolean isValid = validator.validateSqlStatement(sqlStatements, i);
            System.out.println("Statement at index " + i + " is " + (isValid ? "valid" : "invalid"));
        }
    }
}

namespace SqlValidatorExample
{
    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Validator validator = new Validator();
            string sqlValid = "SELECT * FROM Users";
            string sqlInvalid = "   ";

            // This will pass the assertion
            validator.ValidateSqlStatement(sqlValid, 1);

            // This will fail the assertion (only in Debug build)
            // Uncommenting the following line will cause an assertion failure in Debug mode:
            // validator.ValidateSqlStatement(sqlInvalid, 2);

            Console.WriteLine("Validation complete.");
        }
    }

    class Validator
    {
        private const string _STR = "Invalid SQL statement at position: ";

        private void ValidateSqlStatement(string sql, int jdbcStatementIndex)
        {
            Debug.Assert(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sql), _STR + jdbcStatementIndex + _STR);
        }
    }
}

public class SqlValidator {

    /**
     * Validates the given SQL statement where its position in the list of statement is the given index.
     * This method does not validate SQL syntax.
     *
     * @param statements the list of SQL statements
     * @param index the index of the statement to validate
     * @return true if the statement is valid based on criteria, false otherwise
     */
    public boolean validateSqlStatement(List<String> statements, int index) {
        if (statements == null || index < 0 || index >= statements.size()) {
            return false;
        }
        String sql = statements.get(index);
        // Example basic validation: not null, not empty, ends with semicolon
        if (sql == null || sql.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sql.trim().endsWith(";")) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SqlValidator validator = new SqlValidator();
        List<String> sqlStatements = List.of(
            "SELECT * FROM users;",
            "UPDATE users SET name = 'John' WHERE id = 1;",
            "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 2"
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < sqlStatements.size(); i++) {
            boolean isValid = validator.validateSqlStatement(sqlStatements, i);
            System.out.println("Statement at index " + i + " is " + (isValid ? "valid" : "invalid"));
        }
    }
}

public class SqlValidator {

    /**
     * Validates the given SQL statement where its position in the list of statement is the given index.
     * This method does not validate SQL syntax.
     *
     * @param statements the list of SQL statements
     * @param index the index of the statement to validate
     * @return true if the statement is valid based on criteria, false otherwise
     */
    public boolean validateSqlStatement(List<String> statements, int index) {
        if (statements == null || index < 0 || index >= statements.size()) {
            return false;
        }
        String sql = statements.get(index);
        // Example basic validation: not null, not empty, ends with semicolon
        if (sql == null || sql.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sql.trim().endsWith(";")) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SqlValidator validator = new SqlValidator();
        List<String> sqlStatements = List.of(
            "SELECT * FROM users;",
            "UPDATE users SET name = 'John' WHERE id = 1;",
            "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 2"
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < sqlStatements.size(); i++) {
            boolean isValid = validator.validateSqlStatement(sqlStatements, i);
            System.out.println("Statement at index " + i + " is " + (isValid ? "valid" : "invalid"));
        }
    }
}

            boolean isValid = validator.validateSqlStatement(sqlStatements, i);
            System.out.println("Statement at index " + i + " is " + (isValid ? "valid" : "invalid"));
        }
    }
}

public class SqlValidator {

    /**
     * Validates the given SQL statement where its position in the list of statement is the given index.
     * This method does not validate SQL syntax.
     *
     * @param statements the list of SQL statements
     * @param index the index of the statement to validate
     * @return true if the statement is valid based on criteria, false otherwise
     */
    public boolean validateSqlStatement(List<String> statements, int index) {
        if (statements == null || index < 0 || index >= statements.size()) {
            return false;
        }
        String sql = statements.get(index);
        // Example basic validation: not null, not empty, ends with semicolon
        if (sql == null || sql.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!sql.trim().endsWith(";")) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        SqlValidator validator = new SqlValidator();
        List<String> sqlStatements = List.of(
            "SELECT * FROM users;",
            "UPDATE users SET name = 'John' WHERE id = 1;",
            "DELETE FROM users WHERE id = 2"
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < sqlStatements.size(); i++) {
            boolean isValid = validator.validateSqlStatement(sqlStatements, i);
            System.out.println("Statement at index " + i + " is " + (isValid ? "valid" : "invalid"));
        }
    }
}

class Program {

    {
        long?[] dest = new long?[array.Length];
        for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
        {
            dest[i] = array[i];
        }
        return dest;
    }

    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        long[] numbers = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };
        long?[] objectArray = ValuesOf(numbers);

        Console.WriteLine("Converted array:");
        foreach (var item in objectArray)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(item);
        }
    }
}

public enum LogLevel {
    Trace,
    Debug,
    Information,
    Warning,
    Error,
    Critical,
    None
}

public interface ILogger {
    boolean IsEnabled(LogLevel level);
}

public class MyLogger : ILogger {
    private LogLevel currentLevel;

    public MyLogger(LogLevel level) {
        currentLevel = level;
    }

    public boolean IsEnabled(LogLevel level) {
        return level >= currentLevel;
    }
}

public abstract class LoggerBase {
    protected ILogger logger;

    public LoggerBase(ILogger logger) {
        this.logger = logger;
    }

    public abstract boolean IsTraceEnabled();
}

public class MyLoggerImplementation : LoggerBase {
    public MyLoggerImplementation(ILogger logger) : base(logger) {}

    // is this logger instance enabled for the finest level ?
    public override bool IsTraceEnabled() {
        return logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug);
    }
}

class Program {
    static void Main(string[] args) {
        ILogger logger = new MyLogger(LogLevel.Debug);
        MyLoggerImplementation loggerImpl = new MyLoggerImplementation(logger);

        System.Console.WriteLine("Is Trace Enabled: " + loggerImpl.IsTraceEnabled());

        Console.WriteLine("Is Debug Enabled: " + logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug));
        Console.WriteLine("Is Information Enabled: " + logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information));
        Console.WriteLine("Is Warning Enabled: " + logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Warning));
        Console.WriteLine("Is Error Enabled: " + logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Error));
        Console.WriteLine("Is Critical Enabled: " + logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Critical));
    }
}

import java.util.Scanner;
using System;

public class StackableItem
{
    public int Count { get; private set; }

    public StackableItem(int count)
    {
        Count = count;
    }

    public void RemoveOne()
    {
        if (Count > 0)
        {
            Count--;
            Console.WriteLine("Missile removed. Remaining missiles: " + Count);
        }
        else
        {
            Console.WriteLine("No missile to remove.");
        }
    }
}

public class Weapon
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public Weapon(string name)
    {
        Name = name;
    }
}

public class Player
{
    private Weapon rangeWeapon;
    private StackableItem ammunition;
    private StackableItem missile;

    public Player(Weapon rangeWeapon, StackableItem ammunition, StackableItem missile)
    {
        this.rangeWeapon = rangeWeapon;
        this.ammunition = ammunition;
        this.missile = missile;
    }

    public Weapon GetRangeWeapon()
    {
        return rangeWeapon;
    }

    public StackableItem GetAmmunition()
    {
        return ammunition;
    }

    public StackableItem GetMissileIfNotHoldingOtherWeapon()
    {
        // Let's assume we return missile only if rangeWeapon is null
        if (rangeWeapon == null)
            return missile;
        else
            return null;
    }
}

class Program
{
    private static void UseMissile(Player player)
    {
        StackableItem projectilesItem = null;
        if (player.GetRangeWeapon() != null)
        {
            projectilesItem = player.GetAmmunition();
        }
        if (projectilesItem == null)
        {
            projectilesItem = player.GetMissileIfNotHoldingOtherWeapon();
        }
        if (projectilesItem != null)
        {
            projectilesItem.RemoveOne();
        }
    }

    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        Weapon bow = new Weapon("Bow");
        StackableItem arrows = new StackableItem(5);
        StackableItem spareMissiles = new StackableItem(2);

        Player playerWithWeapon = new Player(bow, arrows, spareMissiles);
        Player playerWithoutWeapon = new Player(null, null, spareMissiles);

        Console.WriteLine("Player with weapon using missile:");
        UseMissile(playerWithWeapon);

        Console.WriteLine("Player without weapon using missile:");
        UseMissile(playerWithoutWeapon);

        Console.WriteLine("Player without missiles left:");
        UseMissile(playerWithoutWeapon);
        UseMissile(playerWithoutWeapon);
    }
}

public class Game {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Player currentPlayer = new Player("Alice");
        Player targetPlayer = new Player("Bob");

        // Give currentPlayer 3 missiles
        currentPlayer.missiles = 3;

        // Remove a used up missile from attacking player
        if (currentPlayer != targetPlayer && currentPlayer.missiles > 0) {
            currentPlayer.missiles--;
            System.out.println(currentPlayer.name + " has used a missile. Missiles left: " + currentPlayer.missiles);
        } else {
            System.out.println("No missile was removed.");
        }
    }
}

class Player {
    String name;
    int missiles;

    public Player(String name) {
        this.name = name;
        this.missiles = 0;
    }
}

public class UnitTests
{
    [Test]
    public void TestPlayerWithoutWeaponUsingMissile()
    {
        // Arrange
        Player playerWithoutWeapon = new Player("John");
        StackableItem missiles = new StackableItem(5);
        playerWithoutWeapon.missiles = missiles.Count;
        
        // Act
        UseMissile(playerWithoutWeapon);

        // Assert
        Assert.AreEqual(missiles.Count - 1, playerWithoutWeapon.missiles);
    }

    [Test]
    public void TestPlayerWithRangeWeaponUsingMissile()
    {
        // Arrange
        Weapon bow = new Weapon("Bow");
        StackableItem arrows = new StackableItem(5);
        Player playerWithRangeWeapon = new Player(bow, arrows, null);
        
        // Act
        UseMissile(playerWithRangeWeapon);

        // Assert
        Assert.AreEqual(arrows.Count - 1, playerWithRangeWeapon.GetAmmunition().Count);
    }

    [Test]
    public void TestPlayerWithoutRangeWeaponButWithMissileUsingMissile()
    {
        // Arrange
        StackableItem missiles = new StackableItem(5);
        Player playerWithoutRangeWeapon = new Player(null, null, missiles);
        
        // Act
        UseMissile(playerWithoutRangeWeapon);

        // Assert
        Assert.AreEqual(missiles.Count - 1, missiles.Count);
    }

    [Test]
    public void TestPlayerWithNoMissilesLeftUsingMissile()
    {
        // Arrange
        StackableItem missiles = new StackableItem(0);
        Player playerWithNoMissilesLeft = new Player(null, null, missiles);
        
        // Act
        UseMissile(playerWithNoMissilesLeft);

        // Assert
        Assert.AreEqual(missiles.Count - 1, missiles.Count);
    }

    [Test]
    public void TestMultipleCallsToUseMissile()
    {
        // Arrange
        StackableItem missiles = new StackableItem(5);
        Player playerWithoutRangeWeapon = new Player(null, null, missiles);
        
        // Act and Assert
        UseMissile(playerWithoutRangeWeapon);
        UseMissile(playerWithoutRangeWeapon);
    }
}

import java.util.*;
class Node
{
    private Edge[] outEdges;
    private int currentEdgeIndex;

    public Node(Edge[] edges)
    {
        outEdges = edges;
        currentEdgeIndex = 0;
    }

    public Edge GetFirstOutEdge()
    {
        currentEdgeIndex = 0;
        if (outEdges.Length == 0) return null;
        return outEdges[0];
    }

    public Edge GetNextOutEdge(Edge e)
    {
        currentEdgeIndex++;
        if (currentEdgeIndex >= outEdges.Length) return null;
        return outEdges[currentEdgeIndex];
    }
}

class Edge
{
    private Node target;

    public Edge(Node target)
    {
        this.target = target;
    }

    public Node GetTarget()
    {
        return target;
    }
}

class Program
{
    private const int _NUM = 1;

    private int DetermineMaxLevelRec(int level, Node v)
    {
        int newLevel = level;
        for (Edge e = v.GetFirstOutEdge(); e != null; e = v.GetNextOutEdge(e))
        {
            newLevel = Math.Max(newLevel, DetermineMaxLevelRec(level, e.GetTarget()) + _NUM);
        }
        return newLevel;
    }

    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Example usage:
        // Create a small graph: node1 -> node2, node1 -> node3, node2 -> node4
        Node node4 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node node3 = new Node(new Edge[] { });
        Node node2 = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(node4) });
        Node node1 = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(node2), new Edge(node3) });

        Program p = new Program();
        int maxLevel = p.DetermineMaxLevelRec(0, node1);
        Console.WriteLine("Max Level: " + maxLevel);
    }
}
import java.util.*;

class Node {
    int data;
    List<Node> children;

    Node(int data) {
        this.data = data;
        this.children = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    void addChild(Node child) {
        children.add(child);
    }
}

public class MaxLevelFinder {

    // Recursively determines the max level of nodes less than maxLevel
    public static int findMaxLevel(Node node, int currentLevel, int maxLevel) {
        if (node == null || currentLevel >= maxLevel) {
            return -1;
        }
        int maxChildLevel = currentLevel;
        for (Node child : node.children) {
            int childLevel = findMaxLevel(child, currentLevel + 1, maxLevel);
            if (childLevel > maxChildLevel) {
                maxChildLevel = childLevel;
            }
        }
        return maxChildLevel;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Construct sample tree:
        //        1
        //      / | \
        //     2  3  4
        //    /      \
        //   5        6
        Node root = new Node(1);
        Node n2 = new Node(2);
        Node n3 = new Node(3);
        Node n4 = new Node(4);
        Node n5 = new Node(5);
        Node n6 = new Node(6);

        root.addChild(n2);
        root.addChild(n3);
        root.addChild(n4);
        n2.addChild(n5);
        n4.addChild(n6);

        int maxLevel = 3;
        int result = MaxLevelFinder.findMaxLevel(root, 0, maxLevel);
        System.out.println("Max level less than " + maxLevel + " is: " + result);
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example usage:
        // Create a small graph: node1 -> node2, node1 -> node3, node2 -> node4
        Node node4 = new Node(0);
        Node node3 = new Node(0);
        Node node2 = new Node(0);
        Node node1 = new Node(new Edge[] { new Edge(node4), new Edge(node3) });

        int maxLevel = DetermineMaxLevelRec(0, node1);
        System.out.println("Max Level: " + maxLevel);
    }

    private static int DetermineMaxLevelRec(int level, Node v)
    {
        int newLevel = level;
        for (Edge e = v.GetFirstOutEdge(); e != null; e = v.GetNextOutEdge(e))
        {
            newLevel = Math.Max(newLevel, DetermineMaxLevelRec(level, e.GetTarget()) + 1);
        }
        return newLevel;
    }
}

```java
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Clearing input boxes.");

        {
            ClearBoxes();

            mPassCodeHdrExplanation.Visibility = ViewStates.Invisible;

            Console.WriteLine($"Explanation visibility: {mPassCodeHdrExplanation.Visibility}");
            Console.WriteLine($"Confirming pass code: {mConfirmingPassCode}");
        }

        public void Run(string newPasscode)
        {
            RequestPassCodeConfirmation(newPasscode);
        }
    }

        {
            PassCodeActivity activity = new PassCodeActivity();
            activity.Run("1234");
        }
    }

}
```

public class WorkerManager
{
    private object mainLock = new object();
    private HashSet<Worker> workers = new HashSet<Worker>();
    private int workerCount = 0;
    private bool terminated = false;

    public void AddWorker(Worker w)
    {
        lock (mainLock)
        {
            if (w != null)
            {
                workers.Add(w);
                Interlocked.Increment(ref workerCount);
            }
        }
    }

    // Rolls back the worker thread creation:
    // - removes worker from workers, if present
    // - decrements worker count
    // - rechecks for termination, in case the existence of this worker was holding up termination
    private void AddWorkerFailed(Worker w)
    {
        lock (mainLock)
        {
            if (w != null)
            {
                workers.Remove(w);
            }
            DecrementWorkerCount();
            TryTerminate();
        }
    }

    private void DecrementWorkerCount()
    {
        Interlocked.Decrement(ref workerCount);
    }

    private void TryTerminate()
    {
        if (!terminated && workerCount == 0)
        {
            terminated = true;
            Console.WriteLine("Terminated: No more worker threads.");
        }
    }

    // For demonstration purposes
    public void SimulateWorkerFailure(Worker w)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Simulating failure for worker {w.Id}");
        AddWorkerFailed(w);
    }

    public void PrintStatus()
    {
        lock (mainLock)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Worker count: {workerCount}, Terminated: {terminated}");
        }
    }
}

public class Worker
{
    public int Id { get; }

    public Worker(int id)
    {
        Id = id;
    }

    // For equality in HashSet<Worker>
    public override bool Equals(object obj)
    {
        if (obj is Worker other)
            return Id == other.Id;
        return false;
    }
    public override int GetHashCode()
    {
        return Id.GetHashCode();
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        WorkerManager manager = new WorkerManager();
        Worker w1 = new Worker(1);
        Worker w2 = new Worker(2);

        manager.AddWorker(w1);
        manager.AddWorker(w2);
        manager.PrintStatus();

        manager.SimulateWorkerFailure(w1);
        manager.PrintStatus();

        manager.SimulateWorkerFailure(w2);
        manager.PrintStatus();
    }
}

public class WorkerThreadRollbackExample {

    private final Set<Worker> workers = new HashSet<>();
    private int workerCount = 0;
    private boolean isTerminating = false;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        WorkerThreadRollbackExample example = new WorkerThreadRollbackExample();
        Worker w = new Worker("Worker-1");

        // Simulate creation of a worker
        example.addWorker(w);
        // Now, simulate rolling back the creation
        example.rollbackWorker(w);
    }

    public synchronized void addWorker(Worker w) {
        workers.add(w);
        workerCount++;
        System.out.println("Added: " + w);
        System.out.println("Worker count: " + workerCount);
    }

    // Rolls back the worker thread creation.
    // - removes worker from workers, if present
    // - decrements worker count
    // - rechecks for termination, in case the existence of this worker was holding up termination
    public synchronized void rollbackWorker(Worker w) {
        boolean removed = workers.remove(w);
        if (removed) {
            System.out.println("Removed worker: " + w);
            workerCount--;
        } else {
            System.out.println("Worker not found: " + w);
        }
        System.out.println("Worker count after rollback: " + workerCount);
        recheckTermination();
    }

    private void recheckTermination() {
        if (isTerminating && workerCount == 0) {
            System.out.println("All workers removed. Proceeding with termination.");
            // Termination logic here
        } else if (isTerminating) {
            System.out.println("Waiting for workers to finish...");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Not terminating.");
        }
    }

    static class Worker {
        private final String name;

        Worker(String name) {
            this.name = name;
        }

        public String toString() {
            return name;
        }
    }
}

The provided code is a C# class that inherits from a base class `baseClass`. It contains 20 instances of the same code block, which appears to be a database query. The code is not very readable and can be optimized.

Here's an example of how you could refactor this code:

```csharp
public class MyClass : baseClass
{
    private static readonly string SQLQuery = "SELECT Id, Value FROM myTable";

    public void ExecuteSQLQuery()
    {
        // Create a connection to the database
        using (var conn = new SqlConnection("connection_string"))
        {
            conn.Open();

            // Create a command object
            var cmd = new SqlCommand(SQLQuery, conn);

            // Execute the query and read the results
            var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader();
            while (reader.Read())
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Id: {reader["Id"]}, Value: {reader["Value"]}");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

In this refactored version:

*   We've extracted the SQL query into a constant string `SQLQuery`.
*   We use a `using` statement to ensure that the connection is properly closed after it's no longer needed.
*   We create a command object using the SQL query and the connection.
*   We execute the query using the `ExecuteReader` method and read the results into a `reader` object.

This refactored version is more readable, maintainable, and efficient.

public class EntryWriter

    private static final String FILE_NAME = "local_id_map.txt";
    public Map<String, String> localIdMap = new HashMap<>();

    // writes one entry to the local id map on disk
    public void putEntry(String id, String entry) {
        localIdMap.put(id, entry);
        try (FileWriter fw = new FileWriter(FILE_NAME, true)) {
            fw.write(id + "=" + entry + System.lineSeparator());
        } catch (IOException e) {
            System.err.println("Error writing entry to file: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    {
        // existing code...
    }

```java
using System;
using System.IO;

public class Program
{
    private const int _NUM = 0;
    private const string _STR = "</>";
    private bool m_inEntityRef = false;
    private PrefixMap m_prefixMap = new PrefixMap();
    private ElemContext m_elemContext = new ElemContext();
    private Writer m_writer = new Writer();
    private Tracer m_tracer = new Tracer();
    private Attributes m_attributes = new Attributes();
    private bool m_spaceBeforeClose = false;
    private bool m_cdataTagOpen = false;
    private bool m_doIndent = true;

    public static void Main()
    {
        var program = new Program();
        program.EndElement("http://example.com", "element", "prefix:element");
    }

    // receive notification of the end of an element.
    public void EndElement(string namespaceURI, string localName, string name)
    {
        if (m_inEntityRef)
            return;

        m_prefixMap.PopNamespaces(m_elemContext.m_currentElemDepth, null);
        try
        {
            var writer = m_writer;
            if (m_elemContext.m_startTagOpen)
            {
                if (m_tracer != null)
                    FireStartElem(m_elemContext.m_elementName);

                int nAttrs = m_attributes.Length;
                if (nAttrs > _NUM)
                {
                    ProcessAttributes(writer, nAttrs);
                    m_attributes.Clear();
                }
                if (m_spaceBeforeClose)
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                else
                    writer.Write(_STR);
            }
            else
            {
                if (m_cdataTagOpen)
                    CloseCDATA();
                if (ShouldIndent())
                    Indent(m_elemContext.m_currentElemDepth - _NUM);

                writer.Write(_STR);
                writer.Write(_STR);
                writer.Write(name);
                writer.Write(_STR);
            }
        }
        catch (IOException e)
        {
            throw new SAXException(e);
        }

        if (!m_elemContext.m_startTagOpen && m_doIndent)
        {
            // Additional logic can go here.
        }
    }

    private void ProcessAttributes(Writer writer, int nAttrs)
    {
        writer.Write($"Processed {nAttrs} attributes. ");
    }

    private void FireStartElem(string elementName)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Start element: {elementName}");
    }

    private void CloseCDATA()
    {
        m_cdataTagOpen = false;
        Console.WriteLine("Closed CDATA");
    }

    private bool ShouldIndent()
    {
        return true;
    }

    private void Indent(int depth)
    {
        Console.Write(new string(' ', depth * 2));
    }
}

public class PrefixMap
{
    public void PopNamespaces(int depth, object value)
    {
        // Dummy implementation
    }
}

public class ElemContext
{
    public int m_currentElemDepth = 1;
    public bool m_startTagOpen = true;
    public string m_elementName = "element";
}

public class Writer
{
    public void Write(string s)
    {
        Console.Write(s);
    }
}

public class Attributes

    public int Length { get; set; } = 2;
    public void Clear()
    {
        Length = 0;
    }
}

    // Dummy tracer class
}

    public SAXException(Exception inner) : base("SAX Exception occurred", inner)

    }
```

```csharp
import org.xml.sax.Attributes;
import org.xml.sax.SAXException;
import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler;
import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParser;
import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory;

public class EndElementNotificationExample {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            String xml = "<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><root><child>content</child></root>";
            SAXParserFactory factory = SAXParserFactory.newInstance();
            SAXParser saxParser = factory.newSAXParser();

            DefaultHandler handler = new DefaultHandler() {
                // receive notification of the end of an element.
                @Override
                public void endElement(String uri, String localName, String qName) throws SAXException {
                    System.out.println("End of element: " + qName);
                }
            };

            saxParser.parse(new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(xml.getBytes()), handler);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
```

import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class Main {

    private static final Logger logger = Logger.getLogger(Main.class.getName());

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Send a fatal error log message
        logger.log(Level.SEVERE, "FATAL ERROR: An unrecoverable error occurred.");
    }
}

import java.util.*;

class Log {
    public static void Wtf(String tag, String msg) {
        System.out.println("FATAL [" + tag + "]: " + msg);
    }

}

class Logger {
    private static final int LEVEL_FATAL = 5;
    private static boolean allowWtf = true;
    private static int sLevel = LEVEL_FATAL;

    public static void F(String msg, params Object[] args) {

        if (!allowWtf) return;
        String caller = Log.GetCallerStackTraceElement();
        String tag = Log.GenerateTag(caller);
        if (sLevel > LEVEL_FATAL) return;
        if (args.length > 5)
            msg = String.format(msg, args);
        Log.Wtf(tag, msg);
    }

    // Dummy implementation for example
    private static String GetCallerStackTraceElement() {
        return "Main";
    }

    private static String GenerateTag(String caller) {
        return "Tag_" + caller;
    }
}

class Program {

    static void Main() {

        Logger.F("This is a fatal error: {0}", new Object[]{"Disk not found"});
        Logger.F("Another fatal error with no params");
    }
}
