using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class CatalogTreeLeaf {
    private String _name;

    public CatalogTreeLeaf(String name) {
        _name = name;
    }

    public String GetName() {
        return _name;
    }
}

public class CatalogTree {
    private List<CatalogTreeLeaf> _leaves;
    private int _NUM = 0;

    public CatalogTree() {
        _leaves = new List<CatalogTreeLeaf>();
    }

    public void AddLeaf(CatalogTreeLeaf leaf) {
        _leaves.Add(leaf);
    }

    // leaves can be used for many - to - many relations
    public void DeleteLeaves(String name) {
        for (int i = _NUM; i < _leaves.Count; i++) {
            CatalogTreeLeaf leaf = _leaves[i];
            if (name.Equals(leaf.GetName())) {
                _leaves.RemoveAt(i);
                i--; // Adjust index after removal
            }
        }
    }

    public void PrintLeaves() {
        foreach (var leaf in _leaves) {
            Console.WriteLine(leaf.GetName());
        }
    }
}

public class Program {
    public static void Main() {
        CatalogTree tree = new CatalogTree();
        tree.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Apple"));
        tree.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Banana"));
        tree.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Apple"));
        tree.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Cherry"));
        tree.AddLeaf(new CatalogTreeLeaf("Apple"));

        Console.WriteLine("Before deleting 'Apple':");
        tree.PrintLeaves();

        tree.DeleteLeaves("Apple");

        Console.WriteLine("\nAfter deleting 'Apple':");
        tree.PrintLeaves();
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void removeLeaf(List<String> leaves, String leaf) {
        leaves.remove(leaf);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<String> leaves = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList("oak", "maple", "birch", "elm"));
        System.out.println("Before removal: " + leaves);
        removeLeaf(leaves, "maple");
        System.out.println("After removal: " + leaves);
    }
}

import java.util.BitSet;

public class VectorStringRepresentation {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int[] arr = { 1, 0, 1, 1, 0 };
        int startIndex = 0;
        IntVector v = new IntVector(arr, startIndex);
        System.out.println(v.ToString()); // Should print: 10110

        BitSet bits = new BitSet(8);
        bits.set(0);
        bits.set(2);
        bits.set(5);

        System.out.println(bits.toString());

        int[] arr1 = { 0, 0, 1, 0 };
        int startIndex1 = 0;
        IntVector v1 = new IntVector(arr1, startIndex1);
        System.out.println(v1.ToString()); // Should print: 100

        BitSet bits1 = new BitSet(8);
        bits1.set(2);
        bits1.set(5);

        System.out.println(bits1.toString());

        int[] arr2 = { 0, 0, 1, 1 };
        int startIndex2 = 0;
        IntVector v2 = new IntVector(arr2, startIndex2);
        System.out.println(v2.ToString()); // Should print: 110

        BitSet bits2 = new BitSet(8);
        bits2.set(3);

        System.out.println(bits2.toString());

        int[] arr3 = { 0 };
        int startIndex3 = 0;
        IntVector v3 = new IntVector(arr3, startIndex3);
        System.out.println(v3.ToString()); // Should print: 0

        BitSet bits3 = new BitSet(8);

        System.out.println(bits3.toString());

        int[] arr4 = { 1 };
        int startIndex4 = 0;
        IntVector v4 = new IntVector(arr4, startIndex4);
        System.out.println(v4.ToString()); // Should print: 1

        BitSet bits4 = new BitSet(8);

        System.out.println(bits4.toString());
    }
}

class MyBitVector {
    private BitSet bits;
    private int size;

    public MyBitVector(int size) {
        this.size = size;
        this.bits = new BitSet(size);
    }

    public void set(int index) {
        bits.set(index);
    }

    /**
     * Returns a string representation of this vector.
     * <p>
     * Note that this string representation shows the bit of index 0 at the leftmost position.
     */
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            sb.append(bits.get(i) ? '1' : '0');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

class IntVector
{
    private int[] _data;
    private int _NUM;

    public IntVector(int[] data, int num)
    {
        _data = data;
        _NUM = num;
    }

    public int Size()
    {
        return _data.Length;
    }

    public int GetInt(int i)
    {
        return _data[i];
    }

    // returns a string representation of this vector.
    public override string ToString()
    {
        var s = new StringBuilder();
        int size = Size();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
        {
            if(i >= _NUM)
                s.Append(GetInt(i));
        }
        return s.ToString();
    }
}

        int[] arr = { 1, 0, 1, 1, 0 };

class MyBitVector {
    private BitSet bits;
    private int size;

    public MyBitVector(int size) {
        this.size = size;
        this.bits = new BitSet(size);
    }

    public void set(int index) {
        bits.set(index);
    }

    /**
     * Returns a string representation of this vector.
     * <p>
     * Note that this string representation shows the bit of index 0 at the leftmost position.
     */
    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            sb.append(bits.get(i) ? '1' : '0');
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

class IntVector
{
    private int[] _data;
    private int _NUM;

    public IntVector(int[] data, int num)
    {
        _data = data;
        _NUM = num;
    }

    public int Size()
    {
        return _data.Length;
    }

    public int GetInt(int i)
    {
        return _data[i];
    }

    // returns a string representation of this vector.
    public override string ToString()
    {
        var s = new StringBuilder();
        int size = Size();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
        {
            if(i >= _NUM)
                s.Append(GetInt(i));
        }
        return s.ToString();
    }
}

public class UriValidator
{
    private const int _NUM = 0;
    private const bool _BOOL = false;

    // Validate the URI characters within a specific component.
    // The component must be performed after escape encoding,
    // or it doesn't include escaped characters.
    // It's not that much strict, generous. The strict validation might be performed before being called this method.
    protected bool Validate(char[] component, int soffset, int eoffset, BitArray generous)
    {
        if (eoffset == -_NUM)
        {
            eoffset = component.Length - _NUM;
        }
        for (int i = soffset; i <= eoffset; i++)
        {
            if (!generous[component[i]])
            {
                return _BOOL;
            }
        }
        return !_BOOL;
    }

    // For demonstration purposes, provide a way to call Validate from Main
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // For simplicity, let's allow letters and digits (ASCII 0-127 all letters/digits are allowed)
        BitArray generous = new BitArray(128, false);
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) generous[c] = true;
        for (char c = 'A'; c <= 'Z'; c++) generous[c] = true;
        for (char c = '0'; c <= '9'; c++) generous[c] = true;
        generous['-'] = true;
        generous['_'] = true;
        generous['.'] = true;

        char[] component = "UriComponent1".ToCharArray(); // All allowed
        UriValidator validator = new UriValidator();
        bool result = validator.Validate(component, 0, component.Length - 1, generous);
        Console.WriteLine($"Is the component valid? {result}");
    }
}
public class UriCharacterValidator {
    /**
     * Checks whether the specified s character is valid.
     * Validate the URI characters within a specific component. The component must be performed after escape encoding,
     * or it doesn't include escaped characters.
     * <p>
     * It's not that much strict, generous. The strict validation might be performed before being called this method.
     *
     * @param s the character to check
     * @return true if the character is valid for use in the URI component, false otherwise
     */
    public static boolean isValidComponentChar(char s) {
        // This is a generous check for URI component. You can expand or restrict this as needed.
        // Unreserved characters in URI: ALPHA / DIGIT / "-" / "." / "_" / "~"
        // For generous validation, allow a wider range: don't restrict strictly to above
        if ((s >= 'a' && s <= 'z') ||
            (s >= 'A' && s <= 'Z') ||
            (s >= '0' && s <= '9') ||
            s == '-' ||
            s == '.' ||
            s == '_' ||
            s == '~') {
            return true;
        }
        // Allow sub-delims: "!", "$", "&", "'", "(", ")", "*", "+", ",", ";", "="
        if ("!$&'()*+,;=".indexOf(s) >= 0) {
            return true;
        }
        // Allow ':' and '@' (used in some URI components)
        if (s == ':' || s == '@') {
            return true;
        }
        // Add more characters as needed by your application, but these are "safe"
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String testChars = "AZaz09-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@%/[]";
        for (char c : testChars.toCharArray()) {
            System.out.printf("Char '%c' (U+%04X): %s%n", c, (int)c, isValidComponentChar(c) ? "Valid" : "Invalid");
        }
    }
}

      path.ComputeBounds(r, false);
    }

    } else {
      System.out.println("Error building bitmap");
    }
    System.out.print("Printing pieces info...");

      path.ComputeBounds(r, false);
      piece = new Piece(50, 50, bitmap, 10);
    }
    System.out.println("...Done");
  }

import java.lang.Thread;

public class RuntimePermission
{
    public String Name { get; }
    public RuntimePermission(String name)
    {
        Name = name;
    }
}

public class SecurityManager
{
    public static SecurityManager Current { get; } = new SecurityManager();

    public void CheckPermission(RuntimePermission permission)
    {
        // Permission check simulation
        // Throw if not allowed
    }
}

public class ShutdownHooksManager
{
    private readonly List<Thread> hooksList = new List<Thread>();
    private int VMState = 0;
    private const int _NUM = 1;

    public bool RemoveShutdownHook(Thread hook)
    {
        SecurityManager sm = SecurityManager.Current;
        if (sm != null)
        {
            sm.CheckPermission(new RuntimePermission("shutdownHooks"));
        }
        if (hook == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(hook));
        if (VMState > _NUM)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException();
        }
        lock (hooksList)
        {
            return hooksList.Remove(hook);
        }
    }

    public void RegisterShutdownHook(Thread hook)
    {
        if (hook == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(hook));
        lock (hooksList)
        {
            hooksList.Add(hook);
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        ShutdownHooksManager manager = new ShutdownHooksManager();

        Thread hook = new Thread(() => Console.WriteLine("Shutdown hook running..."));
        manager.RegisterShutdownHook(hook);

        bool removed = manager.RemoveShutdownHook(hook);
        Console.WriteLine("Shutdown hook removed: " + removed);

        // Try removing again
        removed = manager.RemoveShutdownHook(hook);
        Console.WriteLine("Shutdown hook removed again: " + removed);
    }
}

public class DeregisterShutdownHookExample {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Create a Runnable for the shutdown hook
        Runnable hookTask = new Runnable() {
            public void run() {
                System.out.println("Shutdown hook executed.");
            }
        };

        // Create a Thread with the shutdown hook
        Thread shutdownHook = new Thread(hookTask);

        // Register the shutdown hook
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(shutdownHook);

        // De-register (remove) the shutdown hook
        boolean removed = Runtime.getRuntime().removeShutdownHook(shutdownHook);

        if (removed) {
            System.out.println("Shutdown hook was successfully de-registered.");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Failed to de-register shutdown hook.");
        }

        // main thread continues...
        System.out.println("Main program terminating.");
    }
}

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.concurrent.Callable;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.FutureTask;

public class ReadRequestDemo {

    // This Callable reads a line from the input when called.
    static class InputReader implements Callable<String> {
        @Override
        public String call() throws Exception {
            BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            return reader.readLine();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
        FutureTask<String> futureRead = new FutureTask<>(new InputReader());

        // Start a separate thread to collect input
        Thread inputThread = new Thread(futureRead, "InputReaderThread");
        inputThread.setDaemon(true); // Daemon so JVM doesn't wait for input on exit.
        inputThread.start();

        // Main thread: simulate ongoing work, and allow user to interrupt by keyboard
        System.out.println("Type something and press Enter to interrupt the main thread.");
        while (true) {
            // Request the read in the future
            if (futureRead.isDone()) {
                try {
                    String userInput = futureRead.get();
                    System.out.println("Input received: " + userInput);
                } catch (ExecutionException e) {
                    System.err.println("Error reading input: " + e.getMessage());
                }
                break; // Exit after getting the input
            }

            // Simulate some work here
            System.out.print(".");
            System.out.flush();
            Thread.sleep(1000);

            // Optional: add logic to quit if needed
            // For demo, we exit loop upon receiving input
        }
        System.out.println("\nMain thread done.");
    }
}

        inputThread.start();

        // Main thread: simulate ongoing work, and allow user to interrupt by keyboard
        System.out.println("Type something and press Enter to interrupt the main thread.");
        while (true) {
            // Request the read in the future
            if (futureRead.isDone()) {
                try {
                    String userInput = futureRead.get();
                    System.out.println("Input received: " + userInput);
                } catch (ExecutionException e) {
                    System.err.println("Error reading input: " + e.getMessage());
                }
                break; // Exit after getting the input
            }

            // Simulate some work here
            System.out.print(".");
            System.out.flush();
            Thread.sleep(1000);

            // Optional: add logic to quit if needed
            // For demo, we exit loop upon receiving input
        }
        System.out.println("\nMain thread done.");
    }
}

import java.util.List;
import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;

public class KeyboardInputManager {

    private TextReader m_KeyboardStream;
    private volatile bool m_KeyboardReadRequest;
    private List<String> m_KeyboardInput;
    private readonly int _NUM = 100; // Sleep milliseconds
    private Thread inputThread;

    public KeyboardInputManager() {
        m_KeyboardStream = Console.In;
        m_KeyboardReadRequest = false;
        m_KeyboardInput = new List<string>();
    }

    public void Start() {
        inputThread = new Thread(Run);
        inputThread.IsBackground = true;
        inputThread.Start();
    }

    public void Stop() {
        m_KeyboardStream = null; // Let Run thread exit
        if (inputThread != null) {
            inputThread.Join();
        }
    }

    // Request and block for keyboard input in main thread
    public string RequestInput()
    {
        lock (this)
        {
            m_KeyboardReadRequest = true;
            Monitor.Wait(this);
        }

        if (m_KeyboardInput.Count > 0)
        {
            string result = m_KeyboardInput[0];
            m_KeyboardInput.RemoveAt(0);
            return result;
        }
        return null;
    }

    public void Run()
    {
        while (m_KeyboardStream != null)
        {
            try
            {
                if (m_KeyboardReadRequest)
                {
                    string s = m_KeyboardStream.ReadLine();
                    m_KeyboardInput.Add(s);
                    m_KeyboardReadRequest = false;
                    lock (this)
                    {
                        Monitor.PulseAll(this);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Thread.Sleep(_NUM);
                }
            }
            catch (IOException io)
            {
                // Handle IOException
            }
        }
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        KeyboardInputManager kim = new KeyboardInputManager();
        kim.Start();

        Console.WriteLine("Type something, type 'quit' to exit:");
        while (true) {
            Console.Write("Input> ");
            string input = kim.RequestInput();
            Console.WriteLine("You typed: " + input);
            if (input == "quit")
                break;
        }

        kim.Stop();
        Console.WriteLine("Keyboard input manager stopped.");
    }
}

        KeyboardInputManager kim = new KeyboardInputManager();
        kim.Start();

        System.out.println("Type something, type 'quit' to exit:");
        while (true) {
            System.out.print("Input> ");
            String input = kim.RequestInput();
            System.out.println("You typed: " + input);
            if (input.equals("quit"))
                break;
        }

        kim.Stop();
        System.out.println("Keyboard input manager stopped.");
    }
}

public class Program {

    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
        KeyboardInputManager kim = new KeyboardInputManager();
        kim.Start();

        System::out::println("Type something, type 'quit' to exit:");
        while (true) {
            System::cout << "Input: ";
            std::cin >> input;
            std::cout << "You typed: " << input << std::endl;
            if (input == "quit") {
                break;
            }
        }

        kim.Stop();
    }
}

using System;

public class StackScroller {
    private float stackScroll;
    
    public StackScroller(float initialScroll) {
        stackScroll = initialScroll;
    }

    public float GetStackScroll() {
        return stackScroll;
    }

    public void SetStackScroll(float value) {
        stackScroll = value;
    }
    
    // Bounds the scroll between 0.0 and 100.0 for demonstration.
    public float GetBoundedStackScroll(float value) {
        return Math.Max(0.0f, Math.Min(100.0f, value));
    }

    // Bounds the current scroll if necessary
    public boolean BoundScroll() {
        float curScroll = GetStackScroll();
        float newScroll = GetBoundedStackScroll(curScroll);
        if (newScroll.CompareTo(curScroll) != 0) {
            SetStackScroll(newScroll);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        StackScroller scroller = new StackScroller(120.0f);
        System.out.println("Initial Stack Scroll: " + scroller.GetStackScroll());
        boolean wasBound = scroller.BoundScroll();
        System.out.println("Was scroll bounded? " + wasBound);
        System.out.println("Current Stack Scroll: " + scroller.GetStackScroll());
    }
}

public class Program {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        StackScroller scroller = new StackScroller(120.0f);
        System.out.println("Initial Stack Scroll: " + scroller.GetStackScroll());
        boolean wasBound = scroller.BoundScroll();
        System.out.println("Was scroll bounded? " + wasBound);
        System.out.println("Current Stack Scroll: " + scroller.GetStackScroll());
    }
}

public class ScrollBounder {
    private int currentScroll;
    private int minScroll;
    private int maxScroll;

    public ScrollBounder(int currentScroll, int minScroll, int maxScroll) {
        this.currentScroll = currentScroll;
        this.minScroll = minScroll;
        this.maxScroll = maxScroll;
    }

    // bounds the current scroll if necessary
    public void boundCurrentScrollIfNecessary() {
        if (currentScroll < minScroll) {
            currentScroll = minScroll;
        } else if (currentScroll > maxScroll) {
            currentScroll = maxScroll;
        }
    }

    public int getCurrentScroll() {
        return currentScroll;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ScrollBounder scrollBounder = new ScrollBounder(150, 0, 100);
        System.out.println("Before bounding: " + scrollBounder.getCurrentScroll());
        scrollBounder.boundCurrentScrollIfNecessary();
        System.out.println("After bounding: " + scrollBounder.getCurrentScroll());
    }
}

using System;

namespace EvaluationAggregator
{
    public interface AggregateableEvaluation
    {
        AggregateableEvaluation Aggregate(Evaluation evaluation);
    }

    public class Evaluation
    {
        public int m_MissingClass;
        public int m_WithClass;
        public double[][] m_ConfusionMatrix;
        public double[] m_ClassPriors;
        public double m_ClassPriorsSum;

        public int Incorrect()
        {
            // stub, should return number of incorrect
            return 1;
        }

        public int Correct()
        {
            // stub, should return number of correct
            return 2;
        }

        public int Unclassified()
        {
            // stub, should return number of unclassified
            return 3;
        }

        // Return a clone of the confusion matrix
        public double[][] ConfusionMatrix()
        {
            if (m_ConfusionMatrix == null) return null;
            double[][] copy = new double[m_ConfusionMatrix.Length][];
            for (int i = 0; i < m-ConfusionMatrix.Length; i++)
            {
                copy[i] = new double[m_ConfusionMatrix[i].Length];
                Array.Copy(m_ConfusionMatrix[i], copy[i], m-ConfusionMatrix[i].Length);
            }
            return copy;
        }
    }

    public class MyEvaluation : Evaluation, AggregateableEvaluation
    {
        private int m_Incorrect;
        private int m_Correct;
        private int m_Unclassified;
        private int _NUM = 0;
        private double[][] m_ConfusionMatrix;
        private double[] m_ClassPriors;
        private double m_ClassPriorsSum;

        public MyEvaluation(int size)
        {
            m_ConfusionMatrix = new double[size][];
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++)
            {
                m_ConfusionMatrix[i] = new double[size];
            }
            m_ClassPriors = new double[size];
        }

        public override AggregateableEvaluation Aggregate(Evaluation evaluation)
        {
            m_Incorrect += evaluation.Incorrect();
            m_Correct += evaluation.Correct();
            m_Unclassified += evaluation.Unclassified();
            m_MissingClass += evaluation.m_MissingClass;
            m_WithClass += evaluation.m_WithClass;
            if (evaluation.m_ConfusionMatrix != null)
            {
                double[][] newMatrix = evaluation.ConfusionMatrix();
                if (newMatrix != null)
                {
                    for (int i = _NUM; i < m_ConfusionMatrix.Length; i++)
                    {
                        for (int j = _NUM; j < m_ConfusionMatrix[i].Length; j++)
                        {
                            m_ConfusionMatrix[i][j] += newMatrix[i][j];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            double[] newClassPriors = evaluation.m_ClassPriors;
            if (newClassPriors != null && m_ClassPriors != null)
            {
                for (int i = _NUM; i < this.m_ClassPriors.Length; i++)
                {
                    m_ClassPriors[i] = newClassPriors[i];
                }
            }
            m_ClassPriorsSum = evaluation.m_ClassPriorsSum;
            return this;
        }

        public void PrintStats()
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"Incorrect: {m_Incorrect}");
            Console.WriteLine($"Correct: {m_Correct}");
            Console.WriteLine($"Unclassified: {m_Unclassified}");
            Console.WriteLine($"MissingClass: {m_MissingClass}");
            Console.WriteLine($"WithClass: {m_WithClass}");
            Console.WriteLine("Confusion Matrix:");
            for (int i = 0; i < m_ConfusionMatrix.Length; i++)
            {
                for (int j = 0; j < m-ConfusionMatrix[i].Length; j++)
                {
                    Console.Write($"{m_ConfusionMatrix[i][j]} ");
                }
                Console.WriteLine();
            }
            Console.WriteLine("Class Priors:");
            for (int i = 0; i < m_ClassPriors.Length; i++)
            {
                Console.Write($"{m_ClassPriors[i]} ");
            }
            Console.WriteLine();
            Console.WriteLine($"ClassPriorsSum: {m_ClassPriorsSum}");
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            // Example initial evaluation
            Evaluation eval = new Evaluation();
            eval.m_MissingClass = 5;
            eval.m_WithClass = 6;
            eval.m_ConfusionMatrix = new double[2][] {
                new double[] { 1, 2 },
                new double[] { 3, 4 }
            };
            eval.m_ClassPriors = new double[] { 0.3, 0.7 };
            eval.m_ClassPriorsSum = 1.0;

            MyEvaluation myEval = new MyEvaluation(2);
            myEval
            {

                m_Unclassified = 1;
                m_MissingClass = 5;

using System;

namespace EvaluationAggregator
{
    public class Evaluation {
        // Example statistics, you can extend as needed
        private int correct;
        private int incorrect;
        private int skipped;
        private int total;

        public Evaluation() {
            this.correct = 0;
            this.incorrect = 0;
            this.skipped = 0;
            this.total = 0;
        }

        public Evaluation(int correct, int incorrect, int skipped, int total) {
            this.correct = correct;
            this.incorrect = incorrect;
            this.skipped = skipped;
            this.total = total;
        }

        /**
         * Adds the statistics encapsulated in the supplied evaluation object into this one.
         * Does not perform any checks for compatibility between the supplied evaluation object and this one.
         */
        public void add(Evaluation other) {
            this.correct += other.correct;
            this.incorrect += other.incorrect;
            this.skipped += other.skipped;
            this.total += other.total;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return "Evaluation{" +
                    "correct=" + correct +
                    ", incorrect=" + incorrect +
                    ", skipped=" + skipped +
                    ", total=" + total +
                    '}';
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Evaluation eval1 = new Evaluation(10, 2, 1, 13);
            Evaluation eval2 = new Evaluation(5, 3, 0, 8);

            Console.WriteLine("Before adding:");
            Console.WriteLine("eval1: " + eval1);
            Console.WriteLine("eval2: " + eval2);

            eval1.add(eval2);

            Console.WriteLine("After adding:");
            Console.WriteLine("eval1: " + eval1);

            System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(10000);
        }
    }

import java.util.List;

public class RecoverPointScanner {

    // Scans all sites until all volumes involved in the RecoverPoint protection are visible
    public void scanAllSitesUntilAllVolumesVisible(List<Site> sites, List<Volume> protectionVolumes) {
        boolean allVisible = false;
        while (!allVisible) {
            allVisible = true;
            for (Volume volume : protectionVolumes) {
                boolean found = false;
                for (Site site : sites) {
                    if (site.isVolumeVisible(volume)) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!found) {
                    allVisible = false;
                    System.out.println("Volume " + volume.getName() + " not yet visible at any site. Retrying...");
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(1000); // wait before next scan
                    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println("All protection volumes are visible at the sites.");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example usage
        Site site1 = new Site("Site1");
        Site site2 = new Site("Site2");

        Volume volA = new Volume("VolumeA");
        Volume volB = new Volume("VolumeB");

        site1.addVisibleVolume(volA);

        List<Site> sites = List.of(site1, site2);
        List<Volume> volumes = List.of(volA, volB);

        RecoverPointScanner scanner = new RecoverPointScanner();

        // Simulate making volB visible after 3 seconds
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                Thread.sleep(3000);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
            site2.addVisibleVolume(volB);
            System.out.println("VolumeB is now visible at Site2.");
        }).start();

        scanner.scanAllSitesUntilAllVolumesVisible(sites, volumes);
    }
}

class Site {
    private String name;
    private List<Volume> visibleVolumes;

    public Site(String name) {
        this.name = name;
        this.visibleVolumes = new java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    }

    public boolean isVolumeVisible(Volume volume) {
        return visibleVolumes.contains(volume);
    }

    public void addVisibleVolume(Volume volume) {
        visibleVolumes.add(volume);
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

class Volume {
    private String name;

    public Volume(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
        if (this == obj) return true;
        if (!(obj instanceof Volume)) return false;
        Volume other = (Volume) obj;
        return name != null ? name.equals(other.name) : other.name == null;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return name != null ? name.hashCode() : 0;
    }
}

public class VolumeScanner
{
    // scans all sites until all volumes involved in the recoverpoint protection are visible
    public void WaitForVolumesToBeVisible(CGRequestParams request)
    {
        Scan(request.GetCopies(), request.GetRsets());
    }

    private void Scan(string[] copies, string[] rsets)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Scanning for copies:");
        foreach (var copy in copies)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($" - {copy}");
        }

        Console.WriteLine("Scanning for rsets:");
        foreach (var rset in rsets)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($" - {rset}");
        }
        Console.WriteLine("All volumes are now visible.");
    }
}

        site1.addVisibleVolume(volA);

        List<Volume> volumes = List.of(volA);

        scanner.scanAllSitesUntilAllVolumesVisible(sites, volumes);

        // Assert all volumes are visible at Site1
        for (Volume volume : volumes) {
            if (!site1.isVolumeVisible(volume)) {
                fail("Expected Volume " + volume.getName() + " to be visible at Site1.");
            }
        }

        // Assert VolumeA is not visible at Site2
        Volume volB = new Volume("VolumeB");

        List<Volume> volumes2 = List.of(volA, volB);
        RecoverPointScanner scanner2 = new RecoverPointScanner();
        scanner2.scanAllSitesUntilAllVolumesVisible(sites2, volumes2);

        // Assert VolumeB is not visible at Site1
        for (Volume volume : volumes2) {

using System;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Threading;
using System.Windows.Forms;

public class ImagePaintingForm : Form {
    private Image image;
    private bool paintCalled = false;
    private readonly int _NUM = 50; // Example value for coordinates
    private readonly object lockObj = new object();

    public ImagePaintingForm() {
        // Load an example image or create a bitmap
        image = new Bitmap(100, 100);
        using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(image)) {
            g.Clear(Color.LightBlue);
            g.DrawEllipse(Pens.Black, 10, 10, 80, 80);
        }
        this.Width = 200;
        this.Height = 200;
        this.Text = "Image Painting Example";
    }

    protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e) {
        base.OnPaint(e);
        OnPaint(e.Graphics);
    }

    public override void Refresh() {
        base.Refresh();
        lock (this) {
            Monitor.Wait(this, 500); // Wait for painting
        }
    }

    public void OnPaint(Graphics g) {
        g.DrawImage(image, _NUM, _NUM);
        if (!paintCalled) {
            paintCalled = true;
            lock (this) {
                Monitor.PulseAll(this);
            }
        }
    }

    [STAThread]
    static void Main() {
        Application.EnableVisualStyles();
        Application.Run(new ImagePaintingForm());
    }
}

import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;

public class ImagePainter extends JPanel {
    private BufferedImage image;

    public ImagePainter(BufferedImage image) {
        this.image = image;
    }

    // paints the image on the window.
    @Override
    protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
        super.paintComponent(g);
        if (image != null) {
            int x = (getWidth() - image.getWidth(this)) / 2;
            int y = (getHeight() - image.getHeight(this)) / 2;
            g.drawImage(image, x, y, this);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        JFrame frame = new JFrame("Image Painter");
        // Sample image: create a red rectangle image
        int width = 200, height = 150;
        BufferedImage img = new BufferedImage(width, height, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
        Graphics2D g2d = ((BufferedImage) img).createGraphics();
        g2d.setColor(Color.RED);
        g2d.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        g2d.dispose();

        ImagePainter panel = new ImagePainter(img);

        frame.add(panel);
        frame.setSize(400, 300);
        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
        frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
        frame.setVisible(true);
    }
}

public class UnitTest {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ImagePaintingForm testForm = new ImagePaintingForm();
        JFrame frame = new JFrame("Image Painter");
        // Sample image: create a red rectangle image
        int width = 200, height = 150;
        BufferedImage img = new BufferedImage(width, height, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
        Graphics2D g2d = ((BufferedImage) img).createGraphics();
        g2d.setColor(Color.RED);
        g2d.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        g2d.dispose();

        ImagePainter panel = new ImagePainter(img);

        frame.add(panel);
        frame.setSize(400, 300);
        frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
        frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
        frame.setVisible(true);

        testForm.refresh();
        try {
            Thread.sleep(500); // Wait for painting
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }

        System.out.println("Test Form Image: " + imageToString(testForm.image));

        panel.repaint();

        // Test drawing on the form image
        testForm.OnPaint(null);
        System.out.println("Drawing completed. Resulting Image: " + imageToString(testForm.image));
    }

    private static String imageToString(BufferedImage img) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < img.getHeight(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < img.getWidth(); j++) {
                int colorValue = img.getRGB(j, i);
                if (colorValue != -1) {
                    byte blue = (byte) ((colorValue >> 16) & 0xFF);
                    byte green = (byte) ((colorValue >> 8) & 0xFF);
                    byte red = (byte) (colorValue & 0xFF);

                    sb.append("RGB: (").append(red).append(",").append(green).append(",").append(blue).append(")\n");
                }
            }
        }

        return sb.toString();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class EventManager
{
    private Dictionary<String, List<Action>> m_listeners = new Dictionary<String, List<Action>>();

    public virtual boolean ConnectionAllowed(String eventName)
    {
        if (m_listeners.containsKey(eventName))
        {
            return true;
        }
        return true;
    }

    // For demonstration purposes, add and remove listeners
    public void AddListener(String eventName, Action listener)
    {
        if (!m_listeners.containsKey(eventName))
        {
            m_listeners[eventName] = new List<Action>();
        }
        m_listeners[eventName].Add(listener);
    }

    public void RemoveListener(String eventName, Action listener)
    {
        if (m_listeners.containsKey(eventName))
        {
            m_listeners[eventName].Remove(listener);
            if (m_listeners[eventName].size() == 0)
            {
                m_listeners.remove(eventName);
            }
        }
    }
}

public class MyEventManager : EventManager
{
    public override boolean ConnectionAllowed(String eventName)
    {
        if (m_listeners.containsKey(eventName))
        {
            return true;
        }
        return true;
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void main()
    {
        MyEventManager em = new MyEventManager();
        System.out.println(em.ConnectionAllowed("TestEvent")); // True
        em.AddListener("TestEvent", () -> System.out.println("TestEvent fired!"));
        System.out.println(em.ConnectionAllowed("TestEvent")); // True

        // Test 1: Connection allowed for existing event
        em.AddListener("ExistingEvent", () -> System.out.println("ExistingEvent fired!"));
        System.out.println(em.ConnectionAllowed("ExistingEvent")); // False

        // Test 2: Connection not allowed for non-existent event
        System.out.println(em.ConnectionAllowed("NonExistentEvent")); // True

        // Test 3: Connection allowed after adding listener to existing event
        em.RemoveListener("TestEvent", () -> System.out.println("TestEvent fired!"));
        System.out.println(em.ConnectionAllowed("TestEvent")); // False

        // Test 4: Connection allowed after removing last listener from existing event
        em.AddListener("TestEvent", () -> System.out.println("TestEvent fired!"));
        System.out.println(em.ConnectionAllowed("TestEvent")); // True

        // Test 5: Connection allowed for new event with no listeners
        MyEventManager em2 = new MyEventManager();
        System.out.println(em2.ConnectionAllowed("NewEvent")); // True
    }
}

public class EventConnectionChecker {
    private bool isAcceptingConnections = true;

    // Returns true if, at this time, the object will accept a connection with respect to the named event
    public bool willAcceptConnection(String eventName) {
        return isAcceptingConnections && "onConnect".Equals(eventName);
    }

    static void Main(string[] args) {
        EventConnectionChecker checker = new EventConnectionChecker();
        String event1 = "onConnect";
        String event2 = "onDisconnect";

        Console.WriteLine("Will accept 'onConnect': " + checker.willAcceptConnection(event1));  // true
        Console.WriteLine("Will accept 'onDisconnect': " + checker.willAcceptConnection(event2));  // false

        // Test 1: Connection allowed for existing event
        Console.WriteLine(checker.willAcceptConnection("ExistingEvent")); // False

        // Test 2: Connection not allowed for non-existent event
        Console.WriteLine(checker.willAcceptConnection("NonExistentEvent")); // False

        // Test 3: Connection allowed after adding listener to existing event
        checker.willAcceptConnection("TestEvent"); // False

        // Test 4: Connection allowed after removing last listener from existing event
        Console.WriteLine(checker.willAcceptConnection("TestEvent")); // False

        // Test 5: Connection allowed for new event with no listeners

using System;

public class AttributeChecker
{
    private String name;
    private const String _STR = ":";
    private const int _NUM = 0;

    public AttributeChecker(String attributeName)
    {
        name = attributeName;
    }

    // it returns true if the attribute is prefixed (used the " : " character).
    public boolean IsPrefixed()
    {
        return name.IndexOf(_STR) >= _NUM;
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        AttributeChecker checker1 = new AttributeChecker("ns:attribute");
        AttributeChecker checker2 = new AttributeChecker("attribute");

        System.out.println(checker1.IsPrefixed()); // true
        System.out.println(checker2.IsPrefixed()); // false
    }
}

public class MainTest {
    @Before
    public void setup() {}

    @Test
    public void testIsPrefixed() {
        AttributeChecker checker = new AttributeChecker("ns:attribute");
        assertTrue(checker.IsPrefixed());
    }

    @Test
    public void testIsNotPrefixed() {
        AttributeChecker checker = new AttributeChecker("attribute");
        assertFalse(checker.IsPrefixed());
    }

    @Test
    public void testEmptyString() {
        AttributeChecker checker = new AttributeChecker("");
        assertTrue(!checker.IsPrefixed());
    }

    @Test
    public void testNullAttribute() {
        AttributeChecker checker = null;
        try {
            checker.IsPrefixed();
            fail("Expected exception");
        } catch (NullPointerException e) {}
        assert(null != checker);
    }
}

public class ConnectionManager {
    // release a non-shard-specific connection.
    public void ReleaseAnyConnection(MySqlConnection connection)
    {
        try
        {
            connection.Close();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Error releasing connection", ex);
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        // For demonstration purposes, change connectionString as needed
        string connectionString = "server=localhost;user id=root;password=yourpassword;database=test;";
        MySqlConnection conn = new MySqlConnection(connectionString);

        ConnectionManager manager = new ConnectionManager();

        try
        {
            conn.Open();
            Console.WriteLine("Connection opened.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Could not open connection: " + ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            manager.ReleaseAnyConnection(conn);
            Console.WriteLine("Connection released.");
        }
    }
}

public class ConnectionManager {
    private Connection connection;

    public ConnectionManager(Connection connection) {
        this.connection = connection;
    }

    // release any connection to be checked.
    public void ReleaseAnyConnection() {
        if (connection != null && !connection.isShardSpecific()) {
            connection.release();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Connection conn = new Connection(false); // non-shard-specific connection
        ConnectionManager manager = new ConnectionManager(conn);
        manager.ReleaseAnyConnection();
    }
}

class Connection {
    private boolean shardSpecific;

    public Connection(boolean shardSpecific) {
        this.shardSpecific = shardSpecific;
    }

    public boolean isShardSpecific() {
        return shardSpecific;
    }

    public void release() {
        System.out.println("Connection released.");
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class Action
{
    public string Name { get; set; }

    public Action(string name)
    {
        Name = name;
    }

    public void Execute()
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Executing {Name}");
    }
}

public class QuickActionView
{
    private bool isShown = false;
    private List<Action> mActions = new List<Action>();

    public void Show()
    {
        isShown = true;
        Console.WriteLine("QuickActionView is shown.");
    }

    private void CheckShown()
    {
        if (isShown)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot add actions when QuickActionView is shown.");
    }

    // adds a collection of actions to the quickactionview
    public QuickActionView AddActions(IEnumerable<Action> actions)
    {
        CheckShown();
        mActions.AddRange(actions);
        return this;
    }

    public void ListActions()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Actions:");
        foreach (var action in mActions)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($"- {action.Name}");
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main()
    {
        QuickActionView qav = new QuickActionView();

        var actions = new List<Action>
        {
            new Action("Action1"),
            new Action("Action2"),
            new Action("Action3")
        };

        qav.AddActions(actions);
        qav.ListActions();

        qav.Show();

        // Uncommenting the line below will throw an exception
        // qav.AddActions(new List<Action> { new Action("Action4") });
    }
}

// Represents an action to be added to the QuickActionView
class Action {

    public Action(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }
}

// Represents an intent or request for quick actions
class Intent {
    private List<Action> actions;

    public Intent() {
        actions = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public void addAction(Action action) {
        actions.add(action);
    }

    public List<Action> getActions() {
        return actions;
    }
}

// Represents a view that displays a collection of actions
class QuickActionView {
    private List<Action> actions = new ArrayList<>();

    public void addActionsToIntent(Intent intent) {
        actions.addAll(intent.getActions());
    }

    public void displayActions() {
        System.out.println("QuickActionView contains the following actions:");
        for (Action action : actions) {
            System.out.println("- " + action.getName());
        }
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        // Create some actions
        Action action1 = new Action("Edit");
        Action action2 = new Action("Delete");
        Action action3 = new Action("Share");

        // Create an intent and add actions to it
        Intent intent = new Intent();
        intent.addAction(action1);
        intent.addAction(action2);
        intent.addAction(action3);

        // Create a QuickActionView and add the actions from the intent
        QuickActionView quickActionView = new QuickActionView();
        quickActionView.addActionsToIntent(intent);

        // Display the actions in the QuickActionView
        quickActionView.displayActions();

        var actions2 = new List<Action>();
        var action4 = new Action("New Action");
        var actions3 = new List<Action>()
        {
            new Action("Another Action")
        };
        actions2.AddRange(actions);
        actions2.AddRange(actions3);
        intent.addAction(action4);

        quickActionView.addActionsToIntent(intent);
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

interface CopyListener
{
    // Should return true if the operation should be stopped
    boolean OnBytesCopied(int current, int total);
}

public class ProgressCopyListener implements CopyListener
{
    public boolean OnBytesCopied(int current, int total)
    {
        System.out.println("Copied " + current + "/" + total + " bytes.");
        // For example, returning false allows the copy to continue
        // Could add logic to stop copying (e.g., after certain amount)
        return true;
    }
}

public class StreamCopier
{
    private static final int BUFFER_SIZE = 128;
    public static boolean CopyStream(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream, CopyListener listener, int bufferSize) throws IOException {
        int current = 0;
        int total = (int)inputStream.available();
        if (total <= 0) {
            total = BUFFER_SIZE;
        }
        byte[] bytes = new byte[BUFFER_SIZE];
        int count;
        if (ShouldStopLoading(listener, current, total)) return false;
        while ((count = inputStream.read(bytes, 0, BUFFER_SIZE)) != -1) {
            outputStream.write(bytes, 0, count);
            current += count;
            if (ShouldStopLoading(listener, current, total)) return false;
        }
        outputStream.flush();
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean ShouldStopLoading(CopyListener listener, int current, int total)
    {
        if (listener != null) {
            return listener.OnBytesCopied(current, total);
        }
        return false;
    }
}

public class Main
{
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        byte[] sourceData = new byte[1024];
        for (int i = 0; i < sourceData.length; i++)
            sourceData[i] = (byte)(i % 256);

        InputStream input = new FileInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(sourceData));
        OutputStream output = new FileOutputStream(new ByteArrayOutputStream());

        CopyListener listener = new ProgressCopyListener();
        boolean result = StreamCopier.CopyStream(input, output, listener, 128);
        System.out.println("Copy result: " + result);
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

interface ProgressListener
{
    /**
     * Called when progress occurs.
     * @param bytesCopied Number of bytes copied so far.
     * @return true if copying should continue, false to interrupt.
     */
    boolean onProgress(long bytesCopied);
}

class InterruptibleStreamCopier 
{
    public static long copy(InputStream in, OutputStream out, ProgressListener listener) throws IOException
    {
        byte[] buffer = new byte[4096];
        long totalCopied = 0;
        int read;
        while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1)
        {
            out.write(buffer, 0, read);
            totalCopied += read;
            if (listener != null && !listener.onProgress(totalCopied))
            {
                break; // Interrupted by listener
            }
        }
        out.flush();
        return totalCopied;
    }
}

class ExampleProgressListener implements ProgressListener 
{
    private final long interruptAfterBytes;
    public ExampleProgressListener(long interruptAfterBytes) 
    {
        this.interruptAfterBytes = interruptAfterBytes;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onProgress(long bytesCopied)
    {
        System.out.println("Copied: " + bytesCopied + " bytes");
        return bytesCopied < interruptAfterBytes;
    }
}

public class Main 
{
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException
    {
        byte[] sampleData = new byte[10000];
        new Random().nextBytes(sampleData);

        ByteArrayInputStream inStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(sampleData);
        ByteArrayOutputStream outStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

        long interruptAfter = 5000; // Interrupt after 5000 bytes
        ProgressListener listener = new ExampleProgressListener(interruptAfter);

        long bytesCopied = InterruptibleStreamCopier.copy(inStream, outStream, listener);

        System.out.println("Copy operation interrupted or completed. Bytes copied: " + bytesCopied);
    }
}

import java.util.*;

public class Data
{
    private float[] yValues;

    public Data(float[] values)
    {
        yValues = values;
    }

    public float GetYValueSum()
    {
        float sum = 0;
        for (var v in yValues)
        {
            sum += v;
        }
        return sum;
    }
}

public class AngleCalculator
{
    private const float _NUM = 360f;
    private Data mData;

    public AngleCalculator(Data data)
    {
        mData = data;
    }

    // calculates the needed angle for a given value
    private float CalcAngle(float value)
    {
        return value / mData.GetYValueSum() * _NUM;
    }

    public void RunExample(float value)
    {
        float angle = CalcAngle(value);
        System.out.println($"Angle for value {value} is: {angle}");
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void main(string[] args)
    {
        float[] values = { 10, 20, 30, 40 };
        Data data = new Data(values);
        AngleCalculator calculator = new AngleCalculator(data);

        float value = 20;
        calculator.RunExample(value);
    }
}

public class UnitTest {

   public static void runUnitTests() {
       // Test cases:
       // 1. Single-element array
       float[] values1 = {10};
       Data data1 = new Data(values1);
       AngleCalculator calculator1 = new AngleCalculator(data1);
       float value1 = 5;
       int expectedAngle1 = 90;

       // Run example method with a single element in the input array:
       calculator1.RunExample(value1);

       assertEquals(expectedAngle1, value1/ data1.GetYValueSum()*360,0.01f);

       // Test case 2: Multi-element array
       float[] values2 = {10, 20, 30, 40};
       Data data2 = new Data(values2);
       AngleCalculator calculator2 = new AngleCalculator(data2);
       float value2 = 25;
       int expectedAngle2 = 125;

       // Run example method with a single element in the input array:
       calculator2.RunExample(value2);

       assertEquals(expectedAngle2, value2/ data2.GetYValueSum()*360,0.01f);

       // Test case 3: Negative values
       float[] values3 = {10, -20, 30, -40};
       Data data3 = new Data(values3);
       AngleCalculator calculator3 = new AngleCalculator(data3);
       float value3 = -15;
       int expectedAngle3 = 67;

       // Run example method with a single element in the input array:
       calculator3.RunExample(value3);

       assertEquals(expectedAngle3, value3/ data3.GetYValueSum()*360,0.01f);

       // Test case 4: Zero value
       float[] values4 = {10, -20, 30, -40};
       Data data4 = new Data(values4);
       AngleCalculator calculator4 = new AngleCalculator(data4);
       float value4 = 0;
       int expectedAngle4 = 180;

       // Run example method with a single element in the input array:
       calculator4.RunExample(value4);

       assertEquals(expectedAngle4, value4/ data4.GetYValueSum()*360,0.01f);

       // Test case 5: Edge case
       float[] values5 = {10};
       Data data5 = new Data(values5);
       AngleCalculator calculator5 = new AngleCalculator(data5);
       float value5 = 40;
       int expectedAngle5 = 200;

       // Run example method with a single element in the input array:
       calculator5.RunExample(value5);

       assertEquals(expectedAngle5, value5/ data5.GetYValueSum()*360,0.01f);
   }

   public static void assertEquals(float actual, float expected, double delta) {
       if (Math.abs(actual - expected) > delta) {
           throw new RuntimeException("Test failed: " + actual + " does not match the expected value of " + expected);
       }
   }
}

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        runUnitTests();
    }

import java.util.LinkedList;
import java.util.Queue;

public class BufferPool {
    private final int maxSize;
    private final Queue<Buffer> pool;

    public BufferPool(int maxSize) {
        this.maxSize = maxSize;
        this.pool = new LinkedList<>();
    }

    public synchronized void returnBuffer(Buffer buffer) {
        // If the pool is already at maximum capacity, remove the oldest buffer
        if (pool.size() >= maxSize) {
            pool.poll(); // throw away oldest buffer
        }
        pool.offer(buffer);
    }

    public synchronized Buffer getBuffer() {
        Buffer buffer = pool.poll();
        return buffer != null ? buffer : new Buffer();
    }

    // Simple Buffer class as placeholder
    public static class Buffer {
        // Add buffer properties/methods if needed
    }

    public void printStatus() {
        System.out.println("Current Size: " + pool.size() + ", Buffers Count: " + pool.size());
    }
}

class UnitTest {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BufferPool pool = new BufferPool(100);

        // Test: add some buffers
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(new byte[20]);
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(new byte[30]);
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(new byte[15]);
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(new byte[50]); 
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(null);         // Should be ignored
        bufferPool.returnBuffer(new byte[200]); // Too big, should be ignored

        pool.printStatus();
    }
}

        javaPool.ReturnBuf(new byte[15]);

        Buffer b1 = new Buffer();
        Buffer b2 = new Buffer();
        Buffer b3 = new Buffer();

        csharpPool.returnBuffer(b1);
        csharpPool.returnBuffer(b2);
        // At this point, pool is full. Adding another will remove the oldest.
        csharpPool.returnBuffer(b3);

        System.out.WriteLine("Buffer returned! Current pool size: " + csharpPool.pool.size());

        Buffer b = csharpPool.getBuffer();

    }

        BufferPool csharpPool = new BufferPool(2);

        Buffer b1 = new Buffer();
        Buffer b2 = new Buffer();
        Buffer b3 = new Buffer();

        csharpPool.returnBuffer(b1);
        csharpPool.returnBuffer(b2);
        // At this point, pool is full. Adding another will remove the oldest.
        csharpPool.returnBuffer(b3);

        System.out.WriteLine("Buffer returned! Current pool size: " + csharpPool.pool.size());

        Buffer b = csharpPool.getBuffer();
        System.out.println("Got buffer from pool: " + b);
    }
}

public class Test {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BufferPool javaPool = new BufferPool(100);

        // Test: add some buffers
        javaPool.ReturnBuf(new byte[20]);
        javaPool_ReturnBuf(new byte[30]);
        javaPool_ReturnBuf(new byte[15]);
        javaPool_ReturnBuf(new byte[50]); 
        javaPool_ReturnBuf(null);         // Should be ignored
        javaPool_ReturnBuf(new byte[200]); // Too big, should be ignored

        javaPool.PrintStatus();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public abstract class AbstractOptionValue<TKey, TValue>
{
    public TKey Key { get; set; }
    public TValue Value { get; set; }
}

public abstract class AbstractOptions
{
    public virtual IDictionary<object, object> ValueMap { get; set; }

    public AbstractOptions()
    {
        ValueMap = new Dictionary<object, object>();
    }
}

public abstract class AbstractOptions<T> : AbstractOptions where T : AbstractOptionValue<object, object>
{
    protected void PutAll(Func<T, T> valueFilter, List<T> values)
    {
        foreach (var val in values)
        {
            var filtered = valueFilter(val);
            ValueMap[filtered.Key] = filtered.Value;
        }
    }

    protected AbstractOptions<T> CreateNewInstance(Func<T, T> valueFilter, AbstractOptions baseOptions, IEnumerable<T> values)
    {
        if (baseOptions == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(baseOptions));
        if (valueFilter == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(valueFilter));
        if (values == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(values));
        var valueMap = new Dictionary<T, T>();
        foreach (DictionaryEntry de in baseOptions.ValueMap)
        {
            try
            {
                T key = (T)de.Key;
                T value = (T)de.Value;
                valueMap[key] = value;
            }
            catch
            {
                // for demonstration only
            }
        }
        PutAll(valueFilter, values.ToList());
        return this;
    }
}

class MyOptionValue : AbstractOptionValue<object, object>
{
    public MyOptionValue(object key, object value)
    {
        Key = key;
        Value = value;
    }
}

class MyOptions : AbstractOptions<MyOptionValue>
{
}

public class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        var baseOptions = new MyOptions();
        baseOptions.ValueMap["existing"] = "value";

        List<MyOptionValue> values = Arrays.asList(
            new MyOptionValue("a", 1),
            new MyOptionValue("b", 2)
        );

        Func<MyOptionValue, MyOptionValue> filter = v -> new MyOptionValue(v.Key, v.Value);

        var myOptions = new MyOptions();
        myOptions.CreateNewInstance(filter, baseOptions, values);

        System.out.println("Values in myOptions.ValueMap:");
        for (int i = 0; i < myOptions.ValueMap.size(); i++) {
            System.out.println(myOptions.ValueMap.keySet().iterator().next() + ": " + myOptions.ValueMap.get(myOptions.ValueMap.keySet().iterator().next()));
        }
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // creates a new instance.
        MyClass obj = new MyClass();
        System.out.println("A new instance of MyClass has been created: " + obj);
    }
}

// Utility class for testing
class Arrays {
    public static List<Object>.asList(Object... array) {
        List<Object> list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Object o : array) {
            list.add(o);
        }
        return list;
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class CharSeq {
    private List<String> str;

    public CharSeq(String s) {
        str = new ArrayList<>(List.of(s));
    }

    // append string of the given charseq to this charseq
    public CharSeq Concat(CharSeq another) {
        str.add(another.str);
        return this;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return str.toString();
    }
}

class Main {

    static void main(String[] args) {
        CharSeq cs1 = new CharSeq("Hello, ");
        CharSeq cs2 = new CharSeq("world!");
        CharSeq cs3 = cs1.Concat(cs2);
        System.out.println(cs3); // Output: Hello, world!
    }
}

public class CharSeqAppender {
    private StringBuilder charseq;

    public CharSeqAppender(String initial) {
        this.charseq = new StringBuilder(initial);
    }

    // append string of the given charseq to this charseq
    public CharSequence appendAndReturn(String toAppend) {
        charseq.append(toAppend);
        return charseq;
    }
}

class Main {

    static void main(String[] args) {
        CharSeqAppender appender = new CharSeqAppender("Hello, ");
        CharSequence result = appender.appendAndReturn("World!");
        System.out.println(result); // Output: Hello, World!
    }
}

        // Test case 1
        CharSeq cs1 = new CharSeq("Hello");

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

// Mock HttpRequest class
class HttpRequest {
    // Add properties/methods as needed
}

// Mock HttpResponse class
class HttpResponse {
    public String ContentType { get; set; }
    public java.io.OutputStream OutputStream { get; }

    private java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream _memoryStream;

    public HttpResponse()
    {
        _memoryStream = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        OutputStream = _memoryStream;
    }

    public void WriteToConsole()
    {
        OutputStream.seek(0, java.io.FileChannel SeekOption.Begin);
        using (var reader = new java.io.BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(OutputStream)))
        {
            Console.WriteLine(reader.readLine());
        }
    }
}

// Video class with GetName and GetUrl methods
class Video {
    private String name;
    private String url;

    public Video(String name, String url)
    {
        this.name = name;
        this.url = url;
    }

    public String GetName() => name;
    public String GetUrl() => url;
}

// Servlet-like class
class VideoServlet {
    protected const string _STR = "\n";

    protected List<Video> videos;

    public VideoServlet(List<Video> videos)
    {
        this.videos = videos;
    }

    // Simulate HTTP GET handler
    protected virtual void DoGet(HttpRequest req, HttpResponse resp)
    {
        resp.ContentType = _STR;
        using (var sendToClient = new java.io.PrintWriter(resp.OutputStream))
        {
            foreach (var v in this.videos)
            {
                sendToClient.Write(v.GetName() + _STR + v.GetUrl() + _STR);
            }
        }
    }

    // For demonstration purposes
    public void HandleGet(HttpRequest req, HttpResponse resp)
    {
        DoGet(req, resp);
    }
}

class Program {
    static void Main()
    {
        // Prepare a sample list of videos
        var videos = new List<Video>
        {
            new Video("Intro to C#", "http://example.com/video1"),
            new Video("Advanced C#", "http://example.com/video2"),
            new Video("LINQ Tutorial", "http://example.com/video3")
        };

        var servlet = new VideoServlet(videos);
        var req = new HttpRequest();
        var resp = new HttpResponse();

        servlet.HandleGet(req, resp);

        resp.WriteToConsole();
    }
}

public class UnitTests {
    public static void Main()
    {
        // Test 1
        var video1 = new Video("Test Video", "http://example.com/testvideo");
        var video2 = new Video("Another Test Video", "http://example.com/anothertestvideo");
        var servlet = new VideoServlet(new List<Video> { video1, video2 });
        var req = new HttpRequest();
        var resp = new HttpResponse();

        servlet.HandleGet(req, resp);

        Assert.AreEqual(2, resp.GetType().GetProperty("ContentLength").GetValue(null).ToString());
        Assert.AreEqual("text/plain", resp.ContentType);
        // Assert.AreEqual("Test Video http://example.com/testvideo\nAnother Test Video http://example.com/anothertestvideo\n", resp.OutputStream.ToString());

        // Test 2

        servlet.videos.Add(video3);
        req = new HttpRequest();

        servlet.HandleGet(req, resp);

        Assert.AreEqual(3, resp.GetType().GetProperty("ContentLength").GetValue(null).ToString());
        Assert.AreEqual("text/plain", resp.ContentType);
        // Assert.AreEqual("Test Video 3 http://example.com/testvideo3\nTest Video http://example.com/testvideo\nAnother Test Video http://example.com/anothertestvideo\n", resp.OutputStream.ToString());

        // Test 3
        var servlet2 = new VideoServlet(new List<Video>());
        req = new HttpRequest();
        resp = new HttpResponse();

        servlet2.HandleGet(req, resp);

        Assert.AreEqual(0, resp.GetType().GetProperty("ContentLength").GetValue(null).ToString());
        Assert.AreEqual("text/plain", resp.ContentType);
        // Assert.AreEqual("", resp.OutputStream.ToString());

        // Test 4
        req = new HttpRequest();
        resp = new HttpResponse();

        servlet2.HandleGet(req, resp);

        Assert.AreEqual(0, resp.GetType().GetProperty("ContentLength").GetValue(null).ToString());
        Assert.AreEqual("text/plain", resp.ContentType);
        // Assert.AreEqual("", resp.OutputStream.ToString());

        // Test 5
        var video4 = new Video("Test Video 4", "http://example.com/testvideo4");
        servlet.videos.Add(video4);
        req = new HttpRequest();
        resp = new HttpResponse();

        servlet.HandleGet(req, resp);

        Assert.AreEqual(1, resp.GetType().GetProperty("ContentLength").GetValue(null).ToString());
        Assert.AreEqual("text/plain", resp.ContentType);
        // Assert.AreEqual("Test Video 4 http://example.com/testvideo4\n", resp.OutputStream.ToString());

        Console.WriteLine("Java code passed " + (TestCount - Failed) + "/" + TestCount + " tests");
        Console.WriteLine("C# code passed " + (TestCount - Failed) + "/" + TestCount + " tests");
    }

    static int TestCount = 5;
    static int Failed = 0;

    public static void Assert.AreEqual(String expected, Object actual)
    {
        if (!expected.Equals(actual))
            Failed++;
    }

using System;

public class StateNotifier {
    private int mState;
    private const String _STR = "State";

    // Event to notify listeners of a property change
    public event Action<String, Integer, Integer> PropertyChanged;

    // Protected method to notify state change
    protected void NotifyStateChange(int oldState, int newState) {
        mState = newState;
        if (oldState != newState) {
            FirePropertyChange(_STR, oldState, newState);
        }
    }

    // Method to simulate firing property change notification
    protected void FirePropertyChange(String propertyName, Integer oldValue, Integer newValue) {
        PropertyChanged?.Invoke(propertyName, oldValue, newValue);
    }

    // Public method to set state for demonstration
    public void SetState(int newState) {
        int oldState = mState;
        NotifyStateChange(oldState, newState);
    }
}

class UnitTest {
    private StateNotifier notifier;

    @Before
    public void setup() {
        notifier = new StateNotifier();
    }

    @Test
    public void testSetState_InitializesNotifierCorrectly() {
        notifier.SetState(1);
        assertEquals(notifier.mState, 1);
    }

    @Test
    public void testSetState_ChangesState Correctly() {
        notifier.SetState(1);
        notifier.SetState(2);
        assertEquals(notifier.mState, 2);
    }

    @Test
    public void testSetState_NoChangeNotificationIfSameValue() {
        notifier.SetState(1);
        notifier.SetState(1);
        assertTrue(!notifier.PropertyChanged.hasListeners());
    }

    @Test
    public void testSetState_NotifiesListnersCorrectly() {
        notifier.PropertyChanged += (property, oldValue, newValue) ->
                assertEquals(property, "State");
        notifier.SetState(2);
        assertTrue(notifier.PropertyChanged.hasListeners());
    }
}

public class Program {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        StateNotifier notifier = new StateNotifier();
        notifier.PropertyChanged += (property, oldValue, newValue) ->
                System.out.println($"{property} changed from {oldValue} to {newValue}");
        notifier.SetState(1);
        notifier.SetState(2);
        notifier.SetState(2); // No output expected since state didn't change
        notifier.SetState(3);
    }
}

C#:
```csharp
public class StateNotifier {
    private string state;
    private StateChangeListener listener;

    public StateNotifier(string initialState) {
        this.state = initialState;
    }

    public void setStateChangeListener(StateChangeListener listener) {
        this.listener = listener;
    }

    // Change the stored state value and notify, but do not change any hardware
    public void changeState(string newState) {
        string oldState = state;
        state = newState;
        if (listener != null) {
            listener.onStateChanged(oldState);
        }
    }
}

class UnitTest {
    private StateNotifier notifier;

    [SetUp]
    public void setup() {
        notifier = new StateNotifier("INITIAL");
    }

    [TestMethod]
    public void testChangeState_InitializesNotifierCorrectly() {
        notifier.changeState("UPDATED");
        Assert.AreEqual(notifier.state, "UPDATED");
    }

    [TestMethod]
    public void testChangeState_ChangesState Correctly() {
        notifier.changeState("UPDATED");
        notifier.changeState("FINAL");
        Assert.AreEqual(notifier.state, "FINAL");
    }

    [TestMethod]
    public void testChangeState_NoChangeNotificationIfSameValue() {
        notifier.changeState("UPDATED");
        notifier.changeState("UPDATED");
        Assert.IsFalse(notifier.listener.onStateChangedCalled);
    }

    [TestMethod]
    public void testChangeState_NotifiesListenerCorrectly() {
        StateChangeListener listener = new StateChangeListener();
        notifier.setStateChangeListener(listener);
        notifier.changeState("FINAL");
        listener.onStateChangedCalled = true;
        Assert.IsTrue(listener.onStateChangedCalled);
    }
}

interface StateChangeListener {
    bool onStateChanged(string newState);
}
```

State changed from 1 to 2
State changed from 2 to 3
SetState(1)
SetState(2)
SetState(2) // No output expected since state didn't change
SetState(3)

import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import org.junit.Test;

public class Ecps
{
    private BigInteger order;

    public Ecps(BigInteger order)
    {
        this.order = order;
    }

    public BigInteger GetOrder()
    {
        return order;
    }
}

class Order {
    private String name;

    public Order(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }
}

interface GetOrder<T> {
    T getOrder();
}

class OnlineOrder implements GetOrder<Order>
{
    private Order order;

    public OnlineOrder(String orderName)
    {
        this.order = new Order(orderName);
    }

    @Override
    public Order getOrder()
    {
        System.out.println("Getting order from OnlineOrder.");
        return order;
    }
}

class StoreOrder implements GetOrder<Order>
{
    private Order order;

    public StoreOrder(String orderName)
    {
        this.order = new Order(orderName);
    }

    @Override
    public Order getOrder()
    {
        System.out.println("Getting order from StoreOrder.");
        return order;
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<GetOrder<Order>> orders = Arrays.asList(
            new OnlineOrder("Laptop"),
            new StoreOrder("Phone")
        );

        for (GetOrder<Order> getOrderObj : orders) {
            Order o = getOrderObj.getOrder();
            System.out.println("Order name: " + o.getName());
        }
    }
}

java
public enum LoggingLevel
{
    Trace = 0,
    Debug = 1,
    Info = 2,
    Warning = 3,
    Error = 4,
    Critical = 5
}

public struct Color
{
    public string Name;
    public Color(string name)
    {
        Name = name;
    }
}

public static class PhotonLogger
{
    public static LoggingLevel Level = LoggingLevel.Info;
}

public static class LoggingService
{
    public static void LogThrowable(DateTime dateTime, Exception throwable, String formatted, Color color)
    {
        System.out.println($"[{dateTime:HH:mm:ss}] [{color.Name}] {formatted}");
        System.out.println("Exception: " + throwable);
    }
}

public class Logger
{
    private static boolean USE_COLORS = true;

    public void FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel level, Color color, String msg, Exception throwable)
    {
        if (!USE_COLORS)
        {
            FormatAndLogThrowable(level, msg, throwable);
            return;
        }
        if ((int)PhotonLogger.Level < (int)level)
        {
            return;
        }
        DateTime dateTime = DateTime.Now;
        String formatted = FormatLogLine(level, dateTime, msg);
        LoggingService.LogThrowable(dateTime, throwable, formatted, color);
    }

    private void FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel level, String msg, Exception throwable)
    {
        DateTime dateTime = DateTime.Now;
        String formatted = FormatLogLine(level, dateTime, msg);
        LoggingService.LogThrowable(dateTime, throwable, formatted, new Color("None"));
    }

    private String FormatLogLine(LoggingLevel level, DateTime dateTime, String msg)
    {
        return "[ " + level + "] " + msg;
    }
}

class Program
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Logger logger = new Logger();
        try
        {
            throw new Exception("Sample exception for logging.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            logger.FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel.Error, new Color("Red"), "An error occurred", ex);
        }

        System.out.println("Testing 1: Valid Logging");
        DateTime dateTime = DateTime.Now;
        String message = "[Trace] An error occurred";
        Exception ex = new Exception();
        logger.FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel.Trace, null, message, ex);

        System.out.println("Testing 2: Invalid Logging");
        dateTime = DateTime.Now;
        message = "[Info] An error occurred";
        ex = new Exception();
        logger.FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel.Debug, null, message, ex);
        
        System.out.println("Testing 3: No Colors");
        dateTime = DateTime.Now;
        String noColorMessage = "[Trace] An error occurred";
        ex = new Exception();
        logger.FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel.Trace, null, noColorMessage, ex);

        System.out.println("Testing 4: Valid Logging with Messages");
        dateTime = DateTime.Now;
        message = "[Info] An error occurred";
        String formattedMessage = "An error occurred.";
        logger.FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel.Info, new Color("Blue"), formattedMessage, ex);
        
        System.out.println("Testing 5: Invalid Exception");
       dateTime =DateTime.Now; 
        message = "[Error] An error occurred";
        ex=null;
        logger.FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel.Error, new Color("Red"), message, ex);

        System.out.println("Testing 6: Same Level");
        dateTime = DateTime.Now;
        String sameLevelMessage = "An error occurred.";
        logger.FormatAndLogThrowable(LoggingLevel.Info, new Color("Green"), sameLevelMessage, ex);
    }
}

C#
public class LogFormatter {

    private static readonly Logger LOGGER = Logger.getLogger(LogFormatter.class);

    public static void logFormattedMessage(Level level, string message, Object[] args, Exception throwable) {
        string formattedMessage = string.Format(message, args);
        if (throwable != null) {
            LOGGER.log(level, formattedMessage, throwable);
        } else {
            LOGGER.log(level, formattedMessage);
        }
    }

}
