```java
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public enum PinLaterJobState
{
    Pending = 0,
    InProgress = 1,
    Completed = 2
}

public static class PinLaterJobStateExtensions
{
    public static int GetValue(this PinLaterJobState state)
    {
        return (int)state;
    }
}

public class Program
{
    private const string PINLATER_QUEUE_KEY_PREFIX = "PinLaterQueue";

    public static string ConstructQueueRedisKey(string queueName, string shardName, int priority, PinLaterJobState state)
    {
        return string.Format("{0}:{1}:{2}:{3}:{4}", PINLATER_QUEUE_KEY_PREFIX, shardName, queueName, priority, state.GetValue());
    }

    public class UnitTest
    {
        [Fact]
        public void TestConstructQueueRedisKey_PendingState_ReturnsCorrectRedisKey()
        {
            string queueName = "email";
            string shardName = "shard1";
            int priority = 10;
            PinLaterJobState state = PinLaterJobState.Pending;

            string redisKey = ConstructQueueRedisKey(queueName, shardName, priority, state);

            Assert.Equal("PinLaterQueue:shard1:email:10:0", redisKey);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestConstructQueueRedisKey_InProgressState_ReturnsCorrectRedisKey()
        {
            string queueName = "email";
            string shardName = "shard1";
            int priority = 10;
            PinLaterJobState state = PinLaterJobState.InProgress;

            string redisKey = ConstructQueueRedisKey(queueName, shardName, priority, state);

            Assert.Equal("PinLaterQueue:shard1:email:10:1", redisKey);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestConstructQueueRedisKey_CompletedState_ReturnsCorrectRedisKey()
        {
            string queueName = "email";
            string shardName = "shard1";
            int priority = 10;
            PinLaterJobState state = PinLaterJobState.Completed;

            string redisKey = ConstructQueueRedisKey(queueName, shardName, priority, state);

            Assert.Equal("PinLaterQueue:shard1:email:10:2", redisKey);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TestConstructQueueRedisKey_InvalidState_ReturnsCorrectRedisKey()
        {
            string queueName = "email";
            string shardName = "shard1";
            int priority = 10;
            PinLaterJobState state = (PinLaterJobState)100;

            string redisKey = ConstructQueueRedisKey(queueName, shardName, priority, state);

            Assert.Equal("PinLaterQueue:shard1:email:10:0", redisKey);
        }

        public static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            RunUnitTests();
        }

        private static void RunUnitTests()
        {
            Console.WriteLine("\nRunning unit tests for ConstructQueueRedisKey function...");

            int totalPassed = 0;
            int totalTested = 0;

            List<object[]> testCases = new List<object[]>
            {
                new object[] { "email", "shard1", 10, PinLaterJobState.Pending },
                new object[] { "email", "shard1", 10, PinLaterJobState.InProgress },
                new object[] { "email", "shard1", 10, PinLaterJobState.Completed },
                new object[] { "email", "shard1", 10, (PinLaterJobState)100 },
            };

            foreach (object[] testCase in testCases)
            {
                totalTested++;
                string queueName = (string)testCase[0];
                string shardName = (string)testCase[1];
                int priority = (int)testCase[2];
                PinLaterJobState state = (PinLaterJobState)testCase[3];

                try
                {
                    string redisKey = Program.ConstructQueueRedisKey(queueName, shardName, priority, state);

                    if (redisKey == string.Format("PinLaterQueue:{0}:{1}:{2}:{3}:0", shardName, queueName, priority, state.GetValue()))
                    {
                        totalPassed++;
                        Console.WriteLine($"Test case passed: ConstructQueueRedisKey({queueName},{shardName},{priority},{state})");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Console.WriteLine($"Test case failed: ConstructQueueRedisKey({queueName},{shardName},{priority},{state})");
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"Error occurred in test case: ConstructQueueRedisKey({queueName},{shardName},{priority},{state}). Error message: {e.Message}");
                }
            }

            double passPercentage = (double)totalPassed / totalTested * 100;
            Console.WriteLine($"\nUnit tests completed. Pass percentage: {passPercentage}%");
        }
    }
}
```

public class UnitTests {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println("Running tests for DecodeCharset function in Java");
        String original = "Héllo Wørld!";
        String charset = "UTF-8";
        if (DecodeCharset(original, charset) == null)
            System.out.println("Test 1: DecodeCharset(null, \"UTF-8\") should return null.");
        else
            System.out.println("Test 1: DecodeCharset(null, \"UTF-8\") returned " + DecodeCharset(original, charset));
        
        original = "";
        charset = "UTF-8";
        if (DecodeCharset(original, charset) == null)
            System.out.println("Test 2: DecodeCharset(\"\", \"UTF-8\") should return null.");
        else
            System.out.println("Test 2: DecodeCharset(\"\", \"UTF-8\") returned " + DecodeCharset(original, charset));
        
        original = "Hello World!";
        charset = "ISO-8859-1";
        if (DecodeCharset(original, charset) != "Hello World!")
            System.out.println("Test 3: DecodeCharset(\"Hello World!\", \"ISO-8859-1\") should return \"Hello World!\".");
        else
            System.out.println("Test 3: DecodeCharset(\"Hello World!\", \"ISO-8859-1\") returned " + DecodeCharset(original, charset));
        
        original = "Héllo Wørld!";
        charset = "UTF-8";
        if (DecodeCharset(original, charset) != "Héllo Wørld!")
            System.out.println("Test 4: DecodeCharset(\"Héllo Wørld!\", \"UTF-8\") should return \"Héllo Wørld!\".");
        else
            System.out.println("Test 4: DecodeCharset(\"Héllo Wørld!\", \"UTF-8\") returned " + DecodeCharset(original, charset));
        
        original = "Héllo Wörld!";
        charset = "ISO-8859-1";
        if (DecodeCharset(original, charset) != "Hëllo Wørld!")
            System.out.println("Test 5: DecodeCharset(\"Hëllo Wörld!\", \"ISO-8859-1\") should return \"Hëllo Wørld!\".");
        else
            System.out.println("Test 5: DecodeCharset(\"Hëllo Wörld!\", \"ISO-8859-1\") returned " + DecodeCharset(original, charset));
    }

    public static String DecodeCharset(String s, String charset) {
        if (s == null)
            return null;
        try
        {
            byte[] buf = System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(s);
            return System.Text.Encoding.GetEncoding(charset).GetString(buf);
        }
        catch (System.Text.DecoderFallbackException)
        {
            return s;
        }
    }

}

    public static String decodeCharset(String str, String sourceCharset, String targetCharset) {
        try {
            byte[] bytes = str.getBytes(sourceCharset);
            return new String(bytes, Charset.forName(targetCharset));
        } catch (Exception e)
        {
            System.out.println(e);
            return null;
        }
    }

```java
    public void testAddRestrictedDomain_AddsDomain_PrintsCorrectly() {

        manager.PrintRestrictedDomains();
        assertEquals("Restricted Domains:\nexample.com", System.out.readLine().trim());
    }

    @Test
    public void testAddMultipleRestrictedDomains_AddsToPrintCorrectly() {
        RestrictedDomainManager manager = new RestrictedDomainManager();
        manager.AddRestrictedDomain("example.com");
        manager.AddRestrictedDomain("");
        manager.AddRestrictedDomain(null);
        manager.PrintRestrictedDomains();
        assertEquals("Restricted Domains:\nexample.com\n", System.out.readLine().trim());
    }
```

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class DomainManager {
    private List<String> restrictedDomains;

    public DomainManager() {
        restrictedDomains = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    /**
     * Adds specified domain name to the list of restricted domains
     */
    public void addDomain(String domain) {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(domain))
            return;
        restrictedDomains.Add(domain);
    }

    public List<String> getRestrictedDomains() {
        return restrictedDomains;
    }
}

public class RestrictedDomainManagerTest {
    [STAThread]
    static void Main()
    {
        DomainManager manager = new DomainManager();

        // Example: adds a domain name to the list of domain.
        manager.addDomain("example.com");
        manager.addDomain("testsite.org");

        Console.WriteLine("Restricted Domains: " + manager.getRestrictedDomains());
    }
}

import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;

public class ReadWriteLock {
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock readLockObj = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public Lock ReadLock() {
        // Return a Lock object representing the read lock.
        return readLockObj.readLock();
    }
}

class CancelCriterion {
    // Placeholder for some condition to cancel the lock.
    public boolean CancelRequested { get; set; }
}

public class StoppableReadLock {
    private final Lock lockObj;
    private final CancelCriterion stopper;

    // create a new read lock from the given lock
    public StoppableReadLock(CancelCriterion stopper)
    {
        this.lockObj = ReadWriteLock().ReadLock();
        this.stopper = stopper;
    }

    public void Acquire()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Acquiring read lock...");
        // Simulate lock acquisition (for demo purposes)
        if (stopper.CancelRequested)
            throw new OperationCanceledException("Lock acquisition cancelled.");
        // Lock acquired (nothing to do, since it's a dummy implementation)
        Console.WriteLine("Read lock acquired.");
    }

    public void Release()
    {
        // Simulate lock release
        Console.WriteLine("Read lock released.");
    }
}

class Program {
    static void Main()
    {
        var stoppableReadLock = new StoppableReadLock(new CancelCriterion { CancelRequested = false });

        try
        {
            stoppableReadLock.Acquire();
            // Simulate doing some work while holding the lock.
            Console.WriteLine("Doing work in read lock...");
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine(ex.Message);
        }
        finally
        {
            stoppableReadLock.Release();
        }
    }
}

```java
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace InterfaceHashExample
{
    // Utilities, mimicking Java's reflection/descriptors as best as possible in C#
    public static class Util
    {
        public static string MethodDescriptorOf(MethodDoc doc)
        {
            // Very simplified: just return parameter types, separated
            return string.Join(",", doc.ParameterTypes);
        }

        public static string BinaryNameOf(Type ex)
        {
            // Mimic internal naming convention for Java class names: dots
            return ex.FullName.Replace('+', '.');
        }
    }

    // Comparator for sorting exceptions by class name
    public class ClassDocComparator : IComparer<Type>
    {
        public int Compare(Type a, Type b)
        {
            return string.Compare(a.FullName, b.FullName, StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }
    }

    // Represents documentation of a remote method, simple version
    public class MethodDoc
    {
        public string MethodName { get; }
        public string[] ParameterTypes { get; }
        public Type[] ExceptionTypes { get; }

        public MethodDoc(string methodName, string[] parameterTypes, Type[] exceptionTypes)
        {
            MethodName = methodName;
            ParameterTypes = parameterTypes;
            ExceptionTypes = exceptionTypes;
        }

        public string Name() => MethodName;
        public Type[] ThrownExceptions() => ExceptionTypes;
    }

    // Represents a remote method
    public class RemoteMethod
    {
        private readonly MethodDoc _doc;
        public RemoteMethod(MethodDoc doc) { _doc = doc; }
        public MethodDoc MethodDoc() => _doc;
    }

    class Program
    {
        const int INTERFACE_HASH_STUB_VERSION = 1;
        // For demo, these stand in for _NUM and _STR
        const int _NUM = 0;
        const string _STR = "SHA1";
        List<RemoteMethod> remoteMethods;

        public Program()
        {
            // Setup example remote methods
            remoteMethods = new List<RemoteMethod>
            {
                new RemoteMethod(
                    new MethodDoc(
                        "MethodA",
                        new string[] { "int", "string" },
                        new Type[] { typeof(IOException), typeof(InvalidOperationException) }
                    )
                ),
                new RemoteMethod(
                    new MethodDoc(
                        "MethodB",
                        new string[] { },
                        new Type[] { typeof(IOException) }
                    )
                ),
            };
        }

        private long ComputeInterfaceHash()
        {
            long hash = _NUM;
            using (var sink = new MemoryStream())
            {
                try
                {
                    // Replaces Java's MessageDigest "SHA" with C#'s SHA1
                    using (var md = SHA1.Create())
                    using (var outStream = new CryptoStream(sink, md, CryptoStreamMode.Write))
                    using (var writer = new BinaryWriter(outStream))
                    {
                        writer.Write(INTERFACE_HASH_STUB_VERSION);

                        foreach (var method in remoteMethods)
                        {
                            var methodDoc = method.MethodDoc();
                            WriteUTF(writer, methodDoc.Name());
                            WriteUTF(writer, Util.MethodDescriptorOf(methodDoc));
                            var exceptions = methodDoc.ThrownExceptions();
                            Array.Sort(exceptions, new ClassDocComparator());
                            foreach (var ex in exceptions)
                            {
                                WriteUTF(writer, Util.BinaryNameOf(ex));
                            }
                        }
                        writer.Flush();
                        outStream.FlushFinalBlock();

                        var hashArray = md.Hash;

                        // Take up to first 8 bytes (64 bits) for the hash value
                        for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(8, hashArray.Length); i++)
                        {
                            hash += ((long)(hashArray[i] & 0xFF)) << (i * 8);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (IOException e)
                {
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Unable to compute hash", e);
                }
            }
            return hash;
        }

        // Java's DataOutput.writeUTF
        public static void WriteUTF(BinaryWriter writer, string s)
        {
            if (s == null)
                writer.Write((ushort)0);
            else
            {
                var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(s);
                if (bytes.Length > ushort.MaxValue)
                    throw new IOException("String too long!");
                writer.Write((ushort)bytes.Length);
                writer.Write(bytes);
            }
        }

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            var p = new Program();
            long hash = p.ComputeInterfaceHash();
            Console.WriteLine("Computed interface hash: 0x" + hash.ToString("X16"));
        }
    }
}
```

            }

        }

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;

public class ByteArrayCopyExample {

    public static void copyByteArrayToStream(byte[] data, OutputStream out) throws IOException {
        out.write(data);
        out.flush();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        byte[] byteArray = new byte[] {1, 2, 3, 4, 5};

        try {
            ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            copyByteArrayToStream(byteArray, outputStream);

            byte[] copied = outputStream.toByteArray();
            System.out.println("Copied data: " + Arrays.toString(copied));

            // The stream is still open; let's write more data to demonstrate
            outputStream.write(new byte[] {6, 7});
            System.out.println("After writing more: " + Arrays.toString(outputStream.toByteArray()));

            // Close the stream finally
            outputStream.close();
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

public class Page {
    private Object[] items;

    public Page(Object[] items) {
        this.items = items;
    }

    // returns true whether this page doesn't contain items, returns false if it does.
    public bool hasNoItems() {
        return items == null || items.Length == 0;
    }
}

        System.out.println(new Page(null).hasNoItems()); // true
    }

import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class NcNameValidator {
    private static final Pattern NCNAME_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
        "^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$"
    );

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        String[] testNCNames = { "validName", "_alsoValid", "9invalidStart", "with space", "valid_Name123" };
        for (var name : testNCNames) {
            System.out.printf("Is '%s' a valid NCName? %b%n", name, isValidNCName(name));
        }
    }

    public static boolean isValidNCName(String s) {
        if (s == null || s.contains(":")) {
            return false;
        }
        return NCNAME_PATTERN.matcher(s).matches();
    }
}

            {

        // Determines if the character is a valid NCNameStartChar (per XML spec)
        public static bool IsNCNameStart(char ch)
        {
            // In XML, NCNameStartChar: Letter or '_'
            return (ch == '_') ||
                   (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') ||
                   (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') ||
                   (ch >= 0xC0 && ch <= 0xD6) ||
                   (ch >= 0xD8 && ch <= 0xF6) ||
                   (ch >= 0xF8 && ch <= 0x2FF) ||
                   (ch >= 0x370 && ch <= 0x37D) ||
                   (ch >= 0x37F && ch <= 0x1FFF) ||
                   (ch >= 0x200C && ch <= 0x200D) ||
                   (ch >= 0x2070 && ch <= 0x218F) ||
                   (ch >= 0x2C00 && ch <= 0x2FEF) ||
                   (ch >= 0x3001 && ch <= 0xD7FF) ||
                   (ch >= 0xF900 && ch <= 0xFDCF) ||
                   (ch >= 0xFDF0 && ch <= 0xFFFD) ||
                   (ch >= 0x10000 && ch <= 0xEFFFF);
        }

        // Determines if the character is a valid NCNameChar (per XML spec)
        public static bool IsNCName(char ch)
        {
            // NCNameChar: NCNameStartChar + '-' + '.' + digit + combining mark + extender
            return IsNCNameStart(ch) ||
                   (ch == '-') ||
                   (ch == '.') ||
                   (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') ||
                   (ch == 0xB7) ||
                   (ch >= 0x0300 && ch <= 0x036F) || // Combining marks
                   (ch >= 0x203F && ch <= 0x2040);   // Extender
        }

        // Check to see if a string is a valid NCName per XML Namespaces 1.0
        public static bool IsValidNCName(string ncName)
        {
            if (ncName == null || ncName.Length == 0)
                return false;

            char ch = ncName[0];
            if (!IsNCNameStart(ch))
                return false;

            for (int i = 1; i < ncName.Length; i++)
            {
                ch = ncName[i];
                if (!IsNCName(ch))
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}

```java
public class NcNameValidatorTest {

    public void testValidNCName() {

        String ncName = "validName";
        assertTrue(validator.isValidNCName(ncName));
    }

    @Test
    public void testInvalidNCName() {
        NcNameValidator validator = new NcNameValidator();
        String ncName = "invalidName";
        assertFalse(validator.isValidNCName(ncName));
    }

    @Test
    public void testEmptyNCName() {
        NcNameValidator validator = new NcNameValidator();
        String ncName = "";
        assertFalse(validator.isValidNCName(ncName));
    }

    @Test
    public void testNCNameWithColon() {
        NcNameValidator validator = new NcNameValidator();
        String ncName = "invalid:name";
        assertFalse(validator.isValidNCName(ncName));
    }

    @Test
    public void testNCNameWithSpace() {
        NcNameValidator validator = new NcNameValidator();
        String ncName = "with space";
        assertFalse(validator.isValidNCName(ncName));

    public void testNCNameWithDigit() {
        NcNameValidator validator = new NcNameValidator();
```

public interface IType { }

public class MType : IType { }

public class BType { }

public class RepeatedFieldBuilder<MType, BType, IType>
{
    private List<MType> messages = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<BType> builders = null;
    private int modCount = 0;

    public RepeatedFieldBuilder()
    {
        builders = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public RepeatedFieldBuilder<MType, BType, IType> AddMessage(MType message)
    {
        if (message == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException();
        }
        EnsureMutableMessageList();
        messages.Add(message);
        if (builders != null)
        {
            builders.add(default(BType));
        }
        OnChanged();
        IncrementModCounts();
        return this;
    }

    private void EnsureMutableMessageList()
    {
        // Dummy implementation for the example
        if (messages == null)
            messages = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    private void OnChanged()
    {
        // Implementation could signal that the builder state has changed
    }

    private void IncrementModCounts()
    {
        modCount++;
    }

    public void PrintMessages()
    {
        System.out.println("Messages count: " + messages.size());
        for (var message in messages)
        {
            System.out.println(message.ToString());
        }
    }
}

public class TestDataPreparer {
    private static readonly string _STR = "SampleString";
    protected List<string> dataSet1;
    protected List<string> dataSet2;
    protected List<string> dataSet3;

    public void PrepareDataSet() {
        dataSet1 = new List<string> { _STR, _STR, _STR };
        dataSet2 = new List<string> { _STR, _STR, _STR };
        dataSet3 = new List<string> { _STR, _STR, _STR, _STR };
    }

    public void ShowDataSets() {
        System.out.println("DataSet1: " + string.Join(", ", dataSet1));
        System.out.println("DataSet2: " + string.Join(", ", dataSet2));
        System.out.println("DataSet3: " + string.Join(", ", dataSet3));
    }
}

public class Main {

    static void main(String[] args) {
        TestDataPreparer preparer = new TestDataPreparer();
        preparer.PrepareDataSet();
        preparer.ShowDataSets();

        // Unit tests
        Test1(preparer);
        Test2(preparer);
        Test3(preparer);
        Test4(preparer);
        Test5(preparer);
    }

    static void Test1(TestDataPreparer preparer) {
        List<string> expected = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList("SampleString", "SampleString", "SampleString"));
        List<string> actual = new ArrayList<>(preparer.dataSet1);
        if (expected.equals(actual)) {
            System.out.println("Test 1 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 1 failed");
        }
    }

    static void Test2(TestDataPreparer preparer) {
        List<string> expected = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList("SampleString", "SampleString", "SampleString"));
        List<string> actual = new ArrayList<>(preparer.dataSet2);
        if (expected.equals(actual)) {
            System.out.println("Test 2 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 2 failed");
        }
    }

    static void Test3(TestDataPreparer preparer) {
        List<String> expected = Arrays.asList("SampleString", "SampleString", "SampleString");
        List<String> actual = new ArrayList<>(preparer.dataSet3);
        if (expected.equals(actual)) {
            System.out.println("Test 3 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 3 failed");
        }
    }

    static void Test4(TestDataPreparer preparer) {
        expected: prepareTestValues(preparer);
    }

    static List<Integer> prepareTestValues(TestDataPreparer preparer) {
        List<Integer> dataSet = new ArrayList<>();
        dataSet.add(10);
        dataSet.add(20);
        dataSet.add(30);
        dataSet.add(40);
        dataSet.add(50);
        return dataSet;
    }

    static void Test5(TestDataPreparer preparer) {
        System.out.println("Prepare test values: ");
        List<Integer> expected = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(10, 20, 30, 40, 50));
        List<Integer> actual = prepareTestValues(preparer);
        if (expected.equals(actual)) {
            System.out.println("Test 5 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 5 failed");
        }
    }

import java.util.ArrayList;
import import java.util.List;

public class TestDataPreparer {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<Integer> testValues = prepareTestValues();
        System.out.println("Prepared test values: " + testValues);

        // Unit tests
        Test1(prepareTestValues);
        Test2(prepareTestValues);
        Test3(prepareTestValues);
        Test4(prepareTestValues);
        Test5(prepareTestValues);
    }

    static void prepareTestValues() {
        List<Integer> dataSet = new ArrayList<>();
        dataSet.add(10);
        dataSet.add(20);
        dataSet.add(30);
        dataSet.add(40);
        dataSet.add(50);
        return dataSet;
    }

    static void Test1(List<Integer> values) {
        if (new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(10, 20, 30)).equals(values)) {
            System.out.println("Test 1 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 1 failed");
        }
    }

    static void Test2(List<Integer> values) {
        if (new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(20, 30, 40)).equals(values)) {
            System.out.println("Test 2 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 2 failed");
        }
    }

    static void Test3(List<Integer> values) {
        if (new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(10, 20, 30)).equals(values)) {
            System.out.println("Test 3 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 3 failed");
        }
    }

    static void Test4(List<Integer> values) {
        expected: prepareTestValues();
    }

    static List<Integer> prepareTestValues() {
        List<Integer> dataSet = new ArrayList<>();
        dataSet.add(10);
        dataSet.add(20);
        dataSet.add(30);
        dataSet.add(40);
        dataSet.add(50);
        return dataSet;
    }

    static void Test5(List<Integer> values) {
        System.out.println("Prepare test values: ");
        List<Integer> expected = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(10, 20, 30));
        if (expected.equals(values)) {
            System.out.println("Test 5 passed");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Test 5 failed");
        }
    }

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ServiceRegistrar
{
    public String Name { get; set; }
    public ServiceRegistrar(string name)
    {
        Name = name;
    }
}

public class ProxyReg
{
    public ServiceRegistrar proxy { get; set; }
    public ProxyReg(ServiceRegistrar proxy)
    {
        this.proxy = proxy;
    }
}

public class ServiceManager
{
    private int _NUM = 0;
    private List<ProxyReg> proxyRegSet;

    public ServiceManager()
    {
        proxyRegSet = new List<ProxyReg>
        {
            new ProxyReg(new ServiceRegistrar("ServiceA")),
            new ProxyReg(new ServiceRegistrar("ServiceB")),
            new ProxyReg(new ServiceRegistrar("ServiceC"))
        };
    }

    // returns array of serviceregistrar created from the proxyregset
    private ServiceRegistrar[] BuildServiceRegistrar()
    {
        int k = _NUM;
        ServiceRegistrar[] proxys = new ServiceRegistrar[proxyRegSet.Count];
        IEnumerator<ProxyReg> iter = proxyRegSet.GetEnumerator();
        while (iter.MoveNext())
        {
            ProxyReg reg = iter.Current;
            proxys[k++] = reg.proxy;
        }
        return proxys;
    }

    public void PrintServiceRegistrars()
    {
        ServiceRegistrar[] registrars = BuildServiceRegistrar();
        foreach (var reg in registrars)
        {
            if (reg != null)
                Console.WriteLine(reg.Name);
        }
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        ServiceManager manager = new ServiceManager();
        manager.PrintServiceRegistrars();
    }
}
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

class ServiceRegistrar {
    private String name;

    public ServiceRegistrar(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    public String getName() {
        return name;
    }
}

class ProxyRegSet {
    private List<String> proxyNames;

    public ProxyRegSet() {
        this.proxyNames = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public void addProxyName(String name) {
        proxyNames.add(name);
    }

    public List<String> getProxyNames() {
        return proxyNames;
    }
}

class Registry {
    private ProxyRegSet proxyRegSet;

    public Registry(ProxyRegSet proxyRegSet) {
        this.proxyRegSet = proxyRegSet;
    }

    // builds method to the registry .
    // returns array of serviceregistrar created from the proxyregset
    public ServiceRegistrar[] getServiceRegistrars() {
        List<String> proxies = proxyRegSet.getProxyNames();
        ServiceRegistrar[] registrars = new ServiceRegistrar[proxies.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < proxies.size(); i++) {
            registrars[i] = new ServiceRegistrar(proxies.get(i));
        }
        return registrars;
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ProxyRegSet proxyRegSet = new ProxyRegSet();
        proxyRegSet.addProxyName("ServiceA");
        proxyRegSet.addProxyName("ServiceB");
        proxyRegSet.addProxyName("ServiceC");

        Registry registry = new Registry(proxyRegSet);

        // Use built method to return and print the array
        ServiceRegistrar[] registrars = registry.getServiceRegistrars();
        for (ServiceRegistrar registrar : registrars) {
            System.out.println("ServiceRegistrar: " + registrar.getName());
        }
    }
}

using System;

public class MalformedObjectNameException : Exception
{
    public MalformedObjectNameException(string message) : base(message) { }
}

public class Program
{
    private const string _STR = "Error: ";
    private const int _NUM = 3;
    private const bool _BOOL = true;

    // Dummy ParseValue implementation for testing
    // Returns an array where [3] is the ending index, and value pattern is true if all digits
    private static int[] ParseValue(char[] s, int num)
    {
        int[] result = new int[num + 1]; // Ensure result[3] is accessible
        bool valuePattern = true;
        int i = 0;
        for (; i < s.Length && i < num; i++)
        {
            if (!char.IsDigit(s[i])) valuePattern = false;
        }
        result[num] = i; // set endValue as how much was consumed
        return result;
    }

    // check if the supplied value is a valid value .
    private static bool CheckValue(string val)
    {
        if (val == null)
            throw new NullReferenceException(_STR);

        int len = val.Length;
        if (len == _NUM)
            return _BOOL;

        char[] s = val.ToCharArray();
        int[] result = ParseValue(s, _NUM);
        int endValue = result[_NUM];
        bool valuePattern = result[_NUM] == _NUM;

        if (endValue < len)
            throw new MalformedObjectNameException(_STR + s[endValue] + _STR);

        return valuePattern;
    }

    public static void Main()
    {
        string[] testValues = { null, "123", "12", "123a", "456" };

        foreach (string val in testValues)
        {
            try
            {
                bool valid = CheckValue(val);
                Console.WriteLine($"Value: {val ?? "null"}, Valid: {valid}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"Value: {val ?? "null"}, Exception: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }
    }
}

public class ValueChecker
{
    public static bool IsValidValue(int value) {
        return value >= 1 && value <= 100;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int value = 42; // example value to check

        if (IsValidValue(value)) {
            System.out.println(value + " is a valid value.");
        } else {
            System.out.println(value + " is not a valid value.");
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace ServerRecoveryDemo
{
    // Dummy Logger implementation
    public class Logger
    {
        public bool IsDebugEnabled() => true;
        public void Debug(string msg) => Console.WriteLine("DEBUG: " + msg);
        public void Info(string msg) => Console.WriteLine("INFO: " + msg);
    }

    // Dummy string resources
    public static class LocalizedStrings
    {
        public const string QueueManagerImpl_SUBSCRIPTION_MANAGER_REDUNDANCY_SATISFIER_PRIMARY_ENDPOINT_HAS_BEEN_LOST_ATTEMPTIMG_TO_RECOVER = "Primary endpoint has been lost, attempting to recover.";
    }

    // Dummy localizer
    public static class LocalizedMessage
    {
        public static string Create(string key) => key;
    }

    // Dummy Server
    public class Server
    {
        public string Name { get; set; }
        public Server(string name) { Name = name; }
        public override string ToString() => Name;
        public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is Server other && other.Name == Name;
        public override int GetHashCode() => Name.GetHashCode();
    }

    // Dummy QueueConnectionImpl
    public class QueueConnectionImpl
    {
        public Server Server { get; set; }
        public bool IsActive { get; set; }
        public QueueConnectionImpl(Server server, bool isActive = true)
        {
            Server = server;
            IsActive = isActive;
        }
    }

    // Dummy QueueConnections class
    public class QueueConnections
    {
        private QueueConnectionImpl _primary;
        private readonly List<QueueConnectionImpl> _backups = new List<QueueConnectionImpl>();

        public void SetPrimary(QueueConnectionImpl primary) { _primary = primary; }
        public QueueConnectionImpl GetPrimary() => _primary;
        public List<QueueConnectionImpl> GetBackups() => _backups;
        public void AddBackup(QueueConnectionImpl backup) => _backups.Add(backup);
        public void RemoveBackup(QueueConnectionImpl backup) => _backups.Remove(backup);
    }

    // Dummy Pool class
    public class Pool
    {
        private bool _cancelInProgress = false;
        public void SetCancelInProgress(bool val) { _cancelInProgress = val; }
        public object GetPoolOrCacheCancelInProgress() => _cancelInProgress ? (object)true : null;
    }

    public class QueueManager
    {
        private static readonly string _STR = "Trying to recover the primary connection...";
        private static readonly bool _BOOL = false;

        private readonly Logger logger = new Logger();
        private readonly Pool pool = new Pool();
        private readonly QueueConnections queueConnections = new QueueConnections();

        private bool printRecoveringPrimary = true;

        // AddToConnectionList mockup
        private bool AddToConnectionList(QueueConnectionImpl conn, HashSet<Server> excludedServers)
        {
            if (conn.Server.Name.StartsWith("Fail"))
            {
                excludedServers.Add(conn.Server);
                return false;
            }
            queueConnections.SetPrimary(conn);
            return true;
        }

        // PromoteBackupToPrimary mockup
        private QueueConnectionImpl PromoteBackupToPrimary(List<QueueConnectionImpl> backups)
        {
            foreach (var backup in backups)
            {
                if (backup.IsActive)
                {
                    backups.Remove(backup);
                    return backup;
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        // Protected in Java, we'll make public for this demo.
        public void RecoverPrimary(HashSet<Server> excludedServers)
        {
            if (pool.GetPoolOrCacheCancelInProgress() != null)
            {
                return;
            }
            bool isDebugEnabled = logger.IsDebugEnabled();
            if (queueConnections.GetPrimary() != null)
            {
                if (isDebugEnabled)
                {
                    logger.Debug(_STR);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (isDebugEnabled)
            {
                logger.Debug(_STR);
            }
            if (printRecoveringPrimary)
            {
                logger.Info(LocalizedMessage.Create(
                    LocalizedStrings.QueueManagerImpl_SUBSCRIPTION_MANAGER_REDUNDANCY_SATISFIER_PRIMARY_ENDPOINT_HAS_BEEN_LOST_ATTEMPTIMG_TO_RECOVER
                ));
                printRecoveringPrimary = _BOOL;
            }
            QueueConnectionImpl newPrimary = null;
            while (newPrimary == null && pool.GetPoolOrCacheCancelInProgress() == null)
            {
                List<QueueConnectionImpl> backups = new List<QueueConnectionImpl>(queueConnections.GetBackups());
                newPrimary = PromoteBackupToPrimary(backups);
                if (newPrimary == null)
                {
                    break;
                }
                if (!AddToConnectionList(newPrimary, excludedServers))
                {
                    // failed to add, add server to excluded
                    excludedServers.Add(newPrimary.Server);
                    newPrimary = null;

            public static void main(String[] args) {
                QueueManager manager = new QueueManager();
                HashSet<Server> excludedServers = new HashSet<>();
                excludedServers.add(new Server("Fail"));
                excludedServers.add(new Server("Available"));

                manager.RecoverPrimary(excludedServers);

                System.out.println(manager.queueConnections.GetBackups().get(0).ToString());
            }

```java
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

public class ServerManager {
    private List<string> primaryServers = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<string> backupServers = new ArrayList<>();
    private List<string> availableServers = new ArrayList<>();
    private Set<string> excludedServers = new HashSet<>();

    public ServerManager(List<string> primaries, List<string> backups, List<string> availables) {
        this.primaryServers.addAll(primaries);
        this.backupServers.addAll(backups);
        this.availableServers.addAll(availables);
    }

    // finds a new primary, adding any failed servers we encounter to the excluded servers list
    // first we try to make a backup server the primary, but if run out of backup servers we will try to find a new server
    public string findNewPrimary() {
        while (!backupServers.isEmpty()) {
            string backup = backupServers.remove(0);
            if (!excludedServers.Contains(backup)) {
                // Simulate a server failure check
                boolean failed = isServerFailed(backup);
                if (!failed) {
                    primaryServers.Add(backup);
                    System.out.WriteLine("Promoted backup to primary: " + backup);
                    return backup;
                } else {
                    System.out.WriteLine("Backup server failed: " + backup);
                    excludedServers.Add(backup);
                }
            }
        }

        while (!availableServers.isEmpty()) {
            string server = availableServers.remove(0);
            if (!excludedServers.Contains(server)) {
                // Simulate a server failure check
                boolean failed = isServerFailed(server);
                if (!failed) {
                    primaryServers.Add(server);
                    System.out.WriteLine("Promoted available to primary: " + server);
                    return server;
                } else {
                    System.out.WriteLine("Available server failed: " + server);
                    excludedServers.Add(server);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.WriteLine("No servers available to promote to primary.");
        return null;
    }

    // Dummy stub for checking if a server has failed
    private boolean isServerFailed(string server) {
        // For demo, treat server names with 'fail' as failed
        return server.Contains("fail");
    }

    public void printState() {
        System.out.WriteLine("Primaries: " + primaryServers);
        System.out.WriteLine("Backups: " + backupServers);
        System.out.WriteLine("Availables: " + availableServers);
        System.out.WriteLine("Excluded: " + excludedServers);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        List<string> primaries = new ArrayList<>();
        primaries.Add("primary1");
        List<string> backups = new ArrayList<>();
        backups.Add("backup1");
        backups.Add("backup_fail2");
        backups.Add("backup2");
        List<string> availables = new ArrayList<>();
        availables.Add("available1");
        availables.Add("available_fail2");
        availables.Add("available2");

        ServerManager manager = new ServerManager(primaries, backups, availables);

        manager.printState();
        System.out.WriteLine();

        manager.findNewPrimary();

        System.out.println();
        manager.printState();
    }
}
```

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class JournalRebuilder {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Original Java code
        using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;

namespace JournalRebuilder
{
    class Entry
    {
        public string key;
        public object currentEditor;
        private long[] lengths;

        public Entry(string key, long[] lengths, object currentEditor = null)
        {
            this.key = key;
            this.lengths = lengths;
            this.currentEditor = currentEditor;
        }

        public string GetLengths()
        {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            foreach (var l in lengths)
            {
                sb.Append(" ").Append(l);
            }
            return sb.ToString();
        }
    }

    class Journal
    {
        private const string MAGIC = "journal_magic";
        private const string VERSION_1 = "1";
        private const string _STR = "\n";
        private const string DIRTY = "DIRTY";
        private const string CLEAN = "CLEAN";
        private const int IO_BUFFER_SIZE = 8192;

        private string journalFileTmp = "journal.tmp";
        private string journalFile = "journal";
        private StreamWriter journalWriter;
        private int valueCount = 2;
        private int appVersion = 100;
        private Dictionary<string, Entry> lruEntries = new Dictionary<string, Entry>();

        public Journal()
        {
            // Add some fake entries for demonstration
            lruEntries["one"] = new Entry("one", new long[] { 123, 456 });
            lruEntries["two"] = new Entry("two", new long[] { 789, 1011 }, currentEditor: new object());
            lruEntries["three"] = new Entry("three", new long[] { 222, 333 });
        }

        private void RebuildJournal()
        {
            lock (this)
            {
                if (journalWriter != null)
                {
                    journalWriter.Close();
                }
                using (var writer = new StreamWriter(new FileStream(journalFileTmp, FileMode.Create), new UTF8Encoding(), IO_BUFFER_SIZE))
                {
                    writer.Write(MAGIC);
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                    writer.Write(VERSION_1);
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                    writer.Write(appVersion.ToString());
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                    writer.Write(valueCount.ToString());
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                    writer.Write(_STR);
                    foreach (var entry in lruEntries.Values)
                    {
                        if (entry.currentEditor != null)
                        {
                            writer.Write(DIRTY + _STR + entry.key + _STR);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            writer.Write(CLEAN + _STR + entry.key + entry.GetLengths() + _STR);
                        }
                    }
                }
                File.Move(journalFileTmp, journalFile, true);
                journalWriter = new StreamWriter(new FileStream(journalFile, FileMode.OpenOrCreate), new UTF8Encoding(), IO_BUFFER_SIZE);
            }
        }

        public void Run()
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Rebuilding journal...");
            RebuildJournal();
            Console.WriteLine("Journal rebuilt. Contents:");
            journalWriter.Flush();
            journalWriter.Close();
            using (var reader = new StreamReader(journalFile))
            {
                Console.WriteLine(reader.ReadToEnd());
            }
        }
    }

    class Program
    {
        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            Journal journal = new Journal();
            journal.Run();
        }
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

class Journal {
    private List<String> entries;

    public Journal() {
        this.entries = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public void addEntry(String entry) {
        entries.add(entry);
    }

    public List<String> getEntries() {
        return entries;
    }

    // Omits redundant consecutive entries
    public Journal omitRedundantInformation() {
        Journal newJournal = new Journal();
        String previous = null;
        for (String entry : entries) {
            if (!entry.equals(previous)) {
                newJournal.addEntry(entry);
            }
            previous = entry;
        }
        return newJournal;
    }

    public void printEntries() {
        for (String entry : entries) {
            System.out.println(entry);
        }
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Existing journal with redundant information
        Journal currentJournal = new Journal();
        currentJournal.addEntry("Started project");
        currentJournal.addEntry("Added feature A");
        currentJournal.addEntry("Added feature A"); // redundant
        currentJournal.addEntry("Fixed bug");
        currentJournal.addEntry("Fixed bug"); // redundant
        currentJournal.addEntry("Refactored code");
        currentJournal.addEntry("Deployed application");

        System.out.println("Original Journal:");
        currentJournal.printEntries();

        // creates a new journal that omits redundant information
        // this replaces the current journal if it exists
        Journal newJournal = currentJournal.omitRedundantInformation();
        currentJournal = newJournal;

        System.out.println("\nJournal After Omitting Redundant Information:");
        currentJournal.printEntries();
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class RuleManager {
    private List<String> rules;

    public RuleManager() {
        this.rules = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    // Adds a rule to the list
    public void addRule(String rule) {
        rules.add(rule);
    }

    // Removes the last rule from the list (the recurrence)
    public void removeLastRule() {
        if (!rules.isEmpty()) {
            rules.remove(rules.size() - 1);
            System.out.println("Last rule removed from persistent store.");
        } else {
            System.out.println("No rules to remove.");
        }
    }

    // Displays all rules
    public void displayRules() {
        System.out.println("Current rules in persistent store:");
        for (String rule : rules) {
            System.out.println(rule);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        RuleManager ruleManager = new RuleManager();
        ruleManager.addRule("Rule 1: No running");
        ruleManager.addRule("Rule 2: No shouting");
        ruleManager.addRule("Recurrence: Water plants every Sunday");
        ruleManager.displayRules();
        // removes the last from the list of the rules.
        ruleManager.removeLastRule();
        ruleManager.displayRules();
    }
}

class RecurrenceHandler {
    private List<Rule> rRulesList;
    private List<Rule> eRulesList;
    private Info info;

    public RecurrenceHandler(List<Rule> rRulesList, List<Rule> eRulesList, Info info)
    {
        this.rRulesList = rRulesList;
        this.eRulesList = eRulesList;
        this.info = info;
    }

    // removes the recurrence from persistent store .
    public void Remove()
    {
        List<Rule> rulesList = new ArrayList<Rule>();
        rulesList.AddRange(rRulesList);
        rulesList.AddRange(eRulesList);
        try
        {
            foreach (Rule rule in rulesList)
            {
                rule.Remove();
            }
            info.Remove();
        }
        catch (RuleException rre)
        {
            throw new RuleInfoException(rre.Message, rre);
        }
        catch (GenericEntityException gee)
        {
            throw new RuleInfoException(gee.Message, gee);
        }
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class NodeSetDTM {

    // Custom NodeList implementation for demonstration
    static class SimpleNodeList implements NodeList {
        private final List<Node> nodes = new ArrayList<>();

        public void add(Node node) {
            nodes.add(node);
        }

        @Override
        public Node item(int index) {
            return nodes.get(index);
        }

        @Override
        public int getLength() {
            return nodes.size();
        }
    }

    /**
     * copy nodelist members into this nodelist, adding in document order.
     * if a node is null, don't add it.
     */
    public static void copyNodeListMembers(NodeList from, SimpleNodeList to) {
        for (int i = 0; i < from.getLength(); i++) {
            Node node = from.item(i);
            if (node != null) {
                to.add(node);
            }
        }
    }

    // Mock Node implementation for demonstration

public class XPathContext {

    // Implementation details as needed
}

public abstract class DTMIterator {

    public abstract int NextNode();
}

public class NodeSetDTM {

    private boolean m_mutable = true;

    public void SetMutable(boolean value) {
        m_mutable = value;
    }

    // Simulates storing nodes
    private List<Integer> nodes = new ArrayList<>();

    public void AddNodesInDocOrder(DTMIterator iterator, XPathContext support) {
        if (!m_mutable)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("This node set is not mutable.");
        int node;
        while ((node = iterator.NextNode()) != 0) {
            AddNodeInDocOrder(node, support);
        }
    }

    // Simulate adding node in document order (here, just normal add if not present)
    public void AddNodeInDocOrder(int node, XPathContext support) {
        if (node == 0)
            return;
        if (!nodes.contains(node))
        {
            int idx = 0;
            while (idx < nodes.size() && nodes.get(idx) < node)
                idx++;
            nodes.add(idx, node);
        }
    }

    public void PrintNodes() {
        System.out.println("Nodes in doc order: " + string.Join(", ", nodes));
    }
}

public class SimpleDTMIterator implements DTMIterator {

    private final List<Integer> _nodes;
    private int _index = 0;

    public SimpleDTMIterator(List<Integer> nodes) {
        _nodes = nodes;
    }

    public int NextNode() {
        if (_index < _nodes.size())
            return _nodes[_index++];
        return 0;
    }
}

public class UnitTests {
    public static void runUnitTests() {
        // Unit tests for DataFetcher
        testNeedsToRefetchData();
        testFetchDataIfNeeded();
        testIsDataValid();
        testIsDataValidWhenFetchedRecently();
        testIsDataInvalidWhenNotFetched();

        // Run unit tests on Java code
        System.out.println("Running unit tests on Java code:");
        runUnitTestsOnJavaCode();

        // Run unit tests on C# code
        System.out.println("\nRunning unit tests on C# code:");
        runUnitTestsOnCSharpCode();
    }

    public static void testNeedsToRefetchData() {
        DataFetcher fetcher = new DataFetcher(2000);
        assertTrue(fetcher.NeedToRefetchData());
        assertFalse(fetcher.NeedToRefetchData());

        fetcher = new DataFetcher(1000);
        assertTrue(fetcher.NeedToRefetchData());
    }

    public static void testFetchDataIfNeeded() {
        DataFetcher fetcher = new DataFetcher(2000);
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            fetcher.FetchDataIfNeeded();
            try { Thread.sleep(1000); } catch (InterruptedException e) {}
        }
    }

    public static void testIsDataValid() {
        DataFetcher fetcher = new DataFetcher();
        assertTrue(fetcher.isDataValid());
        // Wait for 2 seconds and check again
        try { Thread.sleep(2000); } catch (InterruptedException e) {}
        assertTrue(fetcher.isDataValid());

        // Wait for 6 minutes and check again
        try { Thread.sleep(360000); } catch (InterruptedException e) {}
        assertFalse(fetcher.isDataValid());
    }

    public static void testIsDataValidWhenFetchedRecently() {
        DataFetcher fetcher = new DataFetcher();
        assertTrue(fetcher.isDataValid());
        // Wait for 2 seconds and check again
        try { Thread.sleep(2000); } catch (InterruptedException e) {}
        assertTrue(fetcher.isDataValid());
    }

    public static void testIsDataInvalidWhenNotFetched() {
        DataFetcher fetcher = new DataFetcher();
        assertFalse(fetcher.isDataValid());
    }

import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

public class TestDocumentImpl {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Example test cases
        System.out.println(testCreateDocumentType("html", " "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN", "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd"));
        System.out.println(testCreateDocumentType("invalid name", "", ""));
        System.out.println(testCreateDocumentType("", "", ""));
    }

    public static String testCreateDocumentType(String qualifiedName, String publicID, String systemID) {
        TestDocumentImpl.MyDocumentImpl docImpl = new TestDocumentImpl.MyDocumentImpl();
        try {
            var doctype = docImpl.CreateDocumentType(qualifiedName, publicID, systemID);
            return verifyDocumentType(doctype, qualifiedName, publicID, systemID);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.out.println("Test failed: " + e.getMessage());
            return null;
        }
    }

    public static String verifyDocumentType(Document documentType, String expectedQName, String expectedPublicId, String expectedSystemId) {
        if (!documentType.getName().equals(expectedQName)) {
            return "Expected QName '" + expectedQName + "' but got '" + documentType.getName() + "'";
        }
        if (!documentType.getPublicId().equals(expectedPublicId)) {
            return "Expected Public ID \"" + expectedPublicId + "\" but got \"" + documentType.getPublicId() + "\"";
        }
        if (!documentType.getSystemId().equals(expectedSystemId)) {
            return "Expected System ID \"" + expectedSystemId + "\" but got \"" + documentType.getSystemId() + "\"";
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static class MyDocumentImpl implements TestDocumentImpl.DocumentImpl {
        @Override
        public DocumentType CreateDocumentType(String qualifiedName, String publicID, String systemID) {
            CheckQName(qualifiedName);
            return new DocumentTypeImpl(null, qualifiedName, publicID, systemID);
        }

        protected void CheckQName(String qualifiedName) {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(qualifiedName))
                throw new ArgumentException("Qualified name cannot be null or empty.");

            // Simple QName check. For real DOM, more checks would be needed.
            if (qualifiedName.Contains(" "))
                throw new ArgumentException("Qualified name cannot contain spaces.");
        }
    }

    public interface DocumentImpl {
        DocumentType CreateDocumentType(String qualifiedName, String publicID, String systemID);
    }

    public abstract class DocumentImpl {
        public abstract DocumentType CreateDocumentType(String qualifiedName, String publicID, String systemID);

        protected void CheckQName(String qualifiedName) {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(qualifiedName))
                throw new ArgumentException("Qualified name cannot be null or empty.");

            // Simple QName check. For real DOM, more checks would be needed.
            if (qualifiedName.Contains(" "))
                throw new ArgumentException("Qualified name cannot contain spaces.");
        }
    }

    public class DocumentType {
        public String Name { get; }
        public String PublicId { get; }
        public String SystemId { get; }

        public DocumentType(String name, String publicID, String systemID) {
            Name = name;
            PublicId = publicID;
            SystemId = systemID;
        }

        public override string ToString() {
            return $"<!DOCTYPE {Name} PUBLIC \"{PublicId}\" \"{SystemId}\">";
        }

        public String getName() {
            return Name;
        }

        public String getPublicId() {
            return PublicId;
        }

        public String getSystemId() {
            return SystemId;
        }
    }

    public class DocumentTypeImpl extends DocumentType {
        public DocumentTypeImpl(Object owner, String name, String publicID, String systemID) : base(name, publicID, systemID) {
            // 'owner' is not used in this sample implementation
        }
    }
}

```java
    public AMIdentityRepository(SSOToken token, string realm)
    {
        _token = token;
        _realm = realm;
    }

    public IdSearchResults SearchIdentities(IdType type, string filter, IdSearchControl control)
    {
        // Demo dummy search

public class HandlerBase
{
    public virtual void HandleRequest(RequestContext rc)
    {
        // Base handler logic if needed
    }
}

// Actual handler class implementing the provided code
public class MyHandler : HandlerBase
{
    // Constants for example
    private const string _STR = "default";

    public override void HandleRequest(RequestContext rc)
    {
        base.HandleRequest(rc);

        LdapLogin();
        SSOToken adminSSOToken = GetAdminSSOToken();
        IOutput outputWriter = GetOutputWriter();
        string realm = GetStringOptionValue(nameof(IArgument.REALM_NAME));
        string patternType = GetStringOptionValue(nameof(IArgument.AGENT_TYPE));
        string filter = GetStringOptionValue(nameof(IArgument.FILTER));

        if (patternType == null)
        {
            patternType = _STR;
        }
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filter))
        {
            filter = _STR;
        }
        string[] @params = { realm, patternType, filter };

        WriteLog(LogWriter.LOG_ACCESS, LogLevel.INFO, _STR, @params);
        try
        {
            AMIdentityRepository amir = new AMIdentityRepository(adminSSOToken, realm);
            IdSearchResults isr = amir.SearchIdentities(IdType.AGENTONLY, filter, new IdSearchControl());
            var results = isr.GetSearchResults();
            if (results != null && results.Count > 0)
            {
                results.RemoveAll(am => !MatchType(am, patternType));
            }
            if (results != null && results.Count > 0)
            {
                foreach (var am in results)
                {
                    outputWriter.Write($"Agent: {am.Name}, Type: {am.Type}");
                }
            }
            else
            {
                outputWriter.Write("No matching agents found.");
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            outputWriter.Write($"Error: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }

    private void LdapLogin()
    {
        // Simulated LDAP login
    }

    private SSOToken GetAdminSSOToken()
    {
        return new SSOToken();
    }

    private IOutput GetOutputWriter()
    {
        return new ConsoleOutput();
    }

    private string GetStringOptionValue(string arg)
    {
        // For demonstration, always return some fixed value
        if (arg == nameof(IArgument.REALM_NAME)) return "myRealm";
        if (arg == nameof(IArgument.AGENT_TYPE)) return "type1";
        if (arg == nameof(IArgument.FILTER)) return "";
        return null;
    }

    private void WriteLog(LogWriter lw, LogLevel lvl, string str, string[] param)
    {
        System.Console.WriteLine($"LOG[{lw}|{lvl}|{str}]: params=({string.Join(", ", param)})");
    }
}

{
    public static void TestMyHandler()
    {
        ConsoleOutput consoleOutput = new ConsoleOutput();
```

```java
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.ObjectOutputStream;
import java.io.Serializable;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

public class Field {
    // Dummy implementation to simulate storing bytes into a stream
    public void Store(ByteArrayOutputStream stream, Object parameter) {
        byte[] data = new byte[] { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };
        stream.write(data);
    }
}

public class NestedObject implements Serializable {
    private Field _field;

    public NestedObject() {
        _field = new Field();
    }

    // Serializes this nested object into byte[]
    public byte[] ToBytes() throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytesStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        _field.Store(bytesStream, null);
        return bytesStream.toByteArray();
    }
}

public class Program {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        NestedObject obj = new NestedObject();
        try {
            byte[] bytes = obj.ToBytes();
            System.out.println("Serialized bytes: " + java.util.Arrays.toString(bytes));
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.IO;

public class Field
{
    // Dummy implementation to simulate storing bytes into a stream
    public void Store(Stream stream, object parameter)
    {
        // For demonstration, simply write some bytes
        byte[] data = new byte[] { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 };
        stream.Write(data, 0, data.Length);
    }
}

public class NestedObject : ISerializable
{
    private Field _field;

    public NestedObject()
    {
        _field = new Field();
    }

    // Serializes this nested object into byte[]
    public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
    {
        using (var stream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            _field.Store(stream, null);
            info.AddValue("data", stream.ToArray());
        }
    }
}

public class SerializeToBytesDemo
{
    public static void main()
    {
        try {
            // Example nested object
            OuterObject outer = new OuterObject("Hello", new InnerObject(123));
            byte[] serialized = serializeToBytes(outer);
            System.Console.WriteLine($"Serialized byte array length: {serialized.Length}");
        } catch (IOException e)
        {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    // Serializes an object into byte[]
    public static byte[] serializeToBytes(Serializable obj) throws IOException
    {
        using (var bytesStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream())
        {
            var outStream = new ObjectOutputStream(bytesStream);
            outStream.writeObject(obj);
            outStream.Flush();
            return bytesStream.ToArray();
        }
    }
}

// Nested object for demonstration
class OuterObject : ISerializable
{
    private static readonly long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    public string Name;
    public InnerObject Inner;

    public OuterObject(string name, InnerObject inner)
    {
        Name = name;
        Inner = inner;
    }

    // Implementing get_object_data to store the object data into byte[]
    public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
    {
        using (var stream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            var outStream = new ObjectOutputStream(stream);
            outStream.writeObject(this);
            info.AddValue("Name", Name, typeof(string));
            info.AddValue("Inner", Inner, typeof(InnerObject), new InnerObjectSerializer());
        }
    }
}

class InnerObject : ISerializable
{
    private static readonly long serialVersionUID = 1L;

    public int Value;

    public InnerObject(int value)
    {
        Value = value;
    }

    // Implementing get_object_data to store the object data into byte[]
    public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
    {
        using (var stream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            var outStream = new ObjectOutputStream(stream);
            outStream.writeObject(this);
            info.AddValue("Value", Value, typeof(int));
        }
    }

    // Implementing ISerializable to serialize the object
    public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
    {
        using (var stream = new MemoryStream())
        {
            var outStream = new ObjectOutputStream(stream);
            outStream.writeObject(this);
            info.AddValue("Value", Value, typeof(int));
        }
    }

    // Inner class to handle serialization
    public class InnerObjectSerializer : ISerializable
    {
        public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
        {
            using (var stream = new MemoryStream())
            {
                var outStream = new ObjectOutputStream(stream);
                outStream.writeObject(this);
                info.AddValue("Value", Value, typeof(int));
            }
        }

        // Implementing ISerializable to serialize the object
        public void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
        {
            using (var stream = new MemoryStream())
            {
                var outStream = new ObjectOutputStream(stream);
                outStream.writeObject(this);
                info.AddValue("Value", Value, typeof(int));
            }
        }

        // Fields to be serialized
        public int Value;
    }
}
```

```java
public class SerializeToBytesDemoTest {

    private byte[] serializeToBytes(Serializable obj) throws IOException
    {
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytesStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        ObjectOutputStream out = new ObjectOutputStream(bytesStream);
        out.writeObject(obj);
        out.flush();
        return bytesStream.toByteArray();
    }

    @Test
    void testSerializeAndDeserialize() throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
    {
        OuterObject outer = new OuterObject("Hello", new InnerObject(123));
        byte[] serialized = serializeToBytes(outer);
        NestedObject deserializedObj = new NestedObject();
        deserializedObj.ToBytes(serialized);
        assertEquals(outer.Name, deserializedObj.Name);
        assertEquals(outer.Inner.Value, deserializedObj.Inner.Value);
    }

    @Test
    void testOuterObjectSerialization() throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
    {
        OuterObject outer = new OuterObject("Hello", new InnerObject(123));
        byte[] serialized = serializeToBytes(outer);
        NestedObject deserializedObj = new NestedObject();
        deserializedObj.ToBytes(serialized);
        assertEquals(outer.Name, deserializedObj.Name);
        assertEquals(outer.Inner.Value, deserializedObj.Inner.Value);
    }
}
```

using System;

public class StyleEnumExample {
    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        string styleName = "red-bold italic";
        ColorEnum result = FromStyleName(ColorEnum.class, ColorEnum.Default);
        System.out.println("Matching enum: " + result);

        // Unit tests
        testFromStyleName("italic bold", ColorEnum.ITALIC);
        testFromStyleName("underline unknownstyle", null);
        testFromStyleName(null, null);
    }

    public static E FromStyleName<E>(Class<E> enumClass, E defaultValue) throws Exception {
        if (enumClass == null || defaultValue == null) {
            throw new Exception();
        }
        for (E constant : Enum.valueOf(enumClass)) {
            Style.HasCssName anEnum = (Style.HasCssName) constant;
            String cssClass = anEnum.GetCssName();
            if (cssClass != null && StyleHelper.ContainsStyle("red-bold italic", cssClass)) {
                return (E)(object)constant;
            }
        }
        throw new Exception();
    }

    public static class StyleHelper {
        public static boolean ContainsStyle(String styleName, String cssClass) {
            if (styleName == null || cssClass == null)
                return false;
            String[] styles = styleName.split(new char[]{' '}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            return java.util.Arrays.asList(styles).contains(cssClass.toUpperCase());
        }
    }

    public enum ColorEnum implements Style.HasCssName {
        Default, Red, Bold, Italic;

        @Override
        public String GetCssName() {
            switch (this) {
                case Red:
                    return "red";
                case Bold:
                    return "bold";
                case Italic:
                    return "italic";
                default:
                    return null;
            }
        }
    }

    // Extension allowing ColorEnum to implement HasCssName
    public static class ColorEnumExtensions {
        public static String GetCssName(this ColorEnum color) {
            switch (color) {
                case Red:
                    return "red";
                case Bold:
                    return "bold";
                case Italic:
                    return "italic";
                default:
                    return null;
            }
        }
    }

    // Allow casting ColorEnum to Style.HasCssName for compatibility with the constraint.
    public static class EnumExtensions {
        public static String GetCssName(this Style.HasCssName hasCssName) {
            if (hasCssName instanceof ColorEnum colorEnum)
                return colorEnum.GetCssName();
            return null;
        }
    }

    // Let ColorEnum implement Style.HasCssName for generic constraint.
}

```csharp
public class StyleNameConverter {

    public enum StyleName {
        BOLD, ITALIC, UNDERLINE, NORMAL
    }
    
    // returns first enum constant found in at space - separated list of style names
    public static StyleName convertFromStyleName(String styleNames) {
        if (styleNames == null || styleNames.Trim().Equals(string.Empty)) {
            return default(StyleName);
        }
        String[] names = styleNames.Split(' ');
        for (String name in names) {
            try {
                return (StyleName)(Enum.Parse(typeof(StyleName), name.ToUpper()));
            } catch (ArgumentException e) {
                // continue searching
            }
        }
        return default(StyleName);
    }
    
    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        string test1 = "italic bold";
        string test2 = "underline unknownstyle";
        string test3 = "unknownstyle normal";
        string test4 = "";

        System.Console.WriteLine(convertFromStyleName(test1)); // ITALIC
        System.Console.WriteLine(convertFromStyleName(test2)); // UNDERLINE
        System.Console.WriteLine(convertFromStyleName(test3)); // NORMAL
        System.Console.WriteLine(convertFromStyleName(test4)); // 
    }
}
```

```java
public class MpegExample
{
    public class Logger
    {
        public bool IsDebugEnabled { get; set; } = true;
        public void Warn(string msg)
        {
            System.out.println("[WARN] " + msg);
        }
        public void Debug(string msg)
        {
            System.out.println("[DEBUG] " + msg);
        }
    }

    public class MpegHandler
    {
        private Dictionary<int, object> streamMap = new Dictionary<int, object>();
        private Logger log = new Logger();

        private int videoFrameCount = 0;
        private bool startedMpeg = false;

        // Simulating HleMpegGetAvcAu
        private int HleMpegGetAvcAu(object unused)
        {
            // For testing: return -1 to simulate not finding AU, or any other int as needed
            return new Random().Next(0, 2) == 0 ? -1 : 42;
        }

        public int SceMpegNextAvcRpAu(int mpeg, int streamUid)
        {
            if (!streamMap.ContainsKey(streamUid))
            {
                log.Warn(string.Format("{0}", streamUid));
                return -1; // Replace _NUM with -1
            }
            int result = HleMpegGetAvcAu(null);
            if (result != -1) // Replace _NUM with -1
            {
                if (log.IsDebugEnabled)
                {
                    log.Debug(string.Format("{0}", result));
                }
                return result;
            }
            videoFrameCount++;
            startedMpeg = true; // Replace _BOOL with true
            return -1; // Replace _NUM with -1
        }

        // Helper for demonstration: add a stream
        public void AddStream(int streamUid)
        {
            streamMap[streamUid] = new object();
        }
    }

}

{
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        MpegHandler mpegHandler = new MpegHandler();

        System.out.println("Result (invalid UID): " + mpegHandler.SceMpegNextAvcRpAu(1, 999));
    }
```
