import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

public class ExportMaskDemo {
    // Dummy ExportMask class for demonstration
    public static class ExportMask {
        private String uri;
        private String data;
        public ExportMask(String uri, String data) {
            this.uri = uri;
            this.data = data;
        }
        public String getUri() { return uri; }
        public String getData() { return data; }
        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return "ExportMask{uri='" + uri + "', data='" + data + "'}";
        }
    }

    // Simulate a database or storage of ExportMasks
    private static Map<String, ExportMask> exportMaskStore = new HashMap<>();
    static {
        exportMaskStore.put("mask1", new ExportMask("mask1", "Data1"));
        exportMaskStore.put("mask2", new ExportMask("mask2", "Data2"));
        exportMaskStore.put("mask3", new ExportMask("mask3", "Data3"));
    }

    // Given a set of exportmask URIs, return a map of exportmask URI to ExportMask object
    public static Map<String, ExportMask> getExportMasksByUris(Set<String> exportMaskUris) {
        Map<String, ExportMask> result = new HashMap<>();
        for (String uri : exportMaskUris) {
            if (exportMaskStore.containsKey(uri)) {
                result.put(uri, exportMaskStore.get(uri));
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static class ExportMaskIterator implements Iterator<ExportMask> {
        private List<ExportMask> _masks;
        private int _position = -1;

        public ExportMaskIterator(List<ExportMask> masks)
        {
            _masks = new ArrayList<>(masks);
        }

        @Override
        public ExportMask next() { return _masks[++_position]; }
        @Override
        public boolean hasNext(){ return (_position < _masks.size()) ? true : false; }

    }

    // Dummy DB client
    private static class DummyDbClient {
        private Map<String, ExportMask> _masks;

        public DummyDbClient(Map<String, ExportMask> masks)
        {
            _masks = new HashMap<>(masks);
        }

        public ExportMaskIterator QueryIterativeObjects<T>(Set<String> uris, boolean someFlag)
        {
            List<ExportMask> found = new ArrayList<>();
            for (String uri : uris) {
                if (_masks.containsKey(uri)) {
                    found.add(_masks.get(uri));
                }
            }
            return new ExportMaskIterator(found);
        }
    }

    class Program {

        private DummyDbClient dbClient;

        public Program(DummyDbClient client)
        {
            dbClient = client;
        }

        // given a set of exportmask uris , return a map of exportmask uri to exportmask object
        private Map<String, ExportMask> CreateExportMaskMap(Set<String> placedMasks)
        {
            Map<String, ExportMask> exportMaskMap = new HashMap<>();
            var exportMaskIterator = dbClient.QueryIterativeObjects<ExportMask>(placedMasks, true);
            while (exportMaskIterator.hasNext()) {
                ExportMask exportMask = exportMaskIterator.next();
                exportMaskMap.put(exportMask.getUri(), exportMask);
            }
            return exportMaskMap;
        }

        public static void main(String[] args) {
            // Setup sample export masks
            Set<String> uris = new HashSet<>();
            uris.add("mask1");
            uris.add("mask3");

            Map<String, ExportMask> maskMap = CreateExportMaskMap(uris);

            System.out.println("Returned ExportMask map:");
            for (Map.Entry<String, ExportMask> entry : maskMap.entrySet()) {
                System.out.println("URI: " + entry.getKey() + ", ExportMask: " + entry.getValue());
            }
        }
    }

public class ExportMaskExample {

    // Dummy ExportMask class
    public static class ExportMask {
        private Uri _id;

        public ExportMask(Uri id)
        {
            _id = id;
        }

        public Uri GetId()
        {
            return _id;
        }

        // Just for display purposes
        @Override
        public String ToString()
        {
            return "ExportMask: {_id}";
        }
    }

    // Dummy iterator for ExportMask objects
    public static class ExportMaskIterator implements IEnumerator<ExportMask> {
        private List<ExportMask> _masks;
        private int _position = -1;

        public ExportMaskIterator(List<ExportMask> masks)
        {
            _masks = new ArrayList<>(masks);
        }

        @Override
        public ExportMask next() { return _masks[++_position]; }
        @Override
        public boolean hasNext(){ return (_position < _masks.size()) ? true : false; }

    }

    // Dummy DB client
    private static class DummyDbClient {
        private Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> _masks;

        public DummyDbClient(Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> masks)
        {
            _masks = new HashMap<>(masks);
        }

        public ExportMaskIterator QueryIterativeObjects<T>(Set<Uri> uris, boolean someFlag)
        {
            List<ExportMask> found = new ArrayList<>();
            foreach (var uri in uris) {
                if (_masks.TryGetValue(uri, out var mask))
                {
                    found.Add(mask);
                }
            }
            return new ExportMaskIterator(found);
        }
    }

    class Program {

        private DummyDbClient dbClient;

        public Program(DummyDbClient client)
        {
            dbClient = client;
        }

        // given a set of exportmask uris , return a map of exportmask uri to exportmask object
        private Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> CreateExportMaskMap(Set<Uri> placedMasks)
        {
            Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask> exportMaskMap = new Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask>();
            var exportMaskIterator = dbClient.QueryIterativeObjects<ExportMask>(placedMasks, true);
            while (exportMaskIterator.hasNext()) {
                ExportMask exportMask = exportMaskIterator.next();
                exportMaskMap[exportMask.GetId()] = exportMask;
            }
            return exportMaskMap;
        }

        static void Main(string[] args)
        {
            // Setup sample export masks
            Uri mask1Uri = new Uri("urn:mask:1");
            Uri mask2Uri = new Uri("urn:mask:2");
            Uri mask3Uri = new Uri("urn:mask:3");

            var allMasks = new Dictionary<Uri, ExportMask>
            {
                { mask1Uri, new ExportMask(mask1Uri) },
                { mask2Uri, new ExportMask(mask2Uri) },
                { mask3Uri, new ExportMask(mask3Uri) }
            };

            // Only these two are "placed"
            var placedMasks = new HashSet<Uri> { mask1Uri, mask3Uri };

            DummyDbClient dbClient = new DummyDbClient(allMasks);
            Program p = new Program(dbClient);

            var map = p.CreateExportMaskMap(placedMasks);

            foreach (var kv in map)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"URI: {kv.Key}, Object: {kv.Value}");
            }
        }
    }

public class ImmutableArray2<K>
{
    private readonly K[] array;
    private readonly int length;
    private readonly bool extendable;
    private AtomicBoolean canExtend;

    private const int _NUM = 1;
    private const bool _BOOL = true;

    public ImmutableArray2(K[] arr, int len, bool extendable)
    {
        array = arr;
        length = len;
        this.extendable = extendable;
        this.canExtend = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    }

    public ImmutableArray2<K> Insert(int index, K obj)
    {
        int len = length + _NUM;
        int newLen = len;
        bool extendable;
        if (index == len - _NUM)
        {
            var x = canExtend;
            if (x != null)
            {
                canExtend = null;
                if (array.Length > index && x.GetAndSet(_BOOL))
                {
                    array[index] = obj;
                    return new ImmutableArray2<K>(array, len, _BOOL);
                }
            }
            extendable = _BOOL;
            newLen = len + _NUM;
        }
        else
        {
            extendable = _BOOL;
        }
        K[] a2 = new K[newLen];
        DataUtils.CopyWithGap(array, a2, length, index);
        a2[index] = obj;
        return new ImmutableArray2<K>(a2, len, extendable);
    }

    public override string ToString()
    {
        return $"[{string.Join(", ", array)}], length: {length}, extendable: {extendable}";
    }

    public K this[int index]
    {
        get { return array[index]; }
    }

    public int Length => length;
}

public static class DataUtils
{
    // Copies elements from source to dest, inserting a gap at the specified index
    public static void CopyWithGap<K>(K[] src, K[] dest, int len, int gapIndex)
    {
        for (int i = 0, j = 0; i < len; i++, j++)
        {
            if (j == gapIndex)
            {
                j++;
            }
            if (j < dest.Length && i < src.Length)
            {
                dest[j] = src[i];
            }
        }
    }
}

// Simple atomic boolean class for demonstration
public class AtomicBoolean
{
    private int _value;

    public AtomicBoolean(bool initial)
    {
        _value = initial ? 1 : 0;
    }

    // Returns previous value and sets to newValue
    public bool GetAndSet(bool newValue)
    {
        int newInt = newValue ? 1 : 0;
        int prev = Interlocked.Exchange(ref _value, newInt);
        return prev != 0;
    }
}

public class InsertArrayIntoVector {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Create a Vector of int arrays
        Vector<int[]> vector = new Vector<>();

        // Create some int arrays to add
        int[] array1 = {1, 2, 3};
        int[] array2 = {4, 5, 6};

        // Add array1 to the vector
        vector.add(array1);

        // Insert array2 at index 0 (insert an entry at this index)
        vector.insertElementAt(array2, 0);

        // Print the contents of the vector
        for (int i = 0; i < vector.size(); i++) {
            int[] arr = vector.get(i);
            System.out.print("Entry at index " + i + ": ");
            for (int val : arr) {
                System.out.print(val + " ");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
    }
}

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.awt.print.*;

public class ImageWriteExample implements Printable {

    private BufferedImage image;

    public ImageWriteExample(BufferedImage img) {
        this.image = img;
    }

    // This method writes the image on the printout without any scaling,
    // and positions it on the right side of the paper, at the current height.
    @Override
    public int print(Graphics g, PageFormat pf, int pageIndex) {
        if (pageIndex > 0) {
            return NO_SUCH_PAGE;
        }

        Graphics2D g2d = (Graphics2D) g;
        double pageWidth = pf.getImageableWidth();
        double pageHeight = pf.getImageableHeight();
        double x = pf.getImageableX() + pageWidth - image.getWidth(); // right side
        double y = pf.getImageableY(); // current height (top)

        g2d.drawImage(image, (int)x, (int)y, null);

        return PAGE_EXISTS;
    }

    // Create a sample image for demonstration
    public static BufferedImage createSampleImage(int width, int height) {
        BufferedImage img = new BufferedImage(width, height, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
        Graphics2D g2d = img.createGraphics();
        g2d.setColor(Color.ORANGE);
        g2d.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
        g2d.setColor(Color.BLUE);
        g2d.drawString("Sample Image", 10, height / 2);
        g2d.dispose();
        return img;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BufferedImage sampleImage = createSampleImage(200, 100);
        PrinterJob printerJob = PrinterJob.getPrinterJob();
        printerJob.setPrintable(new ImageWriteExample(sampleImage));
        boolean doPrint = printerJob.printDialog();
        if (doPrint) {
            try {
                printerJob.print();
            } catch (PrinterException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }
    }
}

class PrintoutExample {
    public class PrintPage
    {
        private Bitmap bitmap;
        private Graphics graphics;

        public PrintPage(int width, int height)
        {
            bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height);
            graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
        }

        public void DrawImage(Image image, int x, int y, int width, int height, object misc)
        {
            graphics.DrawImage(image, new Rectangle(x, y, width, height));
        }

        public void ShowPage()
        {
            Form form = new Form
            {
                Text = "Print Preview",
                ClientSize = new Size(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height),
                BackgroundImage = bitmap,
                BackgroundImageLayout = ImageLayout.None
            };
            Application.Run(form);
        }
    }

    public class Printout
    {
        private PrintPage page;
        private int pagenum;
        private int prFirst;
        private int x0, y0, width, charwidth, linenum, lineheight, lineascent;

        public Printout()
        {
            x0 = 10;
            y0 = 10;
            width = 600;
            charwidth = 7;
            linenum = 2;
            lineheight = 30;
            lineascent = 25;
            pagenum = 1;
            prFirst = 1;
            NewPage();
        }

        private void NewPage()
        {
            page = new PrintPage(800, 600);
        }

        // write a graphic to the printout (see summary above)
        public void WriteNoScale(Image c, Component i)
        {
            if (page == null)
            {
                NewPage();
            }
            int x = x0 + width - (c.Width + charwidth);
            int y = y0 + (linenum * lineheight) + lineascent;
            if (page != null && pagenum >= prFirst)
            {
                page.DrawImage(c, x, y, c.Width, c.Height, null);
            }
        }

        public void ShowResult()
        {
            page.ShowPage();
        }
    }

    public class MyComponent : Component
    {
        // Dummy class for demonstration
    }

    static class Program
    {
        [STAThread]
        static void Main()
        {
            Printout printout = new Printout();
            Bitmap img = new Bitmap(100, 50);
            using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(img))
            {
                g.Clear(Color.Red);
                g.DrawEllipse(Pens.Black, 10, 10, 80, 30);
            }

            MyComponent comp = new MyComponent();
            printout.WriteNoScale(img, comp);
            printout.ShowResult();
        }
    }
}

    public class Printout

        public Printout()

            {
                NewPage();
            }
            int x = x0 + width - (c.Width + charwidth);
            int y = y0 + (linenum * lineheight) + lineascent;
            if (page != null && pagenum >= prFirst)
            {
                page.DrawImage(c, x, y, c.Width, c.Height, null);
            }
        }

        public void ShowResult()
        {
            page.ShowPage();
        }
    }

    public class MyComponent : Component
    {
        // Dummy class for demonstration
    }

    static class Program
    {
        [STAThread]
        static void Main()
        {
            Printout printout = new Printout();
            Bitmap img = new Bitmap(100, 50);
            using (Graphics g = Graphics.FromImage(img))
            {
                g.Clear(Color.Red);
                g.DrawEllipse(Pens.Black, 10, 10, 80, 30);
            }

            MyComponent comp = new MyComponent();
            printout.WriteNoScale(img, comp);
            printout.ShowResult();
        }
    }
}

public interface IHost
{
    void UpdateProgress(string progressLabel, int progress);
}

public class MainHost : IHost
{
    public void UpdateProgress(string progressLabel, int progress)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"Progress: {progressLabel} [{progress}%]");
    }
}

public class Plugin
{
    private IHost myHost;
    private int previousProgress = -1;
    private string previousProgressLabel = string.Empty;

    public Plugin(IHost host)
    {
        myHost = host;
    }

    private void UpdateProgress(string progressLabel, int progress)
    {
        if (myHost != null && (progress != previousProgress || !progressLabel.Equals(previousProgressLabel)))
        {
            myHost.UpdateProgress(progressLabel, progress);
        }
        previousProgress = progress;
        previousProgressLabel = progressLabel;
    }

    // Test method to demonstrate progress updating
    public void RunTask()
    {
        UpdateProgress("Initializing", 0);
        UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10);
        UpdateProgress("Loading Data", 10); // Should not trigger
        UpdateProgress("Processing", 50);
        UpdateProgress("Processing", 50); // Should not trigger
        UpdateProgress("Finalizing", 100);
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        MainHost host = new MainHost();
        Plugin plugin = new Plugin(host);
        plugin.RunTask();
    }
}

public class ProgressUpdateEvent {
    private int progress;
    private String message;

    /**
     * Constructor to initialize the progress update event.
     *
     * @param progress the progress value (0-100)
     * @param message a message describing the current progress
     */
    public ProgressUpdateEvent(int progress, String message) {
        this.progress = progress;
        this.message = message;
    }

    public int getProgress() {
        return progress;
    }

    public String getMessage() {
        return message;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "ProgressUpdateEvent{" +
                "progress=" + progress +
                ", message='" + message + '\'' +
                '}';
    }
}

public class Resource
{
    private string _filePath;

    public Resource(string filePath)
    {
        _filePath = filePath;
    }

    public Stream GetOutputStream()
    {
        return new FileStream(_filePath, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
    }

    public Stream GetInputStream()
    {
        return new FileStream(_filePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
    }
}

public static class IOUtil
{
    public static void CloseEL(Stream stream)
    {
        try
        {
            stream?.Close();
        }
        catch
        {
            // Ignore errors on close
        }
    }
}

public class Program
{
    private const bool _BOOL = true;

    public static void Copy(Stream inputStream, Resource outputResource, bool closeInputStream)
    {
        Stream outputStream = null;
        try
        {
            outputStream = ToBufferedOutputStream(outputResource.GetOutputStream());
        }
        catch (IOException ioe)
        {
            IOUtil.CloseEL(outputStream);
            throw;
        }
        Copy(inputStream, outputStream, closeInputStream, _BOOL);
    }

    public static Stream ToBufferedOutputStream(Stream outputStream)
    {
        // In .NET, BufferedStream can be used for buffering
        return new BufferedStream(outputStream);
    }

    public static void Copy(Stream inputStream, Stream outputStream, bool closeInputStream, bool closeOutputStream)
    {
        try
        {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
            int read;
            while ((read = inputStream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length)) > 0)
            {
                outputStream.Write(buffer, 0, read);
            }
            outputStream.Flush();
        }
        finally
        {
            if (closeInputStream)
            {
                IOUtil.CloseEL(inputStream);
            }
            if (closeOutputStream)
            {
                IOUtil.CloseEL(outputStream);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // Demo: copy file1.txt to file2.txt
        string inputFile = "file1.txt";
        string outputFile = "file2.txt";

        // Create a sample input file
        File.WriteAllText(inputFile, "Hello, Resource Copy!");

        Resource inputResource = new Resource(inputFile);
        Resource outputResource = new Resource(outputFile);

        using (Stream inputStream = inputResource.GetInputStream())
        {
            Copy(inputStream, outputResource, true);
        }

        Console.WriteLine("File copied from {0} to {1}", inputFile, outputFile);
    }
}

public class ResourceCopyExample
{
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Example input resource (simulated as in-memory)
        String data = "This is example resource data.";
        InputStream inputResource = new ByteArrayInputStream(data.getBytes());

        // Output resource (in-memory)
        ByteArrayOutputStream outputResource = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

        // Copy input resource to output resource
        copyResource(inputResource, outputResource);

        // To demonstrate, print the copied content
        String copied = outputResource.toString();
        System.out.println("Copied content: " + copied);

        inputResource.close();
        outputResource.close();
    }

    // Copies from input resource to output resource
    public static void copyResource(InputStream in, OutputStream out) throws IOException {
        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        int bytesRead;
        while ((bytesRead = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
            out.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
        }
    }
}

import java.io.IOException;

public class AudioFaderApp
{
    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        String path = "example.wav";
        String type = "t";
        double fadeInLength = 1.0;
        double stopTime = 10.0;
        double fadeOutLength = 1.0;

        AudioFader fader = new AudioFader();
        String result = fader.FadeAudio(path, type, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);
        System.out.println("Output file: " + result);
    }
}

class AudioFader
{
    // Substitute actual sox binary path or command if needed
    private String soxBin = "sox";

    // Placeholders for _STR and _NUM values (assuming _STR = "", _NUM = -1 for this example)
    private const string _STR = "";
    private const int _NUM = -1;

    public String FadeAudio(String path, String type, double fadeInLength, double stopTime, double fadeOutLength)
    {
        // Possible fade types for SOX: t = linear, q = quadratic, h = half-sine, etc.
        var curves = new List<string> { "t", "q", "h", "l", "p" };
        if (!curves.Contains(type))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid fade type: " + type);
        }

        var file = new FileInfo(path);
        String outFile = file.FullName + ".faded.wav";
        var cmd = new List<string>
        {
            soxBin,
            path,
            outFile,
            "fade",
            type,
            fadeInLength.ToString()
        };

        if (stopTime != _NUM)
            cmd.Add(stopTime.ToString());
        if (fadeOutLength != _NUM)
            cmd.Add(fadeOutLength.ToString());

        try
        {
            int rc = ExecSox(cmd, Callback);
            if (rc != 0)
            {
                outFile = null;
            }
        }
        catch (IOException e)
        {
            System.Console.WriteLine("IOException: " + e);
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            System.Console.WriteLine("Exception: " + e);
        }
        return outFile;
    }

    // Dummy implementation of ExecSox; in real code this would execute the sox command
    private int ExecSox(List<string> cmd, Action<string> callback)
    {
        // Just print the command to simulate execution
        System.Console.WriteLine("Executing command: " + string.Join(" ", cmd));
        // Simulate success
        callback?.Invoke("Sox executed successfully.");
        return 0;
    }

    // Dummy callback for process output
    private void Callback(string msg)
    {
        System.Console.WriteLine(msg);
    }
}

public class FadeAudioWithSox {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (args.length != 6) {
            System.out.println("Usage: java FadeAudioWithSox <inputPath> <outputPath> <fadeType> <fadeInLength> <stopTime> <fadeOutLength>");
            System.out.println("Example: java FadeAudioWithSox input.wav output.wav t 3 10 3");
            return;
        }
        String inputPath = args[0];
        String outputPath = args[1];
        String fadeType = args[2];
        String fadeInLength = args[3];
        String stopTime = args[4];
        String fadeOutLength = args[5];

        fadeAudio(inputPath, outputPath, fadeType, fadeInLength, stopTime, fadeOutLength);
    }

    public static void fadeAudio(
            String inputPath,
            String outputPath,
            String fadeType,
            String fadeInLength,
            String stopTime,
            String fadeOutLength) {

        // sox <path> outfile fade <type> <fadeinlength> <stoptime> <fadeoutlength>
        string[] cmd = {
                "sox",
                inputPath,
                outputPath,
                "fade",
                fadeType,
                fadeInLength,
                stopTime,
                fadeOutLength
        };

        try {
            ProcessBuilder pb = new ProcessBuilder(cmd);
            pb.inheritIO();
            Process process = pb.start();
            int exitCode = process.WaitForExit();
            if (exitCode == 0) {
                System.Console.WriteLine("Fade effect applied successfully.");
            } else {
                System.Error.WriteLine("Error while processing audio. Exit code: " + exitCode);
            }
        } catch (IOException | InterruptedException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

    public int Bottom { get; set; }
    public int Left { get; set; }
    public int Right { get; set; }
}

public class BaseDrawable
{
    public virtual void Draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        Console.WriteLine("BaseDrawable.Draw(Canvas)");
    }
}

public class MyDrawable : BaseDrawable
{
    protected EdgeEffect mEdgeGlowTop = new EdgeEffect();
    protected EdgeEffect mEdgeGlowBottom = new EdgeEffect();
    protected Padding mListPadding = new Padding { Top = 10, Bottom = 10, Left = 5, Right = 5 };
    protected int mGlowPaddingTop = 2;
    protected int mGlowPaddingBottom = 2;
    protected int mFirstPositionDistanceGuess = 15;
    protected const int _NUM = 180; // for Math.Min and rotate degrees

    protected int GetScrollX() => 50;
    protected int GetHeight() => 200;
    protected int GetWidth() => 300;

    protected void Invalidate()
    {
        Console.WriteLine("Invalidate() called.");
    }

    public override void Draw(Canvas canvas)
    {
        base.Draw(canvas);
        if (mEdgeGlowTop != null)
        {
            int scrollX = GetScrollX();
            if (!mEdgeGlowTop.IsFinished())
            {
                int restoreCount = canvas.Save();
                int topPadding = mListPadding.Top + mGlowPaddingTop;
                int bottomPadding = mListPadding.Bottom + mGlowPaddingBottom;
                int height = GetHeight() - topPadding - bottomPadding;
                int edgeX = Math.Min(_NUM, scrollX + mFirstPositionDistanceGuess);
                canvas.Rotate(-_NUM);
                canvas.Translate(-GetHeight() + topPadding, edgeX);
                mEdgeGlowTop.SetSize(height, height);
                if (mEdgeGlowTop.Draw(canvas))
                {
                    Invalidate();
                }
                canvas.RestoreToCount(restoreCount);
            }
            if (!mEdgeGlowBottom.IsFinished())
            {
                int restoreCount = canvas.Save();
                int topPadding = mListPadding.Left + mGlowPaddingTop;
                int bottomPadding = mListPadding.Right + mGlowPaddingBottom;
                int height = GetHeight() - topPadding - bottomPadding;
                int width = GetWidth();
                Console.WriteLine($"Bottom glow branch: height={height}, width={width}");
                canvas.RestoreToCount(restoreCount);
            }
        }
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas();
        MyDrawable drawable = new MyDrawable();
        drawable.Draw(canvas);
    }
}

using System;
using System.Numerics;
using Xunit;

public class BigIntegerAddTest {
    public static class Assert {
        public static void True(bool condition) {
            if (!condition) throw new Exception("Assertion failed: condition is false");
        }
        public static void Equal(int expected, int actual) {
            if (!expected.Equals(actual)) throw new Exception($"Assertion failed: expected {expected}, got {actual}");
        }
    }

    public void TestCase20() {
        byte[] bBytes = { 0xD2, 0x02, 0x96, 0x49 }; // little-endian for 1234567890
        byte[] rBytes = { 0xD2, 0x02, 0x96, 0x49 }; // expected result same as input
        int bSign = -1; // negative
        BigInteger aNumber = BigInteger.Zero;
        BigInteger bNumber = new BigInteger(bSign, bBytes);
        BigInteger result = aNumber + bNumber;
        byte[] resBytes = result.ToByteArray();

        for (int i = 0; i < rBytes.Length; i++) {
            Assert.True(resBytes[i] == rBytes[i]);
        }
        Assert.Equal(bNumber.Sign, result.Sign);
    }

    public void TestNegative() {
        BigInteger bNumber = new BigInteger(-1, new byte[] { 0x01 });
        BigInteger result = bNumber + BigInteger.Zero;
        Assert.Equal(BigInteger.One, result);
    }

    public void TestZeroInput() {
        BigInteger aNumber = BigInteger.Zero;
        BigInteger result = aNumber + BigInteger.Zero;
        Assert.Equal(BigInteger.Zero, result);
    }

    public void TestPositiveAddition() {
        BigInteger bNumber = new BigInteger(1, new byte[] { 0x01 });
        BigInteger result = bNumber + BigInteger.One;
        Assert.Equal(BigInteger.Two, result);
    }

    public void TestLargeNumbers() {
        BigInteger aNumber = new BigInteger(12345678901234567890L);
        BigInteger bNumber = new BigInteger(-1, new byte[] { 0x01 });
        BigInteger result = aNumber + bNumber;
        Assert.Equal(BigInteger.Two, result);
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        var test = new BigIntegerAddTest();
        test.TestCase20();
        test.TestNegative();
        test.TestZeroInput();
        test.TestPositiveAddition();
        test.TestLargeNumbers();
        System.Console.WriteLine("All tests passed.");
    }
}

public class BigIntegerAdd {
    public static BigInteger Add(BigInteger a, BigInteger b) {
        return a + b;
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args) {
        BigInteger result = BigIntegerAdd.Add(BigInteger.Zero, BigInteger.Zero);
        Console.WriteLine("Result: " + result);
    }
}

```java
import org.apache.commons.imaging.ImageReadException;
import org.apache.commons.imaging.ImageWriteException;
import org.apache.commons.imaging.Imaging;
import org.apache.commons.imaging.formats.tiff.constants.ExifTagConstants;
import org.apache.commons.imaging.formats.tiff.write.TiffOutputDirectory;
import org.apache.commons.imaging.formats.tiff.write.TiffOutputSet;

public class FixGpsTimestampInExif {

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (args.length != 2) {
            System.out.println("Usage: java FixGpsTimestampInExif <inputImage> <outputImage>");
            return;
        }
        File jpegImageFile = new File(args[0]);
        File dst = new File(args[1]);
        try {
            fixGpsTimestamp(jpegImageFile, dst);
            System.out.println("GPS timestamp fixed and output written to " + dst.getAbsolutePath());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.err.println("Failed to fix GPS timestamp: " + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    public static void fixGpsTimestamp(File jpegImageFile, File dst) throws IOException, ImageReadException, ImageWriteException {
        // Read metadata
        TiffOutputSet outputSet = null;
        Metadata metadata = null;
        try {
            metadata = ImageMetadataReader.readMetadata(jpegImageFile);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IOException("Could not read EXIF data", e);
        }

        // Apache Commons Imaging: Get output set from EXIF or create new
        TiffImageMetadata exif = null;
        try {
            exif = (TiffImageMetadata) Imaging.getMetadata(jpegImageFile);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            exif = null; // No EXIF
        }
        if (exif != null) {
            outputSet = exif.getOutputSet();
        } else {
            outputSet = new TiffOutputSet();
        }

        GpsDirectory gpsDirectory = metadata.getFirstDirectoryOfType(GpsDirectory.class);

        Long gpsTimeMillis = null;
        Date gpsDate = null;
        if (gpsDirectory != null) {
            gpsDate = gpsDirectory.getGpsDate();
            if (gpsDate != null) {
                gpsTimeMillis = gpsDate.getTime();
            }
        }

        if (gpsTimeMillis == null) {
            System.out.println("No GPS date found in EXIF.");
            return;
        }

        SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss");
        sdf.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"));
        String[] hms = sdf.format(new Date(gpsTimeMillis)).split(":");
        RationalNumber[] gpsTime = new RationalNumber[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            gpsTime[i] = new RationalNumber(Integer.parseInt(hms[i]), 1);
        }

        String gpsDateStamp = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy:MM:dd").format(new Date(gpsTimeMillis));

        // Set GPS timestamp and datestamp in output EXIF
        TiffOutputDirectory gpsDir = outputSet.getOrCreateGPSDirectory();
        gpsDir.removeField(ExifTagConstants.EXIF_TAG_GPS_TIME_STAMP);
        gpsDir.removeField(ExifTagConstants.EXIF_TAG_GPS_DATE_STAMP);
        gpsDir.add(ExifTagConstants.EXIF_TAG_GPS_TIME_STAMP, gpsTime);
        gpsDir.add(ExifTagConstants.EXIF_TAG_GPS_DATE_STAMP, gpsDateStamp);

        Imaging.writeImage(Imaging.getBufferedImage(jpegImageFile), dst, Imaging.guessFormat(jpegImageFile), outputSet);
    }
}

            public boolean consumes(EventType<?> eventType) {

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;

public class Localizer
{
    public static String GetMessage(String str, String arg)
    {
        return $"Error: {str} ({arg})";
    }
}

public class MyStreamReader
{
    private InputStream fInputStream;
    private int _NUM;
    private String _STR;

    public MyStreamReader(InputStream inputStream, int num, String str)
    {
        fInputStream = inputStream;
        _NUM = num;
        _STR = str;
    }

    // read a single character. this method will block until a character is available,
    // an i/o error occurs, or the end of the stream is reached.
    public int Read()
    {
        int b0 = fInputStream.read();
        if (b0 > _NUM)
        {
            throw new IOException(Localizer.GetMessage(_STR, Integer.toString(b0)));
        }
        return b0;
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void main(String[] args)
    {
        byte[] data = { 65, 66, 67, 200 };
        using (java.io.InputStream ms = new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream(data)) 
        {
            int limit = 150;
            String errorMsg = "Input value exceeds limit";
            MyStreamReader reader = new MyStreamReader(ms, limit, errorMsg);

            try
            {
                int ch;
                while ((ch = reader.Read()) != -1)
                {
                    System.out.println("Read char: (" + (char)ch + ") (int: " + ch + ")");
                }
            }
            catch (java.io.IOException ex)
            {
                System.out.println("IOException caught: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }
    }
}

public class ReadSingleCharacter {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.print("Please enter a character:");
        try (java.io.InputStreamReader reader = new java.io.InputStreamReader(System.in)) {
            int ch = reader.read();
            if (ch == -1) {
                System.out.println("End of stream reached.");
            } else {
                System.out.println("You entered: " + (char)ch);
            }
        } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
            System.err.println("An I/O error occurred: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

using System;

public class DeltaMax
{
    private long max = 0;
    private long lastTick = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;

    // Update max if new delta is bigger
    public void Mark()
    {
        long now = DateTime.UtcNow.Ticks;
        long delta = now - lastTick;
        if (delta > max)
        {
            max = delta;
        }
        lastTick = now;
    }

    // Get the max delta in nanoseconds
    public long Get()
    {
        // 1 tick = 100 ns
        return max * 100;
    }
}

public class Timer
{
    private DeltaMax deltaMax = new DeltaMax();

    // get running - maximum time - delta , in nanoseconds .
    public long Max()
    {
        return deltaMax.Get();
    }

    public void Mark()
    {
        deltaMax.Mark();
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        Timer timer = new Timer();
        timer.Mark();
        System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(100);
        timer.Mark();
        System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(150);
        timer.Mark();

        Console.WriteLine("Max delta (nanoseconds): " + timer.Max());
    }
}

class MaxTimeDelta {
  public static void Main(String[] args) {
    // Example array of time deltas in nanoseconds
    long[] deltas = {1000000L, 2500000L, 500000L, 3200000L, 1200000L};

    // Get maximum value
    long maxDelta = Long.MIN_VALUE;
    for (long delta : deltas) {
      if (delta > maxDelta) {
        maxDelta = delta;
      }
    }

    // Print the maximum running delta in nanoseconds
    System.out.println("Maximum time delta (ns): " + maxDelta);
  }
}

public class DeltaMaxTests {

  [Fact]
  public void Test_DeltaMax MarksCorrectly() {
    DeltaMax deltaMax = new DeltaMax();
    deltaMax.Mark();
    Assert.True(deltaMax.Get() > 0);
  }

  [Fact]
  public void Test_DeltaMax UpdatesCorrectly() {
    DeltaMax deltaMax = new DeltaMax();
    long initialDelta = deltaMax.Get();
    deltaMax.Mark();
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(100);
    deltaMax.Mark();
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(150);
    deltaMax.Mark();
    Assert.True(initialDelta < deltaMax.Get());
  }

  [Fact]
  public void Test_DeltaMax GetsCorrectValue() {
    DeltaMax deltaMax = new DeltaMax();
    deltaMax.Mark();
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(100);
    deltaMax.Mark();
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(150);
    deltaMax.Mark();
    Assert.True(deltaMax.Get() * 100 == (long)(400));
  }

  [Fact]
  public void Test_Timer MarksCorrectly() {

    timer.Mark();
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(100);
    timer.Mark();
    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(150);
    timer.Mark();

    Assert.True(timer.Max() > 0);
  }

    Assert.True(maxDelta == 3200000);

  }

import java.awt.Desktop;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;

public class PrintCurrentFile {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Replace "example.txt" with the actual filename you want to print
        File file = new File("example.txt");

        if (!file.exists()) {
            System.out.println("File does not exist: " + file.getAbsolutePath());
            return;
        }

        if (!Desktop.isDesktopSupported()) {
            System.out.println("Desktop is not supported on this platform.");
            return;
        }

        Desktop desktop = Desktop.getDesktop();

        if (!desktop.isSupported(Desktop.Action.PRINT)) {
            System.out.println("Print action is not supported on this platform.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            desktop.print(file);
            System.out.printf("Printing: %s%n",file.getAbsolutePath());
        } catch (IOException e) {
            System.out.println("An error occurred while printing the file: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
}

```java
import java.util.List;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class RuleGrounding {
    private List<String> groundings = new ArrayList<>();

    public RuleGrounding(List<String> grounds) {
        groundings = new ArrayList<>(grounds);
    }

    public boolean isFailed() {
        // For demonstration, return true if groundings is empty
        return groundings.size() == 0;
    }

    public List<String> getAlternatives() {
        // In a full implementation, this could get alternative groundings
        // For demonstration, just return the existing ones
        return new ArrayList<>(groundings);
    }

    public void extend(List<String> alternatives) {
        groundings.addAll(alternatives);
    }

    public void extend(RuleGrounding other) {
        if (other.isFailed()) {
            groundings.clear();
            return;
        }
        extend(other.getAlternatives());
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return String.join(", ", groundings);
    }
}

class Program {
    static void main(String[] args) {
        RuleGrounding grounding1 = new RuleGrounding(new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList("A", "B")));
        RuleGrounding grounding2 = new RuleGrounding(new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList("C", "D")));

        System.out.println("Before Extend:");
        System.out.println("Grounding1: " + grounding1);
        System.out.println("Grounding2: " + grounding2);

        grounding1.extend(grounding2);

        System.out.println("After Extend:");
        System.out.println("Grounding1: " + grounding1);

        // Test with failed groundings
        RuleGrounding grounding3 = new RuleGrounding(new ArrayList<>());
        grounding1.extend(grounding3);

        System.out.println("After extending with a failed grounding:");
        System.out.println("Grounding1: " + grounding1);
    }
}

    public static List<T> ExtendGroundings<T>(List<T> existing, List<T> alternative)
    {
        List<T> result = new List<T>(existing);
        result.AddRange(alternative);
        return result;
    }

    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        List<string> existing = new List<string>() { "A", "B" };
        List<string> alternative = new List<string>() { "C", "D" };

        List<string> complete = ExtendGroundings(existing, alternative);

        Console.WriteLine("Extended Groundings: " + string.Join(", ", complete));
    }
}
```

Before Extend:

Grounding2: C, D

After Extend:
Grounding1: A, B, C, D

After extending with a failed grounding:
Grounding1: 

Extended Groundings: A, B, C, D

public class ParserException : Exception
{
    public ParserException(string message) : base(message) { }
}

public class Pattern
{
    private string _pattern;
    public Pattern(string pattern)
    {
        _pattern = pattern;
    }

    public string Pattern()
    {
        return _pattern;
    }
}

public abstract class ParserBase
{
    protected string document;
    protected const string _STR = "Pattern not matched: ";

    public ParserBase(string doc)
    {
        document = doc;
    }

    public abstract string Expect(Pattern pattern);

    // Assume Read matches a pattern at the document's start, and advances the document
    public virtual string Read(Pattern pattern)
    {
        if (document.StartsWith(pattern.Pattern()))
        {
            string token = pattern.Pattern();
            document = document.Substring(token.Length);
            return token;
        }
        return null;
    }
}

public class MyParser : ParserBase
{
    public MyParser(string doc) : base(doc) { }

    public override string Expect(Pattern pattern)
    {
        string token = Read(pattern);
        if (token == null)
        {
            throw new ParserException(_STR + pattern.Pattern() + _STR + document);
        }
        return token;
    }
}

public class Program
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        string input = "hello world";
        Pattern pattern = new Pattern("hello");
        MyParser parser = new MyParser(input);

        try
        {
            string result = parser.Expect(pattern);
            Console.WriteLine("Matched: " + result);
        }
        catch (ParserException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Exception: " + ex.Message);
        }

        Pattern failPattern = new Pattern("bye");
        try
        {
            string result2 = parser.Expect(failPattern);
            Console.WriteLine("Matched: " + result2);
        }
        catch (ParserException ex)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Exception: " + ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

public class PatternMatcher 
{
    public static String matchPatternFromInputStream(Pattern pattern, Scanner input) throws Exception
    {
        if (input.findInLine(pattern) != null)
        {
            return input.match().group();
        }
        else
        {
            throw new Exception("Pattern not found in input stream");
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args)
    {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("\\d+"); 
        System.out.println("Enter a string containing numbers:");
        try
        {
            String matched = matchPatternFromInputStream(pattern, scanner);
            System.out.WriteLine("Matched pattern: " + matched);
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            System.out.WriteLine(e.getMessage());
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}

public class UnitTests 
{
    public static void Main()
    {
        Program program = new Program();

        // Test 1
        string input = "hello world";
        Pattern pattern = new Pattern("hello");
        MyParser parser = new MyParser(input);
        Assert.AreEqual(program.Expect(pattern), "hello");

        // Test 2

        try 
        {
            program.Expect(pattern);
            Assert.Fail();
        }
        catch (ParserException ex) 
        {
            String result = ex.Message;
            Assert.IsTrue(result.Contains("Pattern not matched: "));
        }

        // Test 3

        pattern = new Pattern("\\d+");
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(input);
        PatternMatcher matcher = new PatternMatcher();
        Assert.AreEqual(matcher.matchPatternFromInputStream(pattern, scanner), "123");

        // Test 4

        try

            Assert.Fail();
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            String result = e.getMessage();
            Assert.IsTrue(result.Contains("Pattern not found in input stream"));
        }

        // Test 5

        pattern = Pattern.compile("\\d+");
        try

            Assert.Fail();
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            String result = e.getMessage();
            Assert.IsTrue(result.Contains("Pattern not found in input stream"));

            stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE test1 (id INT)");
            stmt.execute("CREATE VIEW testview AS SELECT * FROM test1");

            DatabaseMetaData meta = con.getMetaData();
            ResultSet rs = meta.getTableTypes();

            System.out.println("Table Types:");
            while (rs.next()) {
                String tableType = rs.getString(1);
                System.out.println(tableType);

            rs.close();

                e.printStackTrace();
            }
        }

public class FileCacheTest {

    private static void testFileCache(String filePath) throws IOException {
        FileStream fs1 = UpdateCache(filePath);
        FileInputStream fis1 = getFileStream(fs1, filePath);

        if (fs1 != null) {
            Console.WriteLine("First stream opened and cached.");
        }

        FileStream fs2 = UpdateCache(filePath);
        FileInputStream fis2 = getFileStream(fs2, filePath);

        if (fis2 == fis1) {
            Console.WriteLine("Second stream retrieved from cache.");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Second stream not retrieved from cache.");
        }
    }

    private static void testFileCacheThrowingIOException(String filePath) throws IOException {
        getFileStream(filePath);
    }

    private static void testGetFileStreamSameInstance(String filePath) throws IOException {
        FileInputStream fis1 = getFileStream(filePath);
        FileInputStream fis2 = getFileStream(filePath);

        if (fis1 == fis2) {
            Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
        }
    }

    private static void testGetFileStreamNotInCache(String filePath) throws IOException {
        FileStream fs = UpdateCache(filePath);
        FileInputStream fis = getFileStream(fs, filePath);

        if (fis != null) {
            Console.WriteLine("File stream not in cache retrieved and closed");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("File stream not in cache.");
        }
    }

    private static void testCloseAll() throws IOException {
        FileCache fileCache = new FileCache();
        FileInputStream fis1 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
        FileInputStream fis2 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
        FileInputStream fis3 = fileCache.getFileStream("newfile.txt");

        if (fis1 == fis2) {
            Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
        }

        fileCache.closeAll();
    }

    private static void testCloseAllThrowingIOException() throws IOException {
        FileCache fileCache = new FileCache();

        try {
            FileInputStream fis1 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
            FileInputStream fis2 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");

            if (fis1 == fis2) {
                Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
            } else {
                Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
            }

        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        fileCache.closeAll();

    }

    private static void testCloseAllFileNotInCache() throws IOException {
        FileCache fileCache = new FileCache();
        FileInputStream fis1 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
        FileInputStream fis2 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");

        if (fis1 == fis2) {
            Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
        }

        FileInputStream fis3 = fileCache.getFileStream("newfile.txt");

        if (fis1 != fis3) {
            Console.WriteLine("File stream not in cache.");
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        String tempFilePath = Path.GetTempFileName();
        File.WriteAllText(tempFilePath, "Sample content for cache test.");

        // First call: should open and cache the stream
        FileStream fs1 = UpdateCache(tempFilePath);
        if (fs1 != null)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("First stream opened and cached.");
        }

        // Second call: should retrieve from cache
        FileStream fs2 = UpdateCache(tempFilePath);
        if (fs2 == fs1)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Second stream retrieved from cache.");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Second stream not retrieved from cache.");
        }

        testFileCache(tempFilePath);

        // Clean up
        fs1?.Dispose();
        fileNameAndStreamCache.Clear();
        File.Delete(tempFilePath);
    }
}

Java:
```java
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Program {

    public static class LOGGER {
        public static void Error(Exception ex, String message) {
            System.out.println("ERROR: " + message + "\n" + ex);
        }
    }

    private static Dictionary<String, FileInputStream> fileNameAndStreamCache = new Dictionary<String, FileInputStream>();

    // this method will be used to check whether stream is already present in cache or not for filepath
    // if not present then create it and then add to cache , other wise get from cache
    public static FileInputStream UpdateCache(String filePath) {
        if (!fileNameAndStreamCache.containsKey(filePath)) {
            try {
                FileInputStream fileInputStream = new FileInputStream(filePath);
                fileNameAndStreamCache.put(filePath, fileInputStream);
            } catch (IOException e) {
                LOGGER.Error(e, e.getMessage());
            }
        }
        return fileNameAndStreamCache.get(filePath);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // Create a temp file to demonstrate the cache
        String tempFilePath = new File(tempFilePath).getPath();
        FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(tempFilePath);
        writer.write("Sample content for cache test.");
        writer.close();

        // First call: should open and cache the stream
        FileInputStream fs1 = UpdateCache(tempFilePath);
        if (fs1 != null) {
            System.out.println("First stream opened and cached.");
        }

        // Second call: should retrieve from cache
        FileInputStream fs2 = UpdateCache(tempFilePath);
        if (fs1 == fs2) {
            System.out.println("Second stream retrieved from cache.");
        } else {
            System.out.println("Second stream not retrieved from cache.");
        }

        testFileCache(tempFilePath);

        // Clean up
        fs1.close();
    }
}

        }
    }

    private static void testGetFileStreamNotInCache(String filePath) throws IOException {
        FileInputStream fs = UpdateCache(filePath);
        FileInputStream fis = getFileStream(fs, filePath);

        if (fis != null) {
            Console.WriteLine("File stream not in cache retrieved and closed");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("File stream not in cache.");
        }
    }

    private static void testCloseAll() throws IOException {
        FileCache fileCache = new FileCache();
        FileInputStream fis1 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
        FileInputStream fis2 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
        FileInputStream fis3 = fileCache.getFileStream("newfile.txt");

        if (fis1 == fis2) {
            Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
        }

        fileCache.closeAll();
    }

    private static void testCloseAllThrowingIOException() throws IOException {
        FileCache fileCache = new FileCache();

        try {
            FileInputStream fis1 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
            FileInputStream fis2 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");

            if (fis1 == fis2) {
                Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
            } else {
                Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
            }

        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        fileCache.closeAll();

    }

    private static void testCloseAllFileNotInCache() throws IOException {
        FileCache fileCache = new FileCache();
        FileInputStream fis1 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");
        FileInputStream fis2 = fileCache.getFileStream("test.txt");

        if (fis1 == fis2) {
            Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
        } else {
            Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
        }

        FileInputStream fis3 = fileCache.getFileStream("newfile.txt");

        if (fis1 != fis3) {
            Console.WriteLine("File stream not in cache.");
        }
    }

    private static void testGetFileStreamThrowingIOException(String filePath) throws IOException {
        try {
            getFileStream(filePath);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FileCache fileCache = new FileCache();

        try {
            // Please make sure the test.txt file exists in your working directory.
            String file1 = "test.txt";
            String file2 = "test.txt";

            FileInputStream fis1 = fileCache.getFileStream(file1);
            FileInputStream fis2 = fileCache.getFileStream(file2);

            if (fis1 == fis2) {
                Console.WriteLine("Same FileInputStream instance returned from cache.");
            } else {
                Console.WriteLine("Different FileInputStream instances returned.");
            }

    }

import java.util.*;

public class SwipeListener
{
    // This could have event handler methods or identifiers as needed
}

public class SwipeManager
{
    private List<SwipeListener> mListeners = new List<SwipeListener>();

    public void AddSwipeListener(SwipeListener listener)
    {
        if (listener != null && !mListeners.Contains(listener))
        {
            mListeners.Add(listener);
        }
    }

    // removes a listener from the set of listeners
    public void RemoveSwipeListener(SwipeListener listener)
    {
        if (mListeners == null)
        {
            return;
        }
        mListeners.Remove(listener);
    }

    public void PrintListeners()
    {
        System.out.println("Current listeners count: " + mListeners.size());
    }
}

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        SwipeManager manager = new SwipeManager();
        SwipeListener listener1 = new SwipeListener();
        SwipeListener listener2 = new SwipeListener();

        manager.AddSwipeListener(listener1);
        manager.AddSwipeListener(listener2);

        manager.PrintListeners();

        manager.RemoveSwipeListener(listener1);

        manager.PrintListeners();
    }
}

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;

public class ListenerManager {
    private Set<Listener> listeners = new HashSet<>();

    public void addListener(Listener listener) {
        listeners.add(listener);
    }

    // removes a listener from the set of listeners.
    public void removeListener(Listener listener) {
        listeners.remove(listener);
    }

    public void notifyListeners(String message) {
        for (Listener listener : listeners) {
            listener.onEvent(message);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ListenerManager manager = new ListenerManager();
        Listener listener1 = new MyListener("Listener1");
        Listener listener2 = new MyListener("Listener2");

        manager.addListener(listener1);
        manager.addListener(listener2);

        System.out.println("Notifying listeners...");
        manager.notifyListeners("Event 1");

        System.out.println("Removing Listener1...");
        manager.removeListener(listener1);

        System.out.println("Notifying listeners again...");
        manager.notifyListeners("Event 2");
    }
}

interface Listener {
    void onEvent(String message);
}

class MyListener implements Listener {
    private String name;

    public MyListener(String name) {
        this.name = name;
    }

    @Override
    public void onEvent(String message) {
        System.out.println(name + " received: " + message);
    }
}

class UnitTest {
    static int testAddRemoveListenerSwipeManager() {
        SwipeManager manager = new SwipeManager();
        SwipeListener listener1 = new SwipeListener();
        SwipeListener listener2 = new SwipeListener();

        manager.AddSwipeListener(listener1);
        manager.AddSwipeListener(listener2);

        manager.RemoveSwipeListener(listener1);

        return manager.GetListenersCount();
    }

    static int testAddRemoveListenerListenerManager() {
        ListenerManager manager = new ListenerManager();
        Listener listener1 = new MyListener("Listener1");
        Listener listener2 = new MyListener("Listener2");

        manager.addListener(listener1);
        manager.addListener(listener2);

        manager.removeListener(listener1);

        return manager.GetListenersCount();
    }

    static int testGetListenersCountSwipeManager() {
        SwipeManager manager = new SwipeManager();

        return manager.GetListenersCount();
    }

    static int testGetListenersCountListenerManager() {
        ListenerManager manager = new ListenerManager();

        return manager.GetListenersCount();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        System.out.println(testAddRemoveListenerSwipeManager());
        System.out.println(testAddRemoveListenerListenerManager());
        System.out.println(testGetListenersCountSwipeManager());
        System.out.println(testGetListenersCountListenerManager());

        if (testAddRemoveListenerSwipeManager() == 1)
            System.out.println("Test Add Remove Listener passed");
        else
            System.out.println("Test Add Remove Listener failed");

        if (testAddRemoveListenerListenerManager() == 1)
            System.out.println("Test Add Remove Listener passed");
        else
            System.out.println("Test Add Remove Listener failed");

        if (testGetListenersCountSwipeManager() == 0)
            System.out.println("Test Get Listeners count passed");
        else
            System.out.println("Test Get Listeners count failed");

        if (testGetListenersCountListenerManager() == 0)
            System.out.println("Test Get Listeners count passed");
        else
            System.out.println("Test Get Listeners count failed");
    }
